rows.original: for one to arrive. The waitress is a kaithrit femboi who somehow seems oddly familiar. Before you can put your finger on it, he speaks up. “Welcome to the Pump House, can I take your ordeeerrr...” he says, trailing off, his mouth hanging open. “Everything alright?” you ask, raising an eyebrow. “N-no, everything’s perfectly fine, just had a bit of a brain freeze,” he tells you. Looking around the restaurant, you gather that there are four waitresses, all of them kaithrit bois. There must be someone else in the kitchen, given the rate the bois come and go. After too long, the same kaithrit returns, a plate of warm food in front of him. “There you go, please, enjoy your meal,” he squeaks out before scampering off. Taking a mouthful, you find it’s very tasty; not overpowering, not too heavy, and perfectly hearty for more of a diner-style lunch meal. Before you know it, you’ve polished off your plate. You don’t have to wait long for your waitress to arrive again. “I hope you enjoyed your meal. Before you leave, the owner would like a word with you,” he says. You raise an eyebrow, wondering what the owner of the diner could want with you, but you decide to go with him either way. He leads you through the kitchen and into an office. It’s a rather simple backroom, not a dump, but neither fancy.

rows.original: The office chair on the other side of the desk is facing the wall, but when the waitress closes the door, it spins to face you. “I’ve been expecting you, Steele.” It doesn’t take you long to recognize the face: the kui-tan mercenary you fought on Dhaal in a secret warehouse. She’s changed from her combat suit to a pair of slacks, dress shirt, and a tie, with a vest over it. “Really?” you ask flatly, your hand hovering over your [pc.weapon] in case that she’s going to try something. “Well, no, not really. And calm down, I’m not going to do anything stupid. Last time we met, it was only business. I have no reason to get into a fight with you, especially with how things turned out. And more importantly, I don’t want to lose my business license, or my hygiene license or anything else. I don’t need to get shut down by some bureaucrats.” You move your hand away from your [pc.weapon], sitting down at the chair in front of the desk. “So why did you want to talk to me?” you ask, still unsure what she has in mind. “Well, since you dropped in on my diner, I figured it was going to be a matter of time until you saw me again, and I didn’t want you to get any wrong ideas,” she explains. Seems reasonable enough, but you have to wonder one thing. “Why did you leave Dhaal?” “Well, after you kicked my ass in that warehouse, I had to leave before the Zaibatsu found out. I didn’t want to be turned into an XO or any of the other nefarious shit they’ve got going on behind closed doors. Plus, I have to take care of my boys. You’re probably also wondering why a restaurant? Well, It’s my job to provide for them, but merc jobs are the best thing I could manage at the time. It’s not what I’d prefer, but the margins are too tight for anything more.” She extends her hand to you, offering a handshake. “That being said, I hope we can put what happened behind us, and start anew.” You grab her hand and shake it. “We’ll see, I won’t promise much, but I’m not going to give you any trouble, at the very least,” you assure her. “That’s all I can ask for,” she says, leaning back in her chair. You open the door and step out of the office, walking through the kitchen and into the dining hall.

rows.original: “So, how did a kui-tan end up as a mercenary on Dhaal?” you ask. “Never been the best storyteller, but might as well give it a shot,” she starts. “So, my parents are both kui-tan from Jitafore and I lived there until my early thirties. It was a decent place. I got a job pretty early on, but nothing worth mentioning; my first proper job was working security. Nothing special, just keeping an eye on people and making sure that no one does anything against the rules. It was good work, although you wouldn’t believe how often I had to break up two or more people fucking in public spaces.” “That job didn’t last long. I didn’t quit or anything, but somehow got roped into working actual law enforcement. But I was already thinking of moving on that point. I didn’t hate the job, but that life just wasn’t for me, I wanted to see the rest of the galaxy. I could have joined up with the U.G.C., but I didn’t want some commanding officer to decide where I was going and what I was doing. So I spent a few years working off-jobs, sometimes mercenary, sometimes ship security,” Jana sighs. “After I met my boys — I can tell how it happened some time later if you’re interested — I started working a more stable mercenary job. Having a squad that you know and can trust makes a huge difference. We originally didn’t do much with any of the Rush planets, but a contact of mine got in touch with me, told how well the Zaibatsu pay. Made my way to the planet with my boys, and well, you know what happened then.” You clear your throat, feeling a little self-conscious from ruining her job. “Sounds like you had a good thing going. Sorry for busting your operation.” “It’s alright. It honestly was the wake-up call I needed. It’s not like I thought we were invincible, but being a merc, you’re living in constant danger. If it had been someone less generous than you, or an agent of one of the other Zaibatsu, my boys and I would have been screwed. Made into slaves or worse.” Jana flexes her cybernetic hand, thoughtfully. “So I got the hell out of there as soon as we could.” “So why a diner?” you ask, unable to help but to wonder why she went from mercenary work to running a restaurant. “We talked about what we were going to do after getting out of Dhaal safely. None of us wanted to work for someone else, and a couple of my boys already knew how to cook and behave, so after talking to a friend of mine he suggested that I could start a diner. At first, I wasn’t too convinced, but that same friend originally owned this place, and gave me a good deal on it. He’d shut it down a while back and hadn’t gotten a chance to sell it yet, so he was more than happy to get it off his back.” “How do you like the new job?” You ask. “I mean, I do miss the mercenary gigs. But I do like this line of work. Safe work. Ultimately, though, I care about getting to stick with my boys,” she finishes with a smile.

rows.original: Sauntering over to her little den, you get a quick look at her. She’s pretty short, at most 5' 3" and the tips of her shoes just about touch the floor. Her hair is a very rich shade of wine red and admirably well-kept. She has peculiar eye-shaped markings above her eyebrows. Her clothing style is smart-casual: classy but all purpose. A straw leading to a thin glass full of soda sits idly between her lips and small earphones play unfamiliar music that drifts around her. You can’t quite tell if she’s looking at you because her eyes... seem to be made of stardust.
rows.translation: 你漫步来到她的小角落，迅速打量了一眼。她很矮，最多五英尺三英寸，鞋尖也只是勉强碰到地板。头发呈浓郁酒红色，打理得令人钦佩。眉毛上方有着奇特的眼形纹路。衣着风格是商务休闲：优雅而且适用于各种场合。一根吸管闲适地夹在双唇间，通向装满汽水的细长玻璃杯；小巧耳机播放着陌生音乐，旋律在她周围飘荡。你不太确定她是否在看你，因为她的眼睛... 仿佛由星尘组成。

rows.original: Snapping back to reality, Jesse looks up from the glowing device on the table. “Ah, let me explain. Ordinarily, I would visit the premises of a client or clients and then our trade talks would take place. Buuut... space is, um,” she pauses, trying to choose her phrasing. “It’s much bigger than Earth, soooooooo I use stations as resting places. Currently, there’s a long running deal with varying levels of importance that’s being carried out on Vesperia. It’s years in the making and it might even take years to finish. However, the added neutrality of Canadia station helps smooth things over very gently.”
rows.translation: 杰西猛然回过神，从桌上发光装置前抬头。“啊，让我解释。通常，我会拜访一名或多名客户的办公地点，然后展开贸易谈判。但——是... 太空，呃，”她停下来斟酌措辞。“它比地球大得多，所——以——我会把空间站当作休息点。目前维斯佩里亚正在进行一项持续很久、重要性程度不断变化的交易。它已经筹备了数年，甚至可能还要几年才能结束。不过，加拿大站提供的额外中立性有助于非常平稳地协调各方。”

Currently, there’s a long running deal with varying levels of importance that’s being carried out on Vesperia. It’s years in the making and it might even take years to finish. However, the added neutrality of Canadia station helps smooth things over very gently.”"

I-I’m all ears, honest,” she replies, her face aimed at yours.

rows.original: Jesse is a 20-something year old human. She just about scrapes 5' 3" in height, generally shorter than the other inhabitants of Canadia station.

rows.raw: "Jesse is a 20-something year old human. She just about scrapes 5' 3\" in height, generally shorter than the other inhabitants of Canadia station."

rows.original: Currently, she’s sitting comfortably with her laptop and datapads in front of her. A few tall glasses of soda dot her table, all at varying degrees of fullness. She’s fairly immersed in what she’s doing: Earphones and the bluish glare of the screens her hold her attention.
rows.translation: 此刻，她舒适地坐着，笔记本电脑和数据板摆在面前。桌上散放着几只高脚汽水杯，剩余饮料多少不一。她颇为沉浸在手头工作中：耳机与屏幕的淡蓝光芒牢牢吸引着注意。

rows.original: Jesse is almost certainly female... you think. She acts and looks the part, but her voice is somewhat huskier than you’d expect from someone so short. Her shoulders are a little broad for a female human, and her hips and legs appear to be spaced slightly further apart than the average as well. Looking closer, you can see that certain parts of her bone structure are a little unusual too.
rows.translation: 杰西几乎肯定是女性...你想。她的言行和外表确实如此，不过声音比你想象中这种矮小身材的人略显低沉。以人类女性而言，她的肩膀稍宽，髋部和双腿之间的间距似乎也比平均水平更大。仔细观察，你还能看出她骨骼结构的某些部分略显异常。
rows.raw: "\n\nJesse is almost certainly female... you think. She acts and looks the part, but her voice is somewhat huskier than you’d expect from someone so short. Her shoulders are a little broad for a female human, and her hips and legs appear to be spaced slightly further apart than the average as well. Looking closer, you can see that certain parts of her bone structure are a little unusual too."

rows.original: Her visibly smooth, Terran skin is a pure, snow white. There doesn’t appear to be a single blemish or mark on it, not even a bluish vein. Her face is adorably feminine if slightly angular, much like a lithe elf or another fantastical higher being of Olde Earth legends. A pointed, fleshy tongue very occasionally slips out of her bare lips to lap up some soda. You’d say it was about 7" long. Her hair is a deep, rich wine-red and impeccably well kept: shoulder length, wavy and with a straight fringe that rests an inch above her thin eyebrows. Her hands and nails are similarly well-kept. Expertly applied, black eyeshadow emphasises her eyes. Speaking of...
rows.translation: 她明显光滑的泰拉皮肤洁白如雪，看不到任何瑕疵或痕迹，甚至连淡蓝血管都没有。她的脸蛋女性味十足，惹人喜爱，只是略显棱角，很像古代地球传说中身姿轻盈的精灵或其他奇幻高等生灵。一条尖尖的肉质舌头偶尔从裸露双唇间滑出，舔走一点汽水。你估计它长约7英寸。她的头发呈深邃浓郁的酒红色，保养得无可挑剔：齐肩、微卷，笔直刘海停在细眉上方一英寸处。她的双手和指甲也同样整洁。专业涂抹的黑色眼影衬托出双眼。说到眼睛...
rows.raw: '\n\nHer visibly smooth, Terran skin is a pure, snow white. There doesn’t appear to be a single blemish or mark on it, not even a bluish vein. Her face is adorably feminine if slightly angular, much like a lithe elf or another fantastical higher being of Olde Earth legends. A pointed, fleshy tongue very occasionally slips out of her bare lips to lap up some soda. You’d say it was about 7" long. Her hair is a deep, rich wine-red and impeccably well kept: shoulder length, wavy and with a straight fringe that rests an inch above her thin eyebrows. Her hands and nails are similarly well-kept. Expertly applied, black eyeshadow emphasises her eyes. Speaking of...'

rows.original: Jesse’s eyes are curious things. They seem to lack pupils until you really focus on their centers. They’re two orbs of a black and red blend, dotted with what seem to be minuscule, pale-red lights. They almost look like miniature star systems! You can never quite tell what she’s looking at.
rows.translation: 杰西的眼睛十分奇特。除非真正聚焦于中心，否则它们仿佛没有瞳孔。那是两颗黑红交融的球体，点缀着似乎极其细小的淡红光点。看起来简直像微型星系！你永远无法完全判断她在看什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nJesse’s eyes are curious things. They seem to lack pupils until you really focus on their centers. rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, music’s easy. They had something all the way back then called ‘classical score’: big, huge sounding stuff. Loads of hands and brains working together to make a big wall of just... sounds and color! I... I need a second.”"

rows.original: She slumps even further down, apparently having worked herself up by merely thinking about the music. Intrigued, you ask if she has any you can listen to. With a wide-eyed grin, Jesse hurriedly pulls out her earphones once more and hands them to you. Putting one to each [pc.ear], it takes a few seconds to adjust to their ‘one size fits all barely’ shapes. Nothing plays at first but a creeping, drawn out series of notes fades into your ears.
rows.translation: 她进一步瘫进椅子，显然仅仅想象那段音乐就让自己激动起来。你很感兴趣，问她是否有能让你听的曲目。杰西睁大双眼咧嘴笑着，再次匆忙取出耳机，递给你。你在[pc.ear]上各戴一只，花了几秒才适应那‘勉强适合所有人’的形状。起初没有声音，随后一串悄然逼近、绵延悠长的音符渐渐传入耳中。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe slumps even further down, apparently having worked herself up by merely thinking about the music. Intrigued, you ask if she has any you can listen to. With a wide-eyed grin, Jesse hurriedly pulls out her earphones once more and hands them to you. Putting one to each [pc.ear], it takes a few seconds to adjust to their ‘one size fits all barely’ shapes. Nothing plays at first but a creeping, drawn out series of notes fades into your ears."

rows.original: What happens next is a bit of a blur.
rows.translation: 接下来发生的事有些模糊。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat happens next is a bit of a blur."

rows.original: It seems to push and pull into so many different states of being, from crushing dissonance to bittersweet melodies. Some sort of stringed instrument plays a passionate solo piece, one that flows into a quiet, solemn plea to some ancient deity... and then, an angelic rapture opens up, closing the ensemble of chaos. It’s difficult to say what exactly just happened!
rows.translation: 它似乎在众多截然不同的状态间推拉摆荡，从压倒性的失谐，直至苦乐交织的旋律。某种弦乐器奏响激情独奏，随后流淌为向某位远古神明发出的安静肃穆祈求...接着，天使般的狂喜豁然绽放，为这场混沌合奏画下句点。很难说清刚才究竟发生了什么！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems to push and pull into so many different states of being, from crushing dissonance to bittersweet melodies. Some sort of stringed instrument plays a passionate solo piece, one that flows into a quiet, solemn plea to some ancient deity... and then, an angelic rapture opens up, closing the ensemble of chaos. It’s difficult to say what exactly just happened!"

rows.original: “It’s definitely... new to me. Or would that be old?” You say, half joking.
rows.translation: “对我来说绝对很... 新。还是说应该算旧？”你半开玩笑地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s definitely... new to me. Or would that be old?” You say, half joking."

rows.original: Jesse beams back at you, pleased that it made you feel something.
rows.translation: 杰西满面笑容地看着你，很高兴它让你产生了某种感受。
rows.raw: "\n\nJesse beams back at you, pleased that it made you feel something."

rows.original: “Did I just die and reincarnate again?!” You joke, laughing at the whole affair.
rows.translation: “我刚才是不是又死了一次、又转生了一次？!”你拿整件事开玩笑，笑出声来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did I just die and reincarnate again?!” You joke, laughing at the whole affair."

rows.original: Jesse giggles, apparently happy that you’re happy.
rows.translation: 杰西咯咯笑了起来，显然因你的快乐而开心。
rows.raw: "\n\nJesse giggles, apparently happy that you’re happy."

rows.original: “What in the universe was that?!” You say, bewildered.
rows.translation: “宇宙在上，那究竟是什么？!”你困惑地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What in the universe was that?!” You say, bewildered."

rows.original: “Such effrontery to decency and good taste...”
rows.translation: “这简直是对体面和高雅品味的冒犯...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Such effrontery to decency and good taste...”"

rows.original: Jesse smiles, covering her mouth with her hand to stifle a giggle.
rows.translation: 杰西微笑着，用手捂住嘴巴，压下咯咯笑声。
rows.raw: "\n\nJesse smiles, covering her mouth with her hand to stifle a giggle."

rows.original: “It’s madness, isn’t it? I love it, it completely takes me over,” she sighs adoringly, palms on her sternum again.
rows.translation: “简直疯狂，对不对？我喜欢它，它能完全将我占据，”她满怀爱意地叹道，双掌再次按在胸骨上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s madness, isn’t it? I love it, it completely takes me over,” she sighs adoringly, palms on her sternum again."

rows.original: What about those old Earth films? You ask her favourite.
rows.translation: 那些古代地球电影呢？你问起她最喜欢的一部。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat about those old Earth films? You ask her favourite."

rows.original: “O-oh, well there’s a ‘classic’, as they say. I-I think it is anyway,” she stammers, blushing somewhat. Is it something embarrassing? You prepare yourself to be indignantly dismissed again.
rows.translation: “哦、哦，嗯，有一部他们所说的‘经典’。我、我想它应该算吧，”她结巴着说，脸上泛起些许红晕。是什么令人难堪的东西吗？你做好了再次被她愤然赶走的准备。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, well there’s a ‘classic’, as they say. I-I think it is anyway,” she stammers, blushing somewhat. Is it something embarrassing? You prepare yourself to be indignantly dismissed again."

rows.original: “I-it’s called Assistant and it’s about a... personal assistant. I-it’s a kind of funny drama and there’s... a nice ending and... yeah,” she says slowly, definitely implying that it’s something embarrassing.
rows.translation: “它、它叫助理，讲的是一名...私人助理。那、那算是一部有趣的剧情片，而且有...一个美好的结局，还有...就这些，”她缓慢说道，明显暗示这里面有些令人难堪的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-it’s called Assistant and it’s about a... personal assistant. I-it’s a kind of funny drama and there’s... a nice ending and... yeah,” she says slowly, definitely implying that it’s something embarrassing."

rows.original: Narrowing your eyes, you probe her again: What does she like about the film?
rows.translation: 你眯起眼睛，再次追问：她究竟喜欢这部电影的什么地方？
rows.raw: "\n\nNarrowing your eyes, you probe her again: What does she like about the film?"

rows.original: “J-just the characters and what they do,” she half whispers, looking this way and that way while fidgeting with her hair. She’s really trying to dodge the subject. “I-I can send you a synopsis if you’d like it...”
rows.translation: “只、只是角色，还有他们做的事，”她近乎耳语地说着，一边摆弄头发，一边东张西望。她实在很努力地躲避这个话题。“如果你想看，我、我可以发一份剧情简介给你...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“J-just the characters and what they do,” she half whispers, looking this way and that way while fidgeting with her hair. She’s really trying to dodge the subject. “I-I can send you a synopsis if you’d like it...”"

rows.original: How about the whole thing? You suggest, seeing how far she’ll go.
rows.translation: 发整部电影怎么样？你提议道，想看看她愿意做到什么程度。
rows.raw: "\n\nHow about the whole thing? You suggest, seeing how far she’ll go."

rows.original: She timidly taps on the device but an alert beeps out from it.
rows.translation: 她胆怯地在设备上点了点，但设备随即发出一声警报。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe timidly taps on the device but an alert beeps out from it."

rows.original: “Ohh... apparently there’s a security lock on the data signature. I-I don’t think I can...”
rows.translation: “哦...数据签名上似乎有安全锁。我、我想自己没办法...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohh... apparently there’s a security lock on the data signature. I-I don’t think I can...”"

rows.original: Not to worry, you say. Accessing your Codex, you do a quick extranet search for the title in question. A notification pops up telling you that all available information on it has been stored to your Codex.
rows.translation: 你说不用担心。打开自己的宝典，你迅速在星网上搜索相关片名。一条通知弹出，告诉你所有可用信息都已存入宝典。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot to worry, you say. Accessing your Codex, you do a quick extranet search for the title in question. A notification pops up telling you that all available information on it has been stored to your Codex."

rows.original: You tell her you’ll give it a thorough looking over.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己会好好研究一番。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her you’ll give it a thorough looking over."

rows.original: “H-how did yo- what is... huh?” she tries to say, perplexed by your Codex.
rows.translation: “你、你怎么做——那是什么...啊？”她试图问道，对你的宝典感到困惑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“H-how did yo- what is... huh?” she tries to say, perplexed by your Codex."

rows.original: You tell her it’s
rows.translation: 你告诉她，这是
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her it’s "

rows.original: the wonders of based technomagic
rows.translation: 基准科技魔法的奇迹
rows.raw: "the wonders of based technomagic"

rows.original: a Steele secret
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔的秘密
rows.raw: "a Steele secret"

rows.original: . Jesse seems visibly enchanted by it all.
rows.translation: 。杰西显然被这一切迷住了。
rows.raw: ". Jesse seems visibly enchanted by it all."

rows.original: “I can only imagine if I had one of those for work...”
rows.translation: “我只能想象，要是工作时有一个那种东西...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can only imagine if I had one of those for work...”"

rows.original: (‘Assistant’ Codex entry unlocked!)
rows.translation: (已解锁‘助理’宝典条目！)
rows.raw: "\n\n(‘Assistant’ Codex entry unlocked!)"

rows.original: Assistant
rows.raw: "Assistant"

rows.original: Interests
rows.translation: 兴趣
rows.raw: "Interests"

rows.original: Interests
rows.translation: 兴趣
rows.raw: "Interests"

rows.original: You just talked about that.
rows.translation: 你们刚谈过这个。
rows.raw: "You just talked about that."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You ask her what work is actually like.
rows.translation: 你问她实际工作是什么样的。
rows.raw: "You ask her what work is actually like."

rows.original: “Ohh, nothing as exciting as your thing. Starts with a briefing by my boss and the other people on the team, then we meet with reps or act as reps for the companies in question. I take the minutes and talk about the relevant data while someone else negotiates alongside. Each deal is different but we’re usually successful,” states the prideful Jesse, resting her elbows on the table.
rows.translation: “哦——，完全没有你的事业那么刺激。首先听老板和团队里其他人做简报，然后我们与相关公司的代表会面，或者亲自担任代表。我负责记录会议纪要、介绍相关数据，同时由另一个人在旁谈判。每笔交易都不相同，但我们通常都能成功，”杰西骄傲地说道，双肘撑在桌上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohh, nothing as exciting as your thing. Starts with a briefing by my boss and the other people on the team, then we meet with reps or act as reps for the companies in question. I take the minutes and talk about the relevant data while someone else negotiates alongside. Each deal is different but we’re usually successful,” states the prideful Jesse, resting her elbows on the table."

rows.original: “Deals need neutrality on my part. I generally have to just be pleasant and accommodating. Sometimes, there’s a few hiccups and the deals need to be worked out privately. O-often I step in for one-on-ones or group deals that require uh... delicate persuasion.”
rows.translation: “在交易中，我需要保持中立。通常只要表现得友善随和即可。有时候会出些小问题，需要私下敲定交易。我、我经常参与一对一谈判或团体交易，它们需要，呃...比较细腻的说服。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Deals need neutrality on my part. I generally have to just be pleasant and accommodating. Sometimes, there’s a few hiccups and the deals need to be worked out privately. O-often I step in for one-on-ones or group deals that require uh... delicate persuasion.”"

rows.original: She visibly bites her lower lip, eyes wandering off into some corner of the room. Hmm...
rows.translation: 她明显咬住下唇，视线飘向房间某个角落。嗯...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe visibly bites her lower lip, eyes wandering off into some corner of the room. Hmm..."

rows.original: “A-and often these deals can be quite grueling to figure out, with so many different needs to be met. I-It’s somewhat tough being in a more male-oriented environment but I’m always congratulated on my um, ability a-and attentiveness,” Jesse quickly blurts out, apparently struggling to word it right. She shuffles around on her seat and her eyes appear to widen.
rows.translation: “而、而且这些交易往往很难理清，因为必须满足许多不同需求。在男性占主导的环境里工作有些艰难，不过大家总会称赞我的，嗯，能力和、和细致，”杰西飞快地脱口说道，显然正努力寻找正确措辞。她在座位上扭动，眼睛似乎睁得更大了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-and often these deals can be quite grueling to figure out, with so many different needs to be met. I-It’s somewhat tough being in a more male-oriented environment but I’m always congratulated on my um, ability a-and attentiveness,” Jesse quickly blurts out, apparently struggling to word it right. She shuffles around on her seat and her eyes appear to widen."

rows.original: “Something the matter, Jesse?” you ask coolly, resting your head on your hands. She’s definitely hiding something.
rows.translation: “出什么事了吗，杰西？”你冷静地问道，双手托住脑袋。她肯定隐瞒着什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something the matter, Jesse?” you ask coolly, resting your head on your hands. She’s definitely hiding something."

rows.original: “My my, someone seems frisky,” you verbally prod, a smirk on your face.
rows.translation: “哎呀呀，某人似乎欲火难耐了，”你用言语刺激她，脸上带着坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“My my, someone seems frisky,” you verbally prod, a smirk on your face."

rows.original: “Tell me what’s wrong,” you say sternly, your gaze focused on her eyes. Even though you can’t quite see the pupils, you sense she’s looking straight back at you.
rows.translation: “告诉我出了什么事，”你严厉地说道，目光紧盯她的双眼。虽然你看不清瞳孔，却感觉她正直直回望你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me what’s wrong,” you say sternly, your gaze focused on her eyes. Even though you can’t quite see the pupils, you sense she’s looking straight back at you."

rows.original: “Nothing’s wrong, honest,” she blurts out, her body visibly tensing up. She’s clearly lying about it, certainly the most dishonest thing she could do.
rows.translation: “什么事也没有，真的，”她脱口说道，身体明显绷紧。她显然在撒谎，这无疑是她能做出的最不诚实行为。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nothing’s wrong, honest,” she blurts out, her body visibly tensing up. She’s clearly lying about it, certainly the most dishonest thing she could do."

rows.original: “Are you sure? I’d be fine if something were,” you say with a smile, playing it calmly. She seems less agitated and more ‘excited’ by your questioning.
rows.translation: “你确定吗？真有事的话，我也不会介意，”你微笑着平静应对。面对你的追问，她似乎少了些焦躁，多了几分‘兴奋’。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you sure? I’d be fine if something were,” you say with a smile, playing it calmly. She seems less agitated and more ‘excited’ by your questioning."

rows.original: “So what, you enjoy lying to me?” you prod further, half joking but still keeping your eyes focused on her.
rows.translation: “所以呢，你喜欢对我撒谎？”你半开玩笑地进一步追问，双眼仍然紧盯着她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what, you enjoy lying to me?” you prod further, half joking but still keeping your eyes focused on her."

rows.original: “I get the impression that something is,” you say with firmness, tilting your head to the side with a furrowed brow.
rows.translation: “我觉得确实有事，”你语气坚定，皱眉歪着脑袋说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I get the impression that something is,” you say with firmness, tilting your head to the side with a furrowed brow."

rows.original: “Not, n-no, I-I’d never lie to [pc.name] Steele, my idol and a-all round nice person,” she says with an almost quivering voice. Something akin to a smile forms on her face but her lips waver around as you continue to look at her, her knees and thighs rubbing together under the table. She seems to be enjoying your accusatory tones...
rows.translation: “没、没有，我、我绝不会对[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我的偶像兼、兼全方位好人撒谎，”她声音几乎在发抖。某种类似笑容的表情浮上脸庞，可在你的持续注视下，她的嘴唇来回颤动，膝盖和大腿也在桌下相互摩擦。她似乎很享受你指控她的语气...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not, n-no, I-I’d never lie to [pc.name] Steele, my idol and a-all round nice person,” she says with an almost quivering voice. Something akin to a smile forms on her face but her lips waver around as you continue to look at her, her knees and thighs rubbing together under the table. She seems to be enjoying your accusatory tones..."

rows.original: “C-c-can we talk about something else? Please?”
rows.translation: “我、我、我们能换个话题吗？拜托？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“C-c-can we talk about something else? Please?”"

rows.original: You drop the probing... for now.
rows.translation: 你暂且停止追问...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou drop the probing... for now."

rows.original: Work
rows.translation: 工作
rows.raw: "Work"

rows.original: Work
rows.translation: 工作
rows.raw: "Work"

rows.original: You just talked about that.
rows.translation: 你们刚谈过这个。
rows.raw: "You just talked about that."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Having spent time with her and facing the somewhat confusing reactions she has to almost anything you talk to her about, now’s the time to actually get some answers from her. Plus, her signals to you have been just as confused...
rows.translation: 和她相处一段时间后，你面对她几乎对任何话题都会产生的迷惑反应，觉得现在该从她那里得到真正答案了。更何况，她向你发出的信号也同样混乱...
rows.raw: "Having spent time with her and facing the somewhat confusing reactions she has to almost anything you talk to her about, now’s the time to actually get some answers from her. Plus, her signals to you have been just as confused..."

rows.original: “I think I need to ask something,” you begin, leaning forward on the table a little.
rows.translation: “我想自己需要问件事，”你开口说道，身体略微前倾，靠在桌上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think I need to ask something,” you begin, leaning forward on the table a little."

rows.original: “You know, you’re a very confusing person,” you start, a cheeky grin on your face.
rows.translation: “你知道吗，你真是个令人迷惑的人，”你带着调皮笑容开口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know, you’re a very confusing person,” you start, a cheeky grin on your face."

rows.original: “Jesse, I need to be blunt with you,” you begin, acting like a tired board director.
rows.translation: “杰西，我需要跟你开门见山，”你像个疲惫的董事一样说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jesse, I need to be blunt with you,” you begin, acting like a tired board director."

rows.original: She timidly raises a hand. “I-if it’s okay, may I get a drink?”
rows.translation: 她怯生生地举起一只手。“如、如果可以，我能去拿杯饮料吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe timidly raises a hand. “I-if it’s okay, may I get a drink?”"

rows.original: You nod and she swiftly gets up and walks to the bar. Her movements are a little stiff but perhaps that’s to be expected. You see that her skirt is slightly shorter at the back than it is the front. Her skinny legs also have strange, red lines right up their middles, a similar shade to the markings on her forehead.
rows.translation: 你点点头，她迅速起身走向吧台。她的动作有些僵硬，不过也许这很正常。你看见她的裙子后侧比前侧稍短，纤瘦双腿正中还有一直向上的奇怪红线，颜色和额头上的印记相近。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and she swiftly gets up and walks to the bar. Her movements are a little stiff but perhaps that’s to be expected. You see that her skirt is slightly shorter at the back than it is the front. Her skinny legs also have strange, red lines right up their middles, a similar shade to the markings on her forehead."

rows.original: You muse over your Codex for a few seconds, reminding yourself of what that Olde Earth film was about.
rows.translation: 你对着宝典思索片刻，回忆那部古代地球电影讲的是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou muse over your Codex for a few seconds, reminding yourself of what that Olde Earth film was about."

rows.original: She’s back in no time however, a blue liquid in a thin glass in her dainty fingers. In a slightly awkward manner, she slides onto the soft leather chair. Without much hesitation, she takes a big glug of the blue drink, downing a third of it.
rows.translation: 不过她很快便回来了，纤细手指握着一只装有蓝色液体的窄玻璃杯。她略显笨拙地滑进柔软皮椅，毫不犹豫地大喝一口蓝色饮料，一下喝掉三分之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s back in no time however, a blue liquid in a thin glass in her dainty fingers. In a slightly awkward manner, she slides onto the soft leather chair. Without much hesitation, she takes a big glug of the blue drink, downing a third of it."

rows.original: “Ach this thing always burns. I must apologize,
rows.translation: “啊，这东西每次都这么烧。我必须道歉，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ach this thing always burns. I must apologize, "

rows.original: . I have to calm myself, I’ve got all these jitters going through me,” she says, holding out her hands. They seem to be slightly twitchy, as if she was frightened of this whole prospect.
rows.translation: 。我得让自己冷静，浑身都在紧张发颤，”她一边说，一边伸出双手。它们似乎在微微抽动，仿佛她害怕这整件事。
rows.raw: ". I have to calm myself, I’ve got all these jitters going through me,” she says, holding out her hands. They seem to be slightly twitchy, as if she was frightened of this whole prospect."

rows.original: You empathise, although still curious as to how quickly she emotionally ramps up. You ask once again if there’s something she’s not telling you.
rows.translation: 你表示理解，但仍对她情绪升温的速度感到好奇。你再次询问，她是否有事瞒着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou empathise, although still curious as to how quickly she emotionally ramps up. You ask once again if there’s something she’s not telling you."

rows.original: She shuffles a little in her seat, looking down to the floor.
rows.translation: 她在座位上挪动了一下，低头看向地板。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shuffles a little in her seat, looking down to the floor."

rows.original: “S-so... uh, I’m fairly certain the only reason I still have a job is because I do favours. For favours. Y-You know what I mean,” she says, a heavy note of shame coming through.

rows.translation: 示意，很快又一杯饮料出现在你面前。酒保朝你妩媚地眨眨眼，摇曳着走开去招呼满桌客人，让你们俩在吧台边基本独处。你啜饮时，枫的手搭在你的大腿上，那双蓝色大眼睛注视着你。你们隔着扭曲的杯壁对上视线，她的脸在你放下杯子、把注意力转向她之前的短暂一刻被拉伸变形。
rows.raw: ", and another drink quickly appears before you. The bartender gives you a flirty wink and sashays off to tend to a table full of customers, leaving the two of you more or less alone at the bar. Kaede’s hand rests on your thigh as you take a sip, watching you with those big blue eyes. You end up making eye contact through the distorted lens of the glass, her face stretched and warped for that brief moment before you set the glass down and turn your attentions to her."

rows.original: “Eh, it’s alright,” she answers with a shrug, finishing off her own drink with a sigh of relish. “Pretty stressful few days, though. It’s nice being in the core where I can, you know, actually relax for once. No pirates, no horrible space monsters... just cute ‘taur girls as far as the eye can see.”
rows.translation: “呃，还行吧，”她耸耸肩回答，惬意地叹息着喝完自己的酒。“不过这几天压力很大。能待在核心区真不错，你知道，我终于可以真正放松一次。没有海盗，没有可怕的太空怪物...放眼望去只有可爱的兽身姑娘。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh, it’s alright,” she answers with a shrug, finishing off her own drink with a sigh of relish. “Pretty stressful few days, though. It’s nice being in the core where I can, you know, actually relax for once. No pirates, no horrible space monsters... just cute ‘taur girls as far as the eye can see.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nThat right. She been dealing with a lot of pirates and monsters in the cargo lanes lately?"

rows.original: Kaede just laughs. “Yeah, actually. But that’s a long story... for when I’m not nearly this sober. Let’s just say I’m glad I invested in Talon’s defenses. But that’s not news to you, huh. I bet you deal with ten times worse, like, every day.”
rows.translation: 枫只是笑了。“对，还真是。不过那说来话长...等我没这么清醒的时候再讲吧。只能说，我很庆幸自己给利爪号的防御系统投了钱。但这对你来说不算新闻，对吧。我敢说你每天应付的事情要糟十倍。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKaede just laughs. “Yeah, actually. But that’s a long story... for when I’m not nearly this sober. Let’s just say I’m glad I invested in Talon’s defenses. But that’s not news to you, huh. I bet you deal with ten times worse, like, every day.”"

rows.translation: “而我更在意这杯苏格兰威士忌，”枫坏笑着向酒保示意。眨眼间，她的酒便换成了满杯，她开始喝起来...丝毫没有要回答你问题的意思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I am much more interested in this scotch,” Kaede smirks, motioning to the bartender. Her drink is replaced in the blink of an eye, and she starts drinking... and gives absolutely no sign of actually answering your queries."

rows.original: “Good. Real good,” she answers. “Cass says if I’m going to be hanging out here a while, she might start swinging her regular route over towards Vesperia so we can hang out. Man, I can’t imagine actually getting to live with those two for... even a few days. Exciting!
rows.translation: “很好。真的很好，”她答道。“卡丝说，如果我要在这里待上一阵子，她可能会开始把固定航线绕到维斯佩里亚来，这样我们就能聚聚。天啊，我简直无法想象真的能和她们俩一起生活...哪怕只有几天。太令人兴奋了！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good. Real good,” she answers. “Cass says if I’m going to be hanging out here a while, she might start swinging her regular route over towards Vesperia so we can hang out. Man, I can’t imagine actually getting to live with those two for... even a few days. Exciting!"

Anyway, Ethan’s a teacher down at the university. Anno put me in touch with him a while ago, and he’s doing some work for me on the side.”

Anyway, Ethan’s a teacher down at the university. Anno put me in touch with him a while ago, and he’s doing some work for me on the side.”"

rows.original: “Work? Like what?”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Work? Like what?”"

rows.original: “He works in artificial intelligence, see, so I asked him to take a look at Talon’s onboard intelligence. We, uh, I’ve been having some... uh, problems... with it. So I’m waiting around while he pokes around in my ship’s brainmeats down on the surface.”
rows.translation: “你看，他研究人工智能，所以我请他检查一下利爪号的舰载智能。我们，呃，我最近一直和它有些...呃，问题...所以他在下面地表上翻查我飞船的脑子时，我就在这里等。”

I don’t know if it’s corruption or just someone putting weird stuff in there when sh - it - was made. I just want Ethan to pick around in the code and see what’s up. At least tell me why things are like they are.”
rows.translation: “哦，没什么好担心的。只是出现了一些...我猜，是奇怪的程序。不该存在的例程之类。我不知道这是数据损坏，还是它被制造时有人往里面塞了怪东西。我只想让伊森翻翻代码，看看究竟怎么回事。至少告诉我为什么会这样。”

rows.original: Kaede shrugs lightly. “I dunno, I’ve only been down to the planet’s surface a couple of times, and I’ve almost never done work out here. You know, this deep in the core it’s almost all big-dog cargo haulers and corporate ships doing the shipping. Real hard to get any contracts in well-settled, safe systems like this, you know?”
rows.translation: 枫轻轻耸肩。“不知道，我只去过几次行星地表，而且几乎没在这里干过活。你知道，核心区这么深的地方，货运几乎都由大型货船和企业飞船承包了。在这种开发成熟又安全的星系里，真的很难拿到合同，懂吧？”

rows.original: “Yeah, that’s true. It was beautiful when I was down on the surface, and full of cute four-legged babes to boot. It’s just hard to find something interesting to say about an actually... nice place to live. Most of the Rush-worlds I’ve been to have been scary and weird, but Vesperia’s been settled for thousands of years. Like, before humanity’s First Contact with the ausar. Kinda puts things in perspective, huh? I wonder how long this station’s been around... doesn’t feel that old, but who knows. Just feels cozy to me.”
rows.translation: “对，那倒是真的。我下到地表时，那里很漂亮，而且到处都是可爱的四足宝贝。只是，一个真正...适合生活的好地方，很难找出什么有趣的话题。我去过的大多数大开发星球都既吓人又古怪，但维斯佩里亚已经有人定居数千年了。比如说，早在人类与奥萨第一次接触之前。想想还挺让人感慨，对吧？不知道这座空间站存在多久了...感觉没那么古老，但谁知道呢。反正我觉得很舒适。”

rows.original: Rolling her eyes, the chubby kui-tan quips, “Most people aren’t me. Most people won’t scrimp and save. Most people will take extensions to eat better food or wear better clothes. Most people don’t have discipline.” Kally thumps her fist on the bar for emphasis. “I did my job, and I did it damned well - well enough to earn an upward adjustment on my contract pay rate. That’s one of the nice things about Vesperia; they have some really strict rules about compensating indentured servants fairly. It’s why I made sure I wound up here.”

Got a few promotions along the way, saving every cred. At the time, I wanted a ship to call my own. Figured I’d see the galaxy, like my little sister was doing.” She shrugs. “Then I started learning how to bartend.” Her tail wiggles happily. “Nobody ever told me how fun it was. It makes people just as happy or happier than cooking with way, wayyyyy less effort. And I get to hang out with my customers while I do it.”

rows.original: [flags.MAGS_MET |[var0 |“Hey [pc.name]!” Mags gives her feathers one last good preen before jumping to her feet. “Need repairs?” |“Hey [pc.name]!” Mags gives her feathers one last good preen before jumping to her feet. “Need repairs?” |“H-hey [pc.mf |sir |ma’am ].” Mags tries to hide her shivery excitement as you approach her. She would make for a terrible, terrible poker player. “Need — need something?” ] |“Hey! Hello!” The mechanic gets up quickly when you approach her, knocking over a case of tools with a loud crash as she does so. She freezes and stares at them for a split second, then shoots her golden yellow eyes back to you and continues talking rapidly. “I’m Mags! Well, you can call me Mags. If you want. I’m the mechanic for this loading bay. If you need repairs, just come to me. Uh... I mean, welcome to Canadia Station!” She laughs. It sounds a bit like someone falling down a flight of stairs. “So uhhh yeah, repairs. Courtesy of Pyrite. Well not really courtesy, you gotta pay. Sorry!” You blink a couple of times, and take her in properly. The girl’s arms are half-arm, half-wing: great, black fans of feathers fold back from her elbows and wrists, which are plated in pale yellow horn, as are her hands, which end in sharp-looking talons. If you were to subtract these and her hawkish eyes, you’d be looking at a slim human, one that you’d assume listens to death metal: she has pale skin and black hair, black lipstick and eyeliner, as well as a studded leather collar. It’s an aesthetic that usually exudes a certain amount of confidence and spikiness. Mags wrings her talon-hands, eyes flitting between you, your ship and the exit. “Are you ok? Do you need medical assistance? I can’t help you with that. Well I mean Pyrite do teach you CPR and stuff as part of emergency training, but I mean I can’t do it legally hahaha!” ]
rows.translation: [flags.MAGS_MET |[var0 |“嘿，[pc.name]！”玛格斯最后仔细梳理了一遍羽毛，随即跳起来站好。“需要维修吗？” |“嘿，[pc.name]！”玛格斯最后仔细梳理了一遍羽毛，随即跳起来站好。“需要维修吗？” |“你、你好，[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]。”你走近时，玛格斯竭力掩饰自己兴奋得发抖的样子。她绝对会成为一个糟糕透顶的扑克玩家。“需、需要什么吗？” ] |“嘿！你好！” 你朝她走近时，这名机械师匆忙站起来，动作间撞翻了一箱工具，发出一声巨响。她僵住身体，盯着那些工具看了片刻，随后金黄色的双眼猛地转回你身上，继续飞快说个不停。 “我是玛格斯！嗯，你可以叫我玛格斯。只要你愿意。我是这座装卸平台的机械师。需要维修就来找我。呃...我是说，欢迎来到卡纳迪亚站！”她笑了起来，听着有点像某人从一段楼梯上滚了下去。“所以，呃，对，维修。由黄铁矿工业提供服务。其实也不能说提供，你得付钱。抱歉！” 你眨了几下眼睛，认真打量起她。少女的双臂半是手臂、半是翅膀：大片黑色扇形羽毛从肘部与腕部向后折叠；她的手臂覆盖着淡黄色角质鳞片，双手也是如此，末端长着看似锋利的爪子。若去掉这些特征和鹰隼般的双眼，她看起来就是个身材纤细的人类，而且你大概会猜她爱听死亡金属：她皮肤苍白，一头黑发，涂着黑色口红和眼线，还戴着一圈镶钉皮项圈。这种审美通常会散发出几分自信和尖锐的气息。 玛格斯绞着长爪般的双手，目光在你、你的飞船与出口之间来回游移。 “你还好吗？需要医疗救助吗？那个我帮不了你。嗯，我是说，黄铁矿工业确实会在应急培训里教心肺复苏之类的，但我是说，我不能合法地替你做，哈哈哈！” ]

rows.original:
is a 5' 5" bird girl. She’s a Pyrite ship mechanic liaised to the dock you’ve been assigned on Canadia. If you want repairs while you’re here, she’s your bird.
	
	She’s dressed in the trademark dark red Pyrite jumpsuit, figure-hugging but reinforced and insulated for serious astro-mechanical work. The suit has to be open at the shoulder, though, to allow her wing arms space. Her wings appear like great sleeves of black feathers, hanging off of her slender, horn-scaled arms; towards her hands these fluttery, fluffy feathers are as long as picket fence posts, quite remarkable to look at. When she has her pale yellow claw-hands facing forwards the wings are folded backwards, like a sort of cloak.
	
	You suppose on another being such big black wings might appear quite sinister, and
rows.translation:
是一名身高5英尺5英寸的鸟女。她是黄铁矿工业派驻到卡纳迪亚站、负责你所属泊位的飞船机械师。你在这里若需要维修，找她准没错。
	
	她身穿黄铁矿工业标志性的暗红色连体工作服，衣料紧贴身形，却也为严肃的航天机械作业做了加固和绝缘处理。不过，为了给翼臂留出空间，工作服肩部必须敞开。她的翅膀就像两只由黑色羽毛织成的巨大袖子，垂挂在覆盖着角质鳞片的纤细双臂上；越靠近手掌，这些轻柔蓬松的羽毛便越长，最长足有栅栏桩一般，外观相当醒目。当她把淡黄色的爪手朝向前方时，翅膀会向后折叠，宛如一件披风。

rows.original: So, Mags is an unusual name. “Oh! Well. It’s not really my name. Well it sort of is, because it’s what everyone calls me around here hahaha!” With a small smile she opens her arms, which by extension opens her wings, spreading those fans of black feathers outward to their fullest extent. It’s surprising, even alarming, how wide and dark a canopy this slight girl has concealed beneath her pits most of the time. “When I first started working here, everyone called me Raven cuz of these. Well, that was...” She rolls her eyes. “Super lame and obvious, right? Small world goth, calling herself Raven. Gimme a break. So one of the Nook bar staff started calling me Magpie instead. And that, well...” she smiles shyly. “Kinda small, likes shiny stuff, got the, the white bits going on. So yeah, yeah, I didn’t mind that.” What’s her real name? “Heidi. Flood. Heidi Flood. You can call me that if you like. I don’t — I just prefer Mags here if that’s alright hahaha!” And what’s the small world she calls home? “Alenoko. Not a world actually, a moon, over Kaspar IV, gas giant. I just said small world because, uh, you know, the saying...” She preens her feathers awkwardly. “It was terraformed by the TSC during the last Rush, latest cloud seeding and evo-surge bio-engineering, big success story! Apparently. Some of the trees and bugs got way too big, not as easy to farm as they thought. They brought some New Texans in to speed up the colonizing efforts.” Is she of New Texan stock? “Hahaha no! Look at me hahaha! My parents come from Mars, they’re just regular dumb old humans.” Again she strokes her feathers — a calming, soothing action. “I had plenty of half-cows, half-bulls as neighbours, though. Very. Very direct people.”

rows.original: So how did she come to be a mechanic on this station? “I’ve always been interested in taking things apart and putting them back together again,” Mags replies. “I find it weird other people don’t. Don’t you want to know how something works hahaha? I used to help my dad with our old Pegasus B3 in the garage, and he encouraged me to keep going with it and I got an apprenticeship with Pyrite because they were doing a mega recruitment drive because of the Rush and now here I am.” Did she choose Canadia, or was she simply assigned here? “Uhm.” This question seems to embarrass her, for some reason. Her face goes a little pink, and her eyes go wandering. “Pyrite show you the stations and planets they have vacancies, and they take your preference into consideration when they assign you... I did say Vesperia was my first preference, yeah. The surface reminded me of home a bit I guess and uh, the people a bit I guess. They’re so friendly hahaha! I’ve made a lot of friends hahaha!”

rows.original: “Me again, huh? Am I really that interesting?” Mitch muses with a gentle smile, before tapping [mitch.hisHer] mug in thought. “Alright, where did I start again? Mmmm, Ah right, the beginning,” the kitsune murmurs, before clearing [mitch.hisHer] throat as [mitch.heShe] prepares to speak.

rows.original: Mitch stiffens, [mitch.hisHer] cyan eyes widening quickly in surprise before lowering to stare at the mug below. “Well, now that’s quite the forward request. No one has really asked about me before; where would I even begin?”
rows.translation: 米奇僵住了，[mitch.hisHer]青色双眼惊讶地迅速睁大，随后又垂下来盯着下面的杯子。“这个请求还真是够直接的。以前还真没人问过关于我的事情；我该从哪里讲起呢？”

rows.original: “I suppose my journey began before I was even born,” Mitch begins. “Sionach have issues getting pregnant, you see, and my mother wanted nothing more than a child of her own to love and raise. She was forced to go through great lengths just to conceive, eventually forcing her to seek out extensive medical aid to combat our species’ peculiar quirks. Even with their help she only barely managed, and in the end, I was the result.”
rows.translation: “我想，我的旅程甚至在自己出生前就已经开始了，”米奇说道。“你瞧，西奥纳克很难怀孕，而我的母亲最大的愿望就是拥有一个属于自己的孩子去爱护和抚养。为了受孕，她不得不付出巨大努力，最后甚至只能寻求广泛的医疗援助，以克服我们种族特有的生理问题。即使有他们的帮助，她也只是勉强成功，而最终的结果就是我。”

She was forced to go through great lengths just to conceive, eventually forcing her to seek out extensive medical aid to combat our species’ peculiar quirks. Even with their help she only barely managed, and in the end, I was the result.”"

rows.original: The fox stops briefly, a smile creeping along [mitch.hisHer] lips before [mitch.heShe] continues. “She loved me dearly, dare I say even more so than most mothers love their children. I was her one and only, her first and possibly last, and nothing would keep her apart from me. She barely left me alone when I was growing up, even during school! She’d follow me into classrooms, the cafeteria, the gym. It was quite embarrassing once I started nearing adulthood!” Mitch chuckles, though you spot a soft yearning in the fox’s eyes after it ends.
rows.translation: 狐狸短暂停下，[mitch.hisHer]唇边浮现一抹微笑，随后[mitch.heShe]继续说道。“她深深地爱着我，我甚至敢说，她爱我的程度远超大多数母亲对孩子的爱。我是她唯一的孩子，是她的第一个，也可能是最后一个；没有任何事能让她和我分开。小时候，她几乎从不让我独处，就连上学时也一样！她会跟着我走进教室、食堂和体育馆。等我开始接近成年时，那可真够尴尬的！”米奇轻笑起来，不过笑声结束后，你从狐狸眼中看出了一丝温柔的思念。

I was her one and only, her first and possibly last, and nothing would keep her apart from me. She barely left me alone when I was growing up, even during school! She’d follow me into classrooms, the cafeteria, the gym. It was quite embarrassing once I started nearing adulthood!” Mitch chuckles, though you spot a soft yearning in the fox’s eyes after it ends."

rows.original: “After my schooling was finished, I gathered up enough credits to strike out on my own. Mom was absolutely heartbroken at it, but she also fully understood. I couldn’t grow as an individual with her hovering over me all the time, and she couldn’t feasibly protect me forever.” Mitch sighs, fingers twiddling the mug in [mitch.hisHer] hands. “It was hard, for the both of us. She suffered without the company of her one and only child, and I quickly found myself lost and utterly confused in the sheer vastness of space. I managed by finding odd jobs here and there, sometimes as a morale officer and other times as a technician. Few people had a need for my very specific expertise in psychology though, and I was nearly on the verge of heading home with my metaphorical tail between my legs. It was around then that a friend invited me to work on New Texas.”
rows.translation: “完成学业后，我攒够了信用点，开始独自闯荡。妈妈为此伤透了心，但她也完全理解。她一直在身边照看我，我就无法成长为独立的人，而她也不可能永远保护我。”米奇叹了口气，手指拨弄着[mitch.hisHer]手中的杯子。“这对我们两人都很艰难。她失去了唯一孩子的陪伴，而我很快就在广袤无垠的太空中迷失了方向，完全不知所措。我靠着四处打零工撑了下来，有时担任士气官，有时做技术员。不过几乎没有人需要我这种极为专门的心理学知识，我差点就要夹着比喻意义上的尾巴回家了。大约就在那时，一位朋友邀请我去新得克萨斯工作。”

Few people had a need for my very specific expertise in psychology though, and I was nearly on the verge of heading home with my metaphorical tail between my legs. It was around then that a friend invited me to work on New Texas.”"

rows.original: Mitch pauses to reminiscence, a more content smile growing before [mitch.heShe] continues. “New Texas. What a wonderful world it is. Working there wasn’t at all what I had originally trained for, but the folks there were just so inviting and caring that I couldn’t say no.” Mitch smiles dreamily, the purple fox wearing a visage of pure wistful yearning and reminiscence.
rows.translation: 米奇停下来回忆，脸上的满足笑容越发明显，随后[mitch.heShe]继续说道。“新得克萨斯。那真是个美妙的世界。在那里做的工作，完全不是我原本接受训练要从事的职业，但当地人实在太热情、太体贴了，让我根本无法拒绝。”米奇如痴如醉地笑着，这只紫色狐狸脸上满是纯粹的向往与追忆。

rows.original: “I absolutely loved it there, for a time at least. I loved living and working in and around the farm buildings, and I loved breathing in the never ending fresh air as I hauled bottles from barn to barn. Whenever it rained, I’d find myself a pile of hay to curl up in and nap while it pummeled against the barn roof. It was perfect. Like it was made to be inviting specifically for Me.” Mitch’s smile lingers at the memory, before the dreamy visage suddenly molds into one of sorrow.
rows.translation: “至少有一段时间，我真的非常喜欢那里。我喜欢在农场建筑里和周围生活、工作，也喜欢在谷仓之间搬运瓶子时，呼吸永远清新的空气。每逢下雨，我都会找一堆干草蜷缩在里面打盹，听雨点猛烈敲打谷仓屋顶。那里堪称完美，仿佛是专门为了欢迎我而建造的。”回忆起这段往事时，米奇脸上的笑容久久不散，随后那副梦幻的神情突然转变成悲伤。

I loved living and working in and around the farm buildings, and I loved breathing in the never ending fresh air as I hauled bottles from barn to barn. Whenever it rained, I’d find myself a pile of hay to curl up in and nap while it pummeled against the barn roof. It was perfect. Like it was made to be inviting specifically for Me.” Mitch’s smile lingers at the memory, before the dreamy visage suddenly molds into one of sorrow."

rows.original: “I couldn’t stay though. I wanted so badly to, but witnessing first-hand what the Treatment does to people day after day was just too much to bear. Watching it change others into pheromone-producing, sex-loving beasts isn’t the problem, it’s what it does to their minds. They just become so mentally weak, so vulnerable to suggestion and conditioning that it almost makes me sick!” Mitch growls. The sudden, aggressive change in the otherwise kind fox is startling enough to make you flinch, but the therapist is suddenly just as calm as [mitch.heShe] was before. [mitch.HeShe] moves on.
rows.translation: “不过我没法留下。我非常想留下，但日复一日亲眼见证改造对人们造成的影响，实在让我无法承受。看着它把别人变成分泌信息素、热爱性爱的野兽并不是问题，真正的问题是它对他们的心智做了什么。他们的精神会变得无比脆弱，极易受到暗示和调教，几乎令我感到恶心！”米奇低声咆哮。平时善良的狐狸骤然变得如此凶狠，惊得你缩了一下；但治疗师转眼间又恢复到[mitch.heShe]先前那般平静。[mitch.HeShe]继续说了下去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I couldn’t stay though. I wanted so badly to, but witnessing first-hand what the Treatment does to people day after day was just too much to bear. Watching it change others into pheromone-producing, sex-loving beasts isn’t the problem, it’s what it does to their minds. They just become so mentally weak, so vulnerable to suggestion and conditioning that it almost makes me sick!” Mitch growls. The sudden, aggressive change in the otherwise kind fox is startling enough to make you flinch, but the therapist is suddenly just as calm as [mitch.heShe] was before. [mitch.HeShe] moves on."

rows.original: “Some of them end up faring better than others of course, managing to keep their mental facilities intact while only earning a few subconscious quirks. The majority, however, have their minds molded to be ever jubilant, carefree, and just painfully simple. Simple enough that someone willing to put in any effort towards mental entrapment could just whisk them away. I just can’t understand why anyone would willingly do that to themselves.” Mitch’s eyes turn toward you, as if searching you for some input.
rows.translation: “当然，其中有些人的情况会比其他人好，能够保持完整的心智能力，只在潜意识里多出一些怪癖。然而，大多数人的心智都会被塑造成永远兴高采烈、无忧无虑，而且单纯得令人痛心的模样。单纯到任何愿意费点心思设下精神圈套的人，都能轻易把他们带走。我就是无法理解，为什么会有人自愿对自己做这种事。”米奇的目光转向你，似乎想从你这里寻求某种回应。

rows.original: It takes Mitch some time to recollect [mitch.hisHer] thoughts, their eyes leaving yours to stare down at the mug in [mitch.hisHer] hands before continuing. “I made credits working the barns long enough to eventually take my leave. I stayed briefly aboard a transport ship to get my bearings, and then I managed to find a relatively cheap location here to open up a therapy business. It’s noisier here than I’d prefer, and charity work only pays so much, but I manage, and I have my ways of avoiding trouble if it happens to cross my path.” Mitch eyes the now-empty mug, a soft tut escaping [mitch.hisHer] lips before [mitch.heShe] shifts under the desk. It gives you a somewhat shameless view of Mitch’s suit clad rump and the many, wriggly tails above it. You’re almost tempted to reach out and stroke the fluffy, plum appendages, before Mitch pops back up to set the newly refilled receptacle onto the desk.
rows.translation: 米奇花了一些时间整理[mitch.hisHer]思绪；那双眼睛从你身上移开，低头盯着[mitch.hisHer]手里的杯子，随后才继续。“我在谷仓工作了很久，终于赚够信用点离开。我曾在一艘运输船上短暂停留，以便弄清今后的方向，之后设法在这里找到一个相对便宜的地点，开办了心理治疗业务。这里比我喜欢的环境更加吵闹，慈善工作带来的收入也很有限，但我还能维持下去；如果麻烦找上门，我也有自己的办法避开。”米奇看了看已经空掉的杯子，[mitch.hisHer]唇间发出轻轻的咂舌声，随后[mitch.heShe]在桌子下面挪动身体。这让你毫无遮拦地看到米奇被紧身服包裹的臀部，以及上方许多条扭动的尾巴。你几乎忍不住想伸手抚摸那些蓬松、丰满的附肢；但米奇很快重新冒出来，把刚刚续满的容器放回桌面。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes Mitch some time to recollect [mitch.hisHer] thoughts, their eyes leaving yours to stare down at the mug in [mitch.hisHer] hands before continuing. “I made credits working the barns long enough to eventually take my leave. I stayed briefly aboard a transport ship to get my bearings, and then I managed to find a relatively cheap location here to open up a therapy business. It’s noisier here than I’d prefer, and charity work only pays so much, but I manage, and I have my ways of avoiding trouble if it happens to cross my path.” Mitch eyes the now-empty mug, a soft tut escaping [mitch.hisHer] lips before [mitch.heShe] shifts under the desk. It gives you a somewhat shameless view of Mitch’s suit clad rump and the many, wriggly tails above it. You’re almost tempted to reach out and stroke the fluffy, plum appendages, before Mitch pops back up to set the newly refilled receptacle onto the desk."

rows.original: “Well, that’s my story; the majority of it, at least. Now is there anything else you wish to ask?” The kitsune smiles, flicking an ear as [mitch.heShe] waits for your next question.
rows.translation: “好了，这就是我的故事；至少是其中的大部分。现在你还有什么想问的吗？”狐妖微笑着，抖了抖一只耳朵，而[mitch.heShe]正在等待你的下一个问题。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, that’s my story; the majority of it, at least. Now is there anything else you wish to ask?” The kitsune smiles, flicking an ear as [mitch.heShe] waits for your next question."

rows.original: “Hun,” you murmur, shifting about in worry. “You okay? You’re like, not looking so hot.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，”你担忧地动了动。“你还好吗？你的脸色看起来不太妙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hun,” you murmur, shifting about in worry. “You okay? You’re like, not looking so hot.”"

rows.original: “Hey,” you rumble, eyeing them in worry. “You feeling alright, champ?”
rows.translation: “嘿，”你担忧地打量着他们，低声说道。“你还好吗，伙计？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” you rumble, eyeing them in worry. “You feeling alright, champ?”"

rows.original: “Mitch,” you start, briefly pausing in hesitation before continuing. “Are you alright?”
rows.translation: “米奇，”你开口道，犹豫片刻后才继续。“你还好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mitch,” you start, briefly pausing in hesitation before continuing. “Are you alright?”"

rows.original: The whiskered therapist eyes you curiously, his clawed fingers playing along the sides of the coffee mug as [mitch.heShe] warmly smiles. “Why of course I am, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 长着胡须的治疗师好奇地打量着你；[mitch.heShe]温暖微笑时，长着利爪的手指沿咖啡杯两侧轻轻拨弄。“当然没事，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe whiskered therapist eyes you curiously, his clawed fingers playing along the sides of the coffee mug as [mitch.heShe] warmly smiles. “Why of course I am, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: [pc.kmhbb |“Something is still troubling you though, isn’t it?” you gently press, eyeing him with worry. |“Ah-uh. You might be able to fool your other patients, but you’re not fooling me.” you retort, waggling a finger playfully at the fox. |You scowl at the false answer. “No, you’re not. Something’s clearly been bothering you, and I want to know what it is.” |You shake your head firmly. “That smile ain’t reaching your eyes, cutie. What’s wrong?” |You shake your head at the fox’s response. “I don’t buy it. Tell me.” ]
rows.translation: [pc.kmhbb |“不过还是有事情困扰着你，对吧？”你担忧地看着他，温和地追问。 |“啊哈。你或许骗得过其他病人，但骗不过我。”你反驳道，顽皮地朝狐狸摇了摇手指。 |你对这个虚假的回答皱起眉头。“不，你并不好。显然有什么事情一直在困扰你，而我想知道那是什么。” |你坚定地朝狐狸摇了摇头。“小可爱，那笑意根本没到你的眼睛里。怎么了？” |听到狐狸的回答，你摇了摇头。“我不信。告诉我。” ]
rows.raw: " [pc.kmhbb |“Something is still troubling you though, isn’t it?” you gently press, eyeing him with worry. |“Ah-uh. You might be able to fool your other patients, but you’re not fooling me.” you retort, waggling a finger playfully at the fox. |You scowl at the false answer. “No, you’re not. Something’s clearly been bothering you, and I want to know what it is.” |You shake your head firmly. “That smile ain’t reaching your eyes, cutie. What’s wrong?” |You shake your head at the fox’s response. “I don’t buy it. Tell me.” ]"

rows.original: Mitch’s ears lower as his smile fades, like a naughty pet who’s just been caught red-handed. “Dammit, I just,” Mitch mumbles, before sighing. “Alright, fine. Something has been bothering me, for quite awhile even.”
rows.translation: 米奇的耳朵垂了下来，笑容随之消失，像只干坏事时被抓个正着的宠物。“该死，我只是，”米奇喃喃说道，随后叹了口气。“好吧，行。确实有件事一直困扰着我，甚至已经持续很久了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch’s ears lower as his smile fades, like a naughty pet who’s just been caught red-handed. “Dammit, I just,” Mitch mumbles, before sighing. “Alright, fine. Something has been bothering me, for quite awhile even.”"

rows.original: You figured as much. You also hazard a guess that it has something to do with the kitsune’s sexual equipment, a hunch that you openly state to the shifting fox.
rows.translation: 你也猜到了。你还推测这与狐妖的性器官有关，并把这个猜想直接告诉了那只不断变换形态的狐狸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou figured as much. You also hazard a guess that it has something to do with the kitsune’s sexual equipment, a hunch that you openly state to the shifting fox."

rows.original: “I-it’s that obvious, is it?” Mitch stammers, staring down dejected at the mug in his hands. “I’ve tried my best to hide it, and yet I’m sure you’re not the only one to have noticed. No one has ever actually approached me about it, though.”
rows.translation: “有、有那么明显吗？”米奇结巴着，沮丧地低头盯着手中的杯子。“我已经尽全力掩饰了，但我敢肯定，注意到的人不只你一个。不过以前从来没有人真的来问过我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-it’s that obvious, is it?” Mitch stammers, staring down dejected at the mug in his hands. “I’ve tried my best to hide it, and yet I’m sure you’re not the only one to have noticed. No one has ever actually approached me about it, though.”"

rows.original: “If something like this is bothering you so much, then maybe you should be finding someone to help you through it.” you remark. “Even a therapist needs therapy every now and then.”
rows.translation: “既然这种事让你如此困扰，也许你应该找个人帮你一起渡过难关。”你说道。“就连治疗师也偶尔需要接受治疗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If something like this is bothering you so much, then maybe you should be finding someone to help you through it.” you remark. “Even a therapist needs therapy every now and then.”"

rows.original: Mitch stares silently at the mug before glancing up at you. “I should be, but I’m just so busy that I don’t have time. Besides, I don’t want to search for another therapist over something so silly.”
rows.translation: 米奇默默盯着杯子，随后抬眼看向你。“确实应该，但我实在太忙了，根本没有时间。而且，我也不想为了这种小事去另找一位治疗师。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch stares silently at the mug before glancing up at you. “I should be, but I’m just so busy that I don’t have time. Besides, I don’t want to search for another therapist over something so silly.”"

rows.original: “Well, you don’t have to look far now.” you firmly assert. “Because I’m here. Now tell Dr. Steele what’s wrong.”
rows.translation: “好吧，现在你不用费心去找了。”你斩钉截铁地说道。“因为我就在这里。现在告诉斯蒂尔医生，究竟出了什么问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you don’t have to look far now.” you firmly assert. “Because I’m here. Now tell Dr. Steele what’s wrong.”"

rows.original: Mitch blinks in surprise, frozen in his seat before snorting out in disbelief. “Y-you? I wasn’t aware that you had a doctorate in psychology.”
rows.translation: 米奇惊讶地眨眨眼，僵在座位上，随后难以置信地哼笑起来。“你、你？我可不知道你还有心理学博士学位。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch blinks in surprise, frozen in his seat before snorting out in disbelief. “Y-you? I wasn’t aware that you had a doctorate in psychology.”"

rows.original: “Maybe I do, maybe I don’t.” you retort. “But I’m not leaving this office until we work out what’s wrong. Together.”
rows.translation: “也许有，也许没有。”你反驳道。“但在我们一起弄清问题之前，我不会离开这间办公室。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe I do, maybe I don’t.” you retort. “But I’m not leaving this office until we work out what’s wrong. Together.”"

rows.original: The therapist continues to stare skeptically, though soon begins to fidget and waver under your steady, unyielding gaze. Seconds tick by, the silence broken only by the sound of fur against fur as the vulpine’s numerous tails squirm with ever increasing speed. You patiently wait, giving Mitch all the time needed until he’s ready to confide his problem.
rows.translation: 治疗师仍满脸怀疑地盯着你，但很快就在你沉稳而毫不退让的注视下坐立不安、开始动摇。时间一秒秒过去，打破沉默的只有毛发彼此摩擦的声音；狐狸的许多条尾巴正以越来越快的速度扭动。你耐心等待，给米奇所需的全部时间，直到他准备好吐露自己的问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe therapist continues to stare skeptically, though soon begins to fidget and waver under your steady, unyielding gaze. Seconds tick by, the silence broken only by the sound of fur against fur as the vulpine’s numerous tails squirm with ever increasing speed. You patiently wait, giving Mitch all the time needed until he’s ready to confide his problem."

rows.original: “It’s, it’s about my, m-my, my thing.” Mitch eventually stammers, hands pressing down into his lap for emphasis. “I don’t feel like it’s really mine, and, I hate it because of it.”
rows.translation: “是，是关于我的，我的那个，那个东西。”米奇终于结结巴巴地说道，双手用力按在大腿间，以此强调自己的意思。“我觉得它根本不属于我，也正因如此，我讨厌它。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s, it’s about my, m-my, my thing.” Mitch eventually stammers, hands pressing down into his lap for emphasis. “I don’t feel like it’s really mine, and, I hate it because of it.”"

rows.original: It’s now your turn to blink in surprise as you’re taken aback by the therapist’s answer.[mitch.touchedFluffyTail|“Really? But It hasn’t stopped you from using it before.”|“Oh? Does that mean you’ve never used it before?”]
rows.translation: 现在轮到你惊讶地眨眼了，治疗师的回答令你措手不及。[mitch.touchedFluffyTail|“真的吗？但你以前并不是没用过它。”|“哦？这是不是意味着你以前从来没用过它？”]
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s now your turn to blink in surprise as you’re taken aback by the therapist’s answer.[mitch.touchedFluffyTail|“Really? But It hasn’t stopped you from using it before.”|“Oh? Does that mean you’ve never used it before?”]"

rows.original: Mitch flusters harder. “I mean, if I get really worked up... But it doesn’t make it feel like it belongs to me. My mom’s a sionach, and my father’s an ausar, and yet my, it doesn’t really look like either of their species,” he explains, awkwardly shifting in his seat.
rows.translation: 米奇的脸涨得更红了。“我是说，如果我真的兴奋起来...但这并不会让我觉得它属于自己。我妈妈是西奥纳克，父亲是奥萨人，可我的，它看起来却不像他们任何一个种族的器官，”他解释道，同时在座位上尴尬地挪动身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch flusters harder. “I mean, if I get really worked up... But it doesn’t make it feel like it belongs to me. My mom’s a sionach, and my father’s an ausar, and yet my, it doesn’t really look like either of their species,” he explains, awkwardly shifting in his seat."

rows.original: “You haven’t considered just modding it?” you counsel.
rows.translation: “你没考虑过直接改造它吗？”你建议道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You haven’t considered just modding it?” you counsel."

rows.original: “[pc.name], you should know my stance on modding,” he replies, before adding, “but
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，你应该知道我对身体改造的看法，”他回答，随后又补充道，“但是
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name], you should know my stance on modding,” he replies, before adding, “but "

rows.original: I would be lying if I said I hadn’t a few times. But I backed out before I could pull the trigger, so to speak. I just, I couldn’t find the strength to do it. The most I’ve ever done is dyed my hair purple, and even then I had a relative help me out with it.”
rows.translation: 如果我说自己从没动过这个念头，那就是在撒谎。但打个比方说，每次在扣下扳机前我都会打退堂鼓。我只是，实在鼓不起勇气去做。我做过最出格的事，也不过是把头发染成紫色，而且就连那次都是一位亲戚帮我弄的。”
rows.raw: "I would be lying if I said I hadn’t a few times. But I backed out before I could pull the trigger, so to speak. I just, I couldn’t find the strength to do it. The most I’ve ever done is dyed my hair purple, and even then I had a relative help me out with it.”"

rows.original: You close your eyes as you think the situation over. “Maybe, maybe you just need someone to help give you that push,” you counsel. “Someone you trust.”
rows.translation: 你闭上眼睛，仔细思索这件事。“也许，也许你只是需要有人推你一把，”你劝道。“一个你信任的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou close your eyes as you think the situation over. “Maybe, maybe you just need someone to help give you that push,” you counsel. “Someone you trust.”"

rows.original: Mitch stares in thought, before his eyes brighten as his ears perk straight up. “You!”
rows.translation: 米奇陷入沉思，随后双眼一亮，耳朵也笔直地竖了起来。“你！”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch stares in thought, before his eyes brighten as his ears perk straight up. “You!”"

rows.original: Oh?
rows.translation: 哦？
rows.raw: "\n\nOh?"

rows.original: Mitch blushes at your expression. “You get around a lot, right? You must come across a bunch of mods. A-and there’s no one else I’d trust more with something like this.” Mitch finishes, blushing deeper as he stares your way. “You, you don’t have to, as I don’t really have enough money to repay you for something like this, but I’m sure I could always repay you in other ways,” Mitch’s blush deepens, tails curling shyly around him.
rows.translation: 米奇看到你的表情，脸红了起来。“你经常四处旅行，对吧？你肯定会碰到许多改造品。而且，这种事我最信任的人就是你。”米奇说完，望着你时脸涨得更红了。“你，你不一定非得答应，毕竟我实在没那么多钱偿还这种人情，但我想我总能用别的方式报答你，”米奇的脸更红了，尾巴害羞地蜷绕在身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch blushes at your expression. “You get around a lot, right? You must come across a bunch of mods. A-and there’s no one else I’d trust more with something like this.” Mitch finishes, blushing deeper as he stares your way. “You, you don’t have to, as I don’t really have enough money to repay you for something like this, but I’m sure I could always repay you in other ways,” Mitch’s blush deepens, tails curling shyly around him."

rows.original: Well, now that certainly sounds like a tempting offer. But is it tempting enough?
rows.translation: 嗯，这听起来确实是个诱人的提议。但有诱人到值得接受吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, now that certainly sounds like a tempting offer. But is it tempting enough?"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original:
[pc.kmhbb
			|You let him know that you’ll think about it, but you won’t make any promises.
			|You chuckle, letting the fussy fox know that you’ll consider it when you’re out and about shopping around.
			|You nod, letting Mitch know that you’ll certainly keep it in mind the next time you happen to be browsing through mods.
			|You gasp in delight, cooing right after to assure the little fox that you’ll find only the best mod for him!
			|You shake your head in amusement at his timidity, letting him know that you’ll keep an eye out for anything that might help the fox’s image. That’s just what Bros do.
			]
rows.translation:
[pc.kmhbb
			|你告诉他，你会考虑一下，但不会作任何保证。
			|你轻笑一声，告诉这只爱操心的狐狸，等你在外面逛商店时会考虑这件事。
			|你点点头，告诉米奇，下次碰巧浏览改造品时，你一定会记着这件事。
			|你欣喜地倒吸一口气，紧接着柔声向小狐狸保证，你一定会为他找到最好的改造品！
			|你被他的羞怯逗得摇了摇头，告诉他，你会留意任何可能改善这只狐狸形象的东西。兄弟就该这么做。
			]
rows.raw:
"

[pc.kmhbb
			|You let him know that you’ll think about it, but you won’t make any promises.
			|You chuckle, letting the fussy fox know that you’ll consider it when you’re out and about shopping around.
			|You nod, letting Mitch know that you’ll certainly keep it in mind the next time you happen to be browsing through mods.
			|You gasp in delight, cooing right after to assure the little fox that you’ll find only the best mod for him!
			|You shake your head in amusement at his timidity, letting him know that you’ll keep an eye out for anything that might help the fox’s image. That’s just what Bros do.

rows.original: Mitch grins harder than you’ve ever seen him before, his tails slapping around like large, purple whips. “[pc.name]! You, you’re just; thank you! For everything,” the fox gushes, hands wringing around the mug between his clawed fingers. “I can’t wait to see what you get me.”
rows.translation: 米奇咧嘴笑着，那笑容比你以往见过的任何一次都灿烂；他的尾巴像一条条紫色的大鞭子般四处拍打。“[pc.name]！你，你真是；谢谢你！谢谢你所做的一切，”狐狸激动地说道，两只利爪间的手正绕着杯子来回绞动。“我等不及想看看你会给我带什么了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch grins harder than you’ve ever seen him before, his tails slapping around like large, purple whips. “[pc.name]! You, you’re just; thank you! For everything,” the fox gushes, hands wringing around the mug between his clawed fingers. “I can’t wait to see what you get me.”"

rows.original: Actually...
rows.translation: 其实...
rows.raw: "Actually..."

rows.original: You think deeply as you consider the offer, taking a drawn-out moment before finally shaking your head. [pc.kmhbb |“I’m really sorry, but: I’m not going to.” |“Sorry, but I can’t go around spending credits on everyone I meet. I’d go broke!” |“No.” |“Sorry hun, but I can’t.” |“No can do,” you rumble. ]
rows.translation: 你认真考虑着这个请求，故意沉思了许久，最后还是摇了摇头。[pc.kmhbb |“真的很抱歉，但是：我不会去做。” |“抱歉，但我不能给遇到的每个人都花信用点。那样我会破产的！” |“不。” |“抱歉，亲爱的，但我不能答应。” |“办不到，”你低声说道。 ]
rows.raw: " You think deeply as you consider the offer, taking a drawn-out moment before finally shaking your head. [pc.kmhbb |“I’m really sorry, but: I’m not going to.” |“Sorry, but I can’t go around spending credits on everyone I meet. I’d go broke!” |“No.” |“Sorry hun, but I can’t.” |“No can do,” you rumble. ]"

rows.original: Mitch’s ears droop low at your rebuttal, eyes lowering to stare at the desk as he shrinks in his chair. “A-ah, I should have figured as much. I just thought, maybe–”
rows.translation: 遭到你的拒绝，米奇的耳朵低垂下来；他垂眼盯着桌面，整个人缩进椅子里。“啊，我早该料到的。我只是觉得，也许–”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch’s ears droop low at your rebuttal, eyes lowering to stare at the desk as he shrinks in his chair. “A-ah, I should have figured as much. I just thought, maybe–”"

rows.original: “It’s not because I don’t want to,” you quickly interject. “It’s because I think you’re punishing yourself for no reason. You’re letting this control you; allowing it to do something you’re clearly not comfortable doing yourself. Sometimes, sometimes you just have to cope with the hand that you’re given. You’re missing out on so much by caging yourself up like this. Sure, maybe it’s not what you thought it would be, or looks how you want it to look, but that shouldn’t keep you from enjoying the experiences you’re missing out on. Maybe you should give it a chance.”
rows.translation: “不是因为我不愿意，”你迅速打断他。“而是因为我觉得你在毫无缘由地惩罚自己。你让这件事支配着你；让它逼你去做自己显然并不愿意做的事。有时候，有时候你只能接受命运发到手里的牌。像这样把自己关起来，只会让你错过太多体验。当然，它或许不是你想象中的样子，也不是你希望它拥有的外观，但你不该因此放弃那些错失的体验。也许你应该给它一次机会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not because I don’t want to,” you quickly interject. “It’s because I think you’re punishing yourself for no reason. You’re letting this control you; allowing it to do something you’re clearly not comfortable doing yourself. Sometimes, sometimes you just have to cope with the hand that you’re given. You’re missing out on so much by caging yourself up like this. Sure, maybe it’s not what you thought it would be, or looks how you want it to look, but that shouldn’t keep you from enjoying the experiences you’re missing out on. Maybe you should give it a chance.”"

rows.original: Mitch sniffles softly, tails twitching in a jerky rhythm as he listens to your words. Silence hangs, broken only by the rattle of the simulated rain, before the slouched fox slowly straightens up in his seat.

rows.original: “You know what? You’re right,” he finally murmurs. “You’re absolutely right. I’ve been selfishly hoping someone else would just come along and just solve my problem for me, when I should have been working on accepting myself from the very beginning.” The kitsune eyes his hands, clenching the clawed digits into fists before sighing. “I’m too scared to change, but maybe, maybe I don’t have to. Maybe I’ve been perfectly fine all along, and I just couldn’t see it myself.” The therapist smiles as his eyes meet yours.
rows.translation: “你知道吗？你说得对，”他终于轻声说道。“你说得完全正确。我一直自私地盼着某个人出现，替我解决问题，可我本该从一开始就努力接纳自己。”狐妖看着自己的双手，将长着利爪的手指攥成拳头，随后叹了口气。“我太害怕改变了，但也许，也许我根本不需要改变。或许我一直都没有任何问题，只是我自己没能看明白。”治疗师与你四目相对，露出了微笑。

rows.original: Mitch huffs and pouts at your expression, [mitch.hisHer] hands rubbing protectively along the sides of the mug. “When I worked on New Texas, I was intimately exposed to treated individuals on a regular basis. Every. Single. Day. It does things to you. That heavy scent, the soft warmth, the constant, boundless produce. It didn’t help that I got bottles of milk for basically free, and I might have become a bit dependent on it by the time I left,” Mitch confesses, staring down once more at the mug in [mitch.hisHer] hands. “I don’t get it quite as cheap as I used to anymore, but I still get it shipped for a hefty discount. The taste isn’t nearly as good as it is when fresh, but it’s still leagues better than anything else. Plus the constant protein intake helps keep my fur and skin soft and healthy.” Mitch smiles at that, tails whirling into a flurry of fluffy wiggles. “And it reminds me of better times. I guess it’s what I lean on when things get rough.”

Mitch settles down somewhat, forcing the cup back down to the desk, but those cyan eyes are now full of needy hunger. “I’ll keep it in mind, if the chance ever comes up,” [mitch.heShe] responds, chewing [mitch.hisHer] lip as [mitch.heShe] grips [mitch.hisHer] mug."

rows.translation: [silly|哎呀呀|哦，天哪]，你究竟惹上了什么麻烦？
rows.raw: "\n\n[silly|Ara ara|Oh dear], just what trouble have you gotten yourself into?"

rows.original: You sigh solemnly, doing your best to break the news as softly as you can. [pc.isBimbo |“So like, maybe we can leave my poor teats alone for a little while?” |“Hey, I’m feeling a little sore. Can we maybe lay off the nursing for a little bit?” ]
rows.translation: 你严肃地叹了口气，尽可能委婉地把消息告诉对方。[pc.isBimbo |“那个，我们能不能暂时别折腾我可怜的奶子了？” |“嘿，我觉得有点疼。我们能不能暂时别喝奶了？” ]
rows.raw: " You sigh solemnly, doing your best to break the news as softly as you can. [pc.isBimbo |“So like, maybe we can leave my poor teats alone for a little while?” |“Hey, I’m feeling a little sore. Can we maybe lay off the nursing for a little bit?” ]"

rows.original: The fox’s ears immediately lower, a soft pout forming on [mitch.hisHer] lips as those cyan eyes stare longingly your way. [pc.isAss|You don’t waver under the vulpine’s needy gaze, staring back at the fox as you stand your ground.|You do your best not to waver under the vulpine’s needy gaze, remaining firm enough that the fox soon gives in.]
rows.translation: 狐狸的耳朵立刻垂下，[mitch.hisHer]嘴唇微微噘起，那双青色眼睛渴望地望着你。[pc.isAss|面对狐人迫切的目光，你毫不动摇，坚守立场与这只狐狸对视。|面对狐人迫切的目光，你竭力不让自己动摇，态度足够坚定，终于让这只狐狸屈服。]
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fox’s ears immediately lower, a soft pout forming on [mitch.hisHer] lips as those cyan eyes stare longingly your way. [pc.isAss|You don’t waver under the vulpine’s needy gaze, staring back at the fox as you stand your ground.|You do your best not to waver under the vulpine’s needy gaze, remaining firm enough that the fox soon gives in.]"

rows.original: “A-alright. I suppose it couldn’t last forever.” Mitch relents. “I still get plenty of shipments, so I won’t go thirsty, but I hope you reconsider letting me do so again sometime soon.”
rows.translation: “好、好吧。我想这种事确实不可能永远持续。”米奇让步道。“我还能收到大量货物，所以不会挨渴，但我希望你尽快重新考虑，再让我喝你的奶。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-alright. I suppose it couldn’t last forever.” Mitch relents. “I still get plenty of shipments, so I won’t go thirsty, but I hope you reconsider letting me do so again sometime soon.”"

rows.original: You’ll certainly keep it in mind.
rows.translation: 你当然会记在心里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll certainly keep it in mind."

rows.original: You ponder a bit before asking Mitch the golden question. “Why.”
rows.translation: 你思索片刻，向米奇问出关键问题。“为什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ponder a bit before asking Mitch the golden question. “Why.”"

rows.original: The kitsune eyes you with a mixture of expressions that you can’t quite place, but it doesn’t take the fox very long to respond. “Such a simple question, isn’t it? And yet, it’s the most impactful one of all. Why? Why indeed.” Mitch sighs, [mitch.hisHer] tails twitching as [mitch.heShe] mulls an answer.
rows.translation: 狐仙用一种令你难以捉摸的复杂神情看着你，不过这只狐狸没多久便作出回答。“真是个简单的问题，不是吗？可它偏偏又是影响最大的问题。为什么？究竟为什么呢。”米奇叹了口气；[mitch.heShe]思索答案时，[mitch.hisHer]尾巴也轻轻抽动。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kitsune eyes you with a mixture of expressions that you can’t quite place, but it doesn’t take the fox very long to respond. “Such a simple question, isn’t it? And yet, it’s the most impactful one of all. Why? Why indeed.” Mitch sighs, [mitch.hisHer] tails twitching as [mitch.heShe] mulls an answer."

rows.original: “When I was a university student, I studied vigorously under various psychology courses,” the kitsune slowly explains. “But I constantly found myself drawn more and more towards courses related to mod usage. I was blessed with opportunities to meet several individuals of interest to the psychology community. I even got to meet with Tank Kannon! Er, well, it wasn’t really in person, per se, but it was still an interesting experience,” Mitch concedes, scrunching [mitch.hisHer] face at the thought. “We were able to interview other willing volunteers during that time as well. The first few were people you’d expect: ones who felt that they belonged to a different sex or believed they were actually another race than the one they were born into, but there were also the real addicts. It was a sobering experience to witness what severe mod abuse can do to a person first-hand.”
rows.translation: “我读大学时，勤奋修习了各类心理学课程，”狐仙缓缓解释道。“但我发现自己越来越被与改造剂使用有关的课程吸引。我有幸结识了几位心理学界感兴趣的人物，甚至还见过坦克·坎农！呃，严格来说不算亲自见面，但依然是一次有趣的经历，”米奇承认道，想到这里便皱起[mitch.hisHer]脸。“那段时间，我们也得以采访其他自愿参加的人。最初几位正是你能预料到的那种：有人认为自己属于另一个性别，有人相信自己实际上属于不同于出生种族的另一个种族；但其中也有真正的成瘾者。亲眼见证严重滥用改造剂会对一个人造成什么影响，是一次令人清醒的经历。”
