I was blessed with opportunities to meet several individuals of interest to the psychology community. I even got to meet with Tank Kannon! Er, well, it wasn’t really in person, per se, but it was still an interesting experience,” Mitch concedes, scrunching [mitch.hisHer] face at the thought. “We were able to interview other willing volunteers during that time as well. The first few were people you’d expect: ones who felt that they belonged to a different sex or believed they were actually another race than the one they were born into, but there were also the real addicts. It was a sobering experience to witness what severe mod abuse can do to a person first-hand.”"

rows.original: The fox pauses to wet [mitch.hisHer] drying throat before continuing. “Most individuals who use mods do take into account their dangers. On one hand, you may find your life wonderfully improved. On the other hand, you may find yourself with an unwieldy mess of a body, or you may end up utterly overloading your senses to the point of no return. But what most people don’t often consider is the ramifications that even just simple modding could have on the psyche, and that is exactly what I have been studying.”
rows.translation: 狐狸停下来润了润[mitch.hisHer]干燥的喉咙，随后继续说道：“大多数使用改造剂的人确实会考虑其中的危险。一方面，你的生活可能得到美妙的改善；另一方面，你可能落得一副笨重混乱的身体，也可能让感官彻底过载，达到无可挽回的地步。但多数人往往没有考虑到，即便只是简单的改造，也可能给心理带来后果，而这正是我一直研究的内容。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fox pauses to wet [mitch.hisHer] drying throat before continuing. “Most individuals who use mods do take into account their dangers. On one hand, you may find your life wonderfully improved. On the other hand, you may find yourself with an unwieldy mess of a body, or you may end up utterly overloading your senses to the point of no return. But what most people don’t often consider is the ramifications that even just simple modding could have on the psyche, and that is exactly what I have been studying.”"

rows.original: Mitch raises an eyebrow as [mitch.heShe] eyes you curiously. “Have you ever considered the repercussions of modding at all? Even if you haven’t, the premise is quite simple enough to understand, right? You take a pill, an injection, or a cream, and then you grow into something completely new. What if, however, those mods were doing more than just that? Not just changing the body physically, but altering the mind as well? Of course, it’s easy enough to rationalize that some of them must. Mods like Throbb, Gush, and the Treatment easily come to mind, but what about the more mundane mods? The ones that give you paws, or lengthen your hair? What if there’s a subtle change with them that we don’t fully understand, which changes the way you fundamentally think or act. That is what I look for. That, is why.”
rows.translation: 米奇挑起眉毛，[mitch.heShe]好奇地打量着你。“你有没有认真考虑过改造的后果？即使没有，其中的道理也很容易理解，对吧？你吃下一颗药丸、打一针，或涂上一种乳霜，随后便成长为截然不同的新模样。然而，假如那些改造剂的作用不只如此呢？假如它们不仅改变肉体，也会改变心智呢？当然，人们很容易推断，其中一些必然有这种作用。悸动、喷涌和治疗剂之类的产品很容易让人想到这一点，可那些更普通的改造剂呢？那些让你长出兽爪，或让头发变长的产品呢？假如它们也带来某种我们尚未完全理解的细微变化，从根本上改变你的思考或行为方式呢？这就是我寻找的东西。这就是原因。”

Even if you haven’t, the premise is quite simple enough to understand, right? You take a pill, an injection, or a cream, and then you grow into something completely new. What if, however, those mods were doing more than just that? Not just changing the body physically, but altering the mind as well? Of course, it’s easy enough to rationalize that some of them must. Mods like Throbb, Gush, and the Treatment easily come to mind, but what about the more mundane mods? The ones that give you paws, or lengthen your hair? What if there’s a subtle change with them that we don’t fully understand, which changes the way you fundamentally think or act. That is what I look for. That, is why.”"

rows.original: Mitch pauses to settle back and drink from the ever-present mug between [mitch.hisHer] clawed hands. The kitsune seems to be stalling now, the mug remaining against the fox’s lips for a suspiciously drawn out amount of time. Before you can make a comment though, [mitch.heShe] finally sets it back onto the dark wood of the desk to speak. “It’s hard for me to admit it, but this subject actually affects me quite personally. Someone I happen to know is a victim of mod abuse, and I’m hoping that my research will one day be able to help bring their mind back to what it once was. Every patient I see, every mind I study, brings me just a little bit closer to that goal.” The fox settles, and for a brief moment [mitch.hisHer] eyes seem sharper, almost older, before returning to their youthfully soft appearance. “Now then, is there anything else you wish to talk about?”
rows.translation: 米奇暂停下来，向后靠去，喝了一口始终捧在[mitch.hisHer]利爪双手之间的杯中饮料。狐仙现在似乎在拖延时间，杯子抵在狐狸唇边的时间长得可疑。可还没等你开口评论，[mitch.heShe]终于把杯子放回深色木桌上，说道：“我很难承认，但这个课题其实对我个人影响很深。我认识的某个人正是滥用改造剂的受害者，我希望自己的研究有朝一日能帮助其心智恢复到曾经的状态。我接待的每一位患者、研究的每一颗心灵，都让我离这个目标更近一点。”狐狸平静下来；有那么短暂一刻，[mitch.hisHer]目光似乎变得更加锐利，也更加沧桑，随后才恢复年轻柔和的模样。“那么，你还有别的事情想谈吗？”

rows.original: You giggle at a stray thought before gasping aloud. “Wait! So how does the therapy, like, work?”
rows.translation: 你想到一个念头，咯咯笑了起来，随即惊呼出声。“等等！那这个治疗到底是怎么进行的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou giggle at a stray thought before gasping aloud. “Wait! So how does the therapy, like, work?”"

rows.original: You scratch at your chin in thought. “What’s the therapy like?”
rows.translation: 你若有所思地挠挠下巴。“治疗是什么样的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scratch at your chin in thought. “What’s the therapy like?”"

rows.original: “So how does your therapy work, exactly?”
rows.translation: “所以，你的治疗究竟是怎么进行的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So how does your therapy work, exactly?”"

rows.original: Mitch nods, the act causing [mitch.hisHer] enormous ears to bounce with it. “A very reasonable question. My therapy is actually quite simple, and maybe a little different than what people are expecting. It comes in tiers: gentle therapy, deep therapy, and physical-based therapy,” the fox explains, before gesturing an arm outward as [mitch.heShe] continues. “Therapy actually begins the moment you step into my office. I had this room specifically designed to simulate a soothing, atmospheric environment. The plants I chose myself, for both their color and their calming scent. Everything here works in tandem to make sure you’re relaxed and at ease before you even make it to the lounge.”
rows.translation: 米奇点点头，[mitch.hisHer]硕大耳朵也随之弹动。“这个问题很合理。我的治疗其实相当简单，或许也和人们预想的略有不同。它分为几个层级：温和治疗、深度治疗和身体接触治疗，”狐狸解释道，随后伸出一条手臂示意，[mitch.heShe]继续说道：“其实从你踏进办公室的那一刻，治疗就已经开始了。我特意将这间房设计成能够模拟舒缓氛围的环境。这里的植物由我亲自挑选，看中的既有颜色，也有镇静香气。此处的一切相辅相成，确保你甚至还没走到沙发前，就已经放松自在。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch nods, the act causing [mitch.hisHer] enormous ears to bounce with it. “A very reasonable question. My therapy is actually quite simple, and maybe a little different than what people are expecting. It comes in tiers: gentle therapy, deep therapy, and physical-based therapy,” the fox explains, before gesturing an arm outward as [mitch.heShe] continues. “Therapy actually begins the moment you step into my office. I had this room specifically designed to simulate a soothing, atmospheric environment. The plants I chose myself, for both their color and their calming scent. Everything here works in tandem to make sure you’re relaxed and at ease before you even make it to the lounge.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but notice Mitch’s words ring true. Ever since you stepped into [mitch.hisHer] office, you’ve found yourself to be far calmer than you’ve been in awhile. Your thoughts have even almost returned to normal, clearing your head enough to think somewhat properly for once.
rows.translation: 你不得不承认，米奇所言非虚。自从踏进[mitch.hisHer]办公室，你便感到自己比近来任何时候都更加平静。你的思绪甚至几乎恢复正常，头脑也足够清醒，终于能稍微正常地思考。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but notice Mitch’s words ring true. Ever since you stepped into [mitch.hisHer] office, you’ve found yourself to be far calmer than you’ve been in awhile. Your thoughts have even almost returned to normal, clearing your head enough to think somewhat properly for once."

rows.original: You have to admit, [mitch.heShe] isn’t wrong. The moment you slipped into the room, you felt a blissful calm slip over your entire being. You feel relieved, safe even, while inside the kitsune’s little office.
rows.translation: 你必须承认，[mitch.heShe]说得没错。你刚溜进房间，一股幸福的平静便笼罩全身。待在狐仙的小办公室里，你感到如释重负，甚至十分安全。
rows.raw: "You have to admit, [mitch.heShe] isn’t wrong. The moment you slipped into the room, you felt a blissful calm slip over your entire being. You feel relieved, safe even, while inside the kitsune’s little office."

rows.original: Mitch smiles knowingly, [mitch.hisHer] tails brushing and swaying along behind [mitch.himHer]. “Once someone has fully settled in, I judge how a patient is feeling before deciding what type of therapy to use. Gentle therapy is the quickest, but it’s still decently effective. It consists of a few proven tricks to help ease and relax a disturbed mind, and only lasts for around an hour. Deep therapy is much more thorough, and can take up to several hours if need be. It requires me to actively dampen your senses while you undergo a few mental exercises. It can help heal deep, mental wounds caused to your psyche. Both are capable of helping shield a client from additional damage, even well after the therapy finishes.”
rows.translation: 米奇会意地微笑，[mitch.hisHer]尾巴在[mitch.himHer]身后轻扫摇曳。“等一个人完全安顿下来后，我会判断患者的感受，再决定采用哪种治疗。温和治疗最快，但依然颇有成效。它包含几种经过验证的技巧，可以舒缓并放松不安的心智，只需持续约一小时。深度治疗则彻底得多，必要时可能持续数小时。治疗期间，我需要主动削弱你的感官，同时让你完成一些心理练习。它有助于治愈心灵遭受的深层精神创伤。两种治疗都能帮助客户抵御更多伤害，即使治疗结束很久之后依然有效。”

It can help heal deep, mental wounds caused to your psyche. Both are capable of helping shield a client from additional damage, even well after the therapy finishes.”"

rows.original: The fox pauses to wet [mitch.hisHer] drying throat, before perking up. “However, I believe that the physical portion of my therapy is the most effective in soothing troubled minds. Most individuals are quite partial to the sensation of touch, so I decided to play on that with my therapy.” Mitch shifts, tilting [mitch.hisHer] head a bit. “Ah, right; what I mean to say is, I help elevate your natural happiness by Positive Physical Reinforcement.”
rows.translation: 狐狸停下来润了润[mitch.hisHer]干燥的喉咙，随后精神一振。“不过，我相信治疗中的身体接触环节对安抚烦乱心智最为有效。大多数人都很喜欢触碰的感觉，所以我决定在治疗中利用这一点。”米奇动了动，微微歪起[mitch.hisHer]脑袋。“啊，对了；我的意思是，我会通过积极身体强化来提升你自然产生的幸福感。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fox pauses to wet [mitch.hisHer] drying throat, before perking up. “However, I believe that the physical portion of my therapy is the most effective in soothing troubled minds. Most individuals are quite partial to the sensation of touch, so I decided to play on that with my therapy.” Mitch shifts, tilting [mitch.hisHer] head a bit. “Ah, right; what I mean to say is, I help elevate your natural happiness by Positive Physical Reinforcement.”"

rows.original: You [pc.isAss|nod|smile] knowingly. “Cuddles.”
rows.translation: 你心领神会地[pc.isAss|点头|微笑]。“抱抱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou [pc.isAss|nod|smile] knowingly. “Cuddles.”"

You cuddle people!” |You can’t help but sigh hard in realization. “Oh, you cuddle people.” |You clap your hands, giggling as you bounce on the spot. “Cuddles!!” |It takes a little bit for it to sink in, but you nod in understanding. “Cuddles.”]

rows.original: Mitch huffs in response, [mitch.hisHer] large ears flicking into a prominent ‘V’ shape. “Positive Physical Reinforcement! But yes, it could be called cuddling. Almost every species I encounter ends up loving it! It tends to work the best on individuals who lack social companionship, but it’ll work just well on everyone else, regardless.” The plum fox wiggles happily in [mitch.hisHer] seat, reaching a hand to stroke along one of [mitch.hisHer] many overly fluffy tails. “My body is almost designed for it really, so I figured it would make an excellent addition to my therapy. There haven’t been any complaints about it so far, and I have quite a few returning patients who come almost specifically for it.”
rows.translation: 米奇哼了一声，[mitch.hisHer]大耳朵明显弹成“V”字形。“是积极身体强化！不过没错，也可以称作拥抱。我遇见的几乎每个种族最后都会喜欢它！它往往对缺乏社交陪伴的人效果最好，但对其他任何人也同样有效。”这只梅紫色狐狸在[mitch.hisHer]座位上开心地扭动，伸手抚过[mitch.hisHer]其中一条过分蓬松的尾巴。“其实我的身体几乎就是为这种事而生，所以我觉得它会成为治疗中的绝佳补充。到目前为止还没有任何人抱怨，而且有不少回头客几乎就是专程为此而来。”

There haven’t been any complaints about it so far, and I have quite a few returning patients who come almost specifically for it.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but audibly wonder if cuddles are the only thing [mitch.hisHer] patients come in for, given the suspicious splotches dotting the front of the therapist’s desk.
rows.translation: 看着治疗师桌子正面散布的可疑斑点，你忍不住出声怀疑，拥抱是否是[mitch.hisHer]患者前来的唯一目的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but audibly wonder if cuddles are the only thing [mitch.hisHer] patients come in for, given the suspicious splotches dotting the front of the therapist’s desk."

rows.original: Mitch blushes deeply at that, fidgeting nervously in [mitch.hisHer] seat. “Er, well, I. Sometimes they... S-some patients come in a little wound up, and it would be detrimental to their mental health if I allowed them to leave in such a stressful state.”
rows.translation: 米奇顿时深深脸红，在[mitch.hisHer]座位上紧张地坐立不安。“呃，这个，我。有时他们... 有、有些患者来时积压了太多情绪，要是让他们在如此紧张的状态下离开，会损害他们的心理健康。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch blushes deeply at that, fidgeting nervously in [mitch.hisHer] seat. “Er, well, I. Sometimes they... S-some patients come in a little wound up, and it would be detrimental to their mental health if I allowed them to leave in such a stressful state.”"

rows.original: You chuckle, knowing full well the shenanigans that can follow the fox’s therapies.
rows.translation: 你轻笑起来，心里很清楚狐狸的治疗之后会发生怎样的胡闹。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle, knowing full well the shenanigans that can follow the fox’s therapies."

rows.original: You raise an eyebrow at that, your curiosity about what goes on during Mitch’s after therapy rising.
rows.translation: 你闻言挑起眉毛，对米奇治疗后会发生什么愈发好奇。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise an eyebrow at that, your curiosity about what goes on during Mitch’s after therapy rising."

rows.original: “L-let’s talk about something else, please,” the fluffy vulpine stammers, before taking a sip from [mitch.hisHer] mug.
rows.translation: “请、请换个话题吧，”毛茸茸的狐族结结巴巴地说道，随后抿了一口[mitch.hisHer]杯中的饮料。
rows.raw: "\n\n“L-let’s talk about something else, please,” the fluffy vulpine stammers, before taking a sip from [mitch.hisHer] mug."

rows.original: Something’s been bothering you ever since you discovered Mitch’s little office. The fox gave the impression that [mitch.heShe] could somehow read [mitch.hisHer] patients when you first met, and sometimes the purple colored therapist even seems to know exactly what you’re after before you manage to convey it. Not only that, but the service [mitch.heShe] provides is far more than just simple therapy, or even hypnotism for that matter. The longer you think about it, the more certain you are with what the kitsune is using.
rows.translation: 自从发现米奇的小办公室以来，有件事始终令你耿耿于怀。初次见面时，这只狐狸给人的印象是，[mitch.heShe]似乎能以某种方式看透[mitch.hisHer]患者；有时，这位紫色治疗师甚至在你设法表达之前，就已经确切知道你想要什么。不仅如此，[mitch.heShe]提供的服务也远远不止普通治疗，甚至也不只是催眠。你思考得越久，便越发确定狐仙正在使用什么能力。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething’s been bothering you ever since you discovered Mitch’s little office. The fox gave the impression that [mitch.heShe] could somehow read [mitch.hisHer] patients when you first met, and sometimes the purple colored therapist even seems to know exactly what you’re after before you manage to convey it. Not only that, but the service [mitch.heShe] provides is far more than just simple therapy, or even hypnotism for that matter. The longer you think about it, the more certain you are with what the kitsune is using."

rows.original: Psionics.
rows.translation: 灵能。
rows.raw: "\n\nPsionics."

rows.original: Mitch squirms awkwardly in place during the silence, before mumbling. “Alright, well I guess the cat is out of the bag. Yes, I am Psionic.”
rows.translation: 沉默期间，米奇尴尬地在原地扭动，随后咕哝道：“好吧，看来秘密已经暴露了。没错，我是灵能者。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch squirms awkwardly in place during the silence, before mumbling. “Alright, well I guess the cat is out of the bag. Yes, I am Psionic.”"

rows.original: You tense in surprise at the vulpine’s sudden, timely confession. “Wait, but I-”
rows.translation: 狐族突如其来却恰到时机的坦白让你惊讶地绷紧身体。“等等，可我——”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tense in surprise at the vulpine’s sudden, timely confession. “Wait, but I-”"

rows.original: “Didn’t say anything; I know.” The fox quickly finishes for you, smiling sheepishly at your shocked expression before explaining. “I’ve been picking up on your thoughts. In fact, I’ve been picking them up each and every time you’ve ever been around me. Not purposefully, mind you. it’s not something I have any real control over. It just happens with anyone and everyone I happen to be around with. Most of the time I can just ignore it, but when someone thinks especially hard on something it’s like they’re shouting it. Like just now, when you figured out I was psionic.”
rows.translation: “你什么也没说；我知道。”狐狸迅速替你把话说完，看到你震惊的表情后腼腆一笑，解释道：“我一直能接收到你的想法。事实上，每次你出现在我身边时，我都能接收到它们。注意，我不是故意的。这件事完全不受我的实际控制。无论我碰巧和谁待在一起，都会自然发生。大多数时候我可以忽略它，但当某个人特别专注地想着一件事时，就像在大声喊出那个念头。就像刚才，你发现我是灵能者的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Didn’t say anything; I know.” The fox quickly finishes for you, smiling sheepishly at your shocked expression before explaining. “I’ve been picking up on your thoughts. In fact, I’ve been picking them up each and every time you’ve ever been around me. Not purposefully, mind you. it’s not something I have any real control over. It just happens with anyone and everyone I happen to be around with. Most of the time I can just ignore it, but when someone thinks especially hard on something it’s like they’re shouting it. Like just now, when you figured out I was psionic.”"

rows.original: “That would explain a lot,” you concede, though your thoughts quickly turn to other possibilities. “So is mind reading all you can do? Like, can you [flags.MET_FROSTWYRM|summon lightning|move stuff around] with your mind?”
rows.translation: “这能解释很多事情，”你承认道，但思绪很快转向其他可能性。“所以你只会读心吗？比如说，你能不能用意念[flags.MET_FROSTWYRM|召唤闪电|移动物体]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That would explain a lot,” you concede, though your thoughts quickly turn to other possibilities. “So is mind reading all you can do? Like, can you [flags.MET_FROSTWYRM|summon lightning|move stuff around] with your mind?”"

rows.original: Mitch quickly laughs. “[flags.MET_FROSTWYRM|Okay, now that one’s new|Always with the same old question]. No, I haven’t been able to do anything like that. There was this one time I was able to move someone else’s arm, but it was weird. for both of us,” the vulpine confesses, shifting in [mitch.hisHer] seat. “I don’t tend to do things like that unless I have specific permission, so I can’t say I have much practice.”
rows.translation: 米奇立刻笑了起来。“[flags.MET_FROSTWYRM|好吧，这个问题倒是头一回听到|怎么总是这个老问题]。不能，我还做不到那种事。有一次我确实控制了别人的手臂，但那感觉很奇怪。对我们两个都是，”狐人承认道，在[mitch.hisHer]座位上挪了挪。“除非得到明确许可，否则我一般不会做这种事，所以谈不上有多少练习。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch quickly laughs. “[flags.MET_FROSTWYRM|Okay, now that one’s new|Always with the same old question]. No, I haven’t been able to do anything like that. There was this one time I was able to move someone else’s arm, but it was weird. for both of us,” the vulpine confesses, shifting in [mitch.hisHer] seat. “I don’t tend to do things like that unless I have specific permission, so I can’t say I have much practice.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but imagine certain possibilities concerning this new information; possibilities that Mitch is no doubt mentally picking up on judging by [mitch.hisHer] newly growing blush. “Maybe we can try that out together sometime,” you muse.
rows.translation: 得知这个新消息后，你不由得设想起某些可能性；从[mitch.hisHer]脸上逐渐加深的红晕来看，米奇无疑在精神上接收到了这些想法。“也许以后我们可以一起试试看，”你若有所思地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but imagine certain possibilities concerning this new information; possibilities that Mitch is no doubt mentally picking up on judging by [mitch.hisHer] newly growing blush. “Maybe we can try that out together sometime,” you muse."

rows.original: “I-if you wish to,” Mitch stammers softly, fingers fiddling away at the mug between them.
rows.translation: “如、如果你愿意的话，”米奇轻声结巴着，手指不停摆弄着捧在手中的杯子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-if you wish to,” Mitch stammers softly, fingers fiddling away at the mug between them."

rows.original: “What if I just wanted to chat?” you wonder aloud, tilting your head at the purple kitsune.
rows.translation: “如果我只是想聊聊天呢？”你歪头看着紫色狐族，大声问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What if I just wanted to chat?” you wonder aloud, tilting your head at the purple kitsune."

rows.original: “How about a little one-on-one?” you inquire gruffly, raising your eyebrow at the kitsune.
rows.translation: “来点一对一的怎么样？”你粗声询问，同时朝狐族挑起眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How about a little one-on-one?” you inquire gruffly, raising your eyebrow at the kitsune."

rows.original: “What if I just wanted to chat a little?” you suggest.
rows.translation: “如果我只是想聊一会儿呢？”你提议。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What if I just wanted to chat a little?” you suggest."

rows.original: “More questions again?” [mitch.heShe] muses knowingly. [silly|“You’re not skipping my dialogue boxes just so you can get to the fun stuff faster, are you?”] The kitsune smiles slowly before relaxing back, stealing a sip from [mitch.hisHer] ever present mug before [mitch.heShe] nods. “That’s fine by me. I always have some spare time to chat with my patients. What would you like to ask?”
rows.translation: “又有更多问题？”[mitch.heShe]心领神会地问道。[silly|“你该不会为了更快进入有趣环节，跳过了我的对话框吧？”]狐仙缓缓一笑，放松地向后靠去，端起[mitch.hisHer]总不离手的杯子偷喝一口，随后[mitch.heShe]点了点头。“我不介意。我总有一些空闲时间和患者聊天。你想问什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“More questions again?” [mitch.heShe] muses knowingly. [silly|“You’re not skipping my dialogue boxes just so you can get to the fun stuff faster, are you?”] The kitsune smiles slowly before relaxing back, stealing a sip from [mitch.hisHer] ever present mug before [mitch.heShe] nods. “That’s fine by me. I always have some spare time to chat with my patients. What would you like to ask?”"

rows.original: “That’s perfectly fine by me. Casual conversation can be just as effective as any therapy, with an added bonus of learning a little more about each other.” Mitch smiles, fingers happily spinning the coffee mug between them. “But I have this strange feeling you’re just yearning to ask me some questions, so shoot.”
rows.translation: “我完全不介意。随意交谈可以和任何治疗一样有效，额外的好处是让彼此多了解一点。”米奇微笑着，手指愉快地转动着其间的咖啡杯。“不过我有种奇怪的感觉，你早就迫不及待想问我几个问题了，所以尽管开口吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s perfectly fine by me. Casual conversation can be just as effective as any therapy, with an added bonus of learning a little more about each other.” Mitch smiles, fingers happily spinning the coffee mug between them. “But I have this strange feeling you’re just yearning to ask me some questions, so shoot.”"

rows.original: [pc.kmhbb |“How about some therapy today?” you ask with a smile. |“How about some of that therapy of yours?” you ask coyly. |You let out a hard sigh, before glowering at the kitsune. “Since I’m here, I might as well get some therapy.” |You giggle. “Oh I know! How about that therapy thing?” |“I could use a checkup,” you grunt.]
rows.translation: [pc.kmhbb |“今天做点治疗怎么样？”你微笑着问道。 |“试试你的那种治疗怎么样？”你娇声问道。 |你重重叹了口气，随后怒视狐仙。“既然来了，我不妨接受一点治疗。” |你咯咯一笑。“哦，我知道了！试试那个治疗怎么样？” |“我需要检查一下，”你低声说道。]
rows.raw: " [pc.kmhbb |“How about some therapy today?” you ask with a smile. |“How about some of that therapy of yours?” you ask coyly. |You let out a hard sigh, before glowering at the kitsune. “Since I’m here, I might as well get some therapy.” |You giggle. “Oh I know! How about that therapy thing?” |“I could use a checkup,” you grunt.]"

rows.original: Mitch sits up in [mitch.hisHer] seat, [mitch.hisHer] fluffy tails a sudden flurry of excited movement. “I would be delighted to! Before we start however, I have to assess your current mental state. Could you tell me what’s on your mind?”
rows.translation: 米奇在[mitch.hisHer]座位上坐直，[mitch.hisHer]蓬松的尾巴忽然兴奋地乱舞起来。“我很乐意！不过在开始之前，我必须评估你目前的精神状态。你能告诉我在想什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch sits up in [mitch.hisHer] seat, [mitch.hisHer] fluffy tails a sudden flurry of excited movement. “I would be delighted to! Before we start however, I have to assess your current mental state. Could you tell me what’s on your mind?”"

rows.original: Mitch smiles patiently, tails still whirling about as [mitch.heShe] waits for your answer. Well? What’s been bothering you?
rows.translation: 米奇耐心地笑着，尾巴仍在不停转动，等着你回答。那么？什么事一直困扰着你？[mitch.heShe]正等着你的回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch smiles patiently, tails still whirling about as [mitch.heShe] waits for your answer. Well? What’s been bothering you?"

rows.original: Allow
rows.translation: 允许
rows.raw: "Allow"

rows.original: You let out a hard sigh, rolling your eyes before opening your arms up to the kitsune. “Fiiine, I guess you can be my little pog champ. C’mere.”
rows.translation: 你重重叹了口气，翻着白眼向狐仙张开双臂。“好——吧，我想你可以当我的小冠军。过来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let out a hard sigh, rolling your eyes before opening your arms up to the kitsune. “Fiiine, I guess you can be my little pog champ. C’mere.”"

rows.original: [pc.kmhbb |You smile softly, nodding at the kitsune. “Yes, I’d love to.” |You grin slowly at the kitsune. “Oh? Well I shouldn’t turn down the full experience.” |You let out a huffy sigh, before eyeing at the kitsune. “Fine. I guess you can.” |You gasp sharply before squealing out. “Cuddles!!” |You rumble a humm in thought, before giving your affirmation with a firm nod. ]
rows.translation: [pc.kmhbb |你温柔地微笑，向狐仙点点头。“好啊，我很愿意。” |你对狐仙缓缓咧嘴一笑。“哦？那么我不该拒绝完整体验。” |你不耐烦地叹了口气，随后看向狐仙。“好吧。我想可以。” |你猛吸一口气，随后尖声喊道：“抱抱！！” |你若有所思地低哼一声，随后坚定地点头表示同意。 ]
rows.raw: " [pc.kmhbb |You smile softly, nodding at the kitsune. “Yes, I’d love to.” |You grin slowly at the kitsune. “Oh? Well I shouldn’t turn down the full experience.” |You let out a huffy sigh, before eyeing at the kitsune. “Fine. I guess you can.” |You gasp sharply before squealing out. “Cuddles!!” |You rumble a humm in thought, before giving your affirmation with a firm nod. ]"

rows.original: Cuddles
rows.translation: 拥抱
rows.raw: "Cuddles"

rows.original: Cuddles
rows.translation: 拥抱
rows.raw: "Cuddles"

rows.original: You just need some physical therapy!
rows.translation: 你只是需要一点物理治疗！
rows.raw: "You just need some physical therapy!"

rows.original: Deny
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Deny"

rows.original: Deny
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Deny"

rows.original: How can you refuse cuddles?
rows.translation: 你怎么忍心拒绝抱抱呢？
rows.raw: "How can you refuse cuddles?"

rows.original: Deny
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Deny"

rows.original: [pc.kmhbb |You sadly eye at the therapist “I’m sorry, but not today.” |“Not today, I’m afraid,” you sigh, eyeing the fox with an apologetic look. |You shoot a glare towards the plum shaded fox. “No.” | |“No,” you grunt, shaking your head. ]
rows.translation: [pc.kmhbb |你悲伤地看着治疗师。“对不起，但今天不行。” |“恐怕今天不行，”你叹着气，歉意地看向狐狸。 |你怒视这只梅紫色狐狸。“不。” | |“不，”你摇着头低声说道。 ]
rows.raw: " [pc.kmhbb |You sadly eye at the therapist “I’m sorry, but not today.” |“Not today, I’m afraid,” you sigh, eyeing the fox with an apologetic look. |You shoot a glare towards the plum shaded fox. “No.” | |“No,” you grunt, shaking your head. ]"

rows.original: Mitch’s ears promptly lower, [mitch.hisHer] fluffy tails drooping down along the floor. “I understand. The therapy is complete without it, and it isn’t required, but I still recommend it for the full experience.”
rows.translation: 米奇的耳朵立刻垂下，[mitch.hisHer]蓬松尾巴也耷拉到地板上。“我明白。没有这个环节，治疗也算完成，而且它并非必需；不过为了完整体验，我仍然建议进行。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch’s ears promptly lower, [mitch.hisHer] fluffy tails drooping down along the floor. “I understand. The therapy is complete without it, and it isn’t required, but I still recommend it for the full experience.”"

rows.original: You restate your decision, having made up your mind about the matter. The fox lets out a sad sigh in response, but slips back into [mitch.hisHer] chair behind the desk. “Very well. I can be satisfied that we’ve at least completed the main portion of the therapy. I can only hope that it helps ease some of the mental burden upon your psyche,” the kitsune mumbles, [mitch.hisHer] sad smile slowly turning a bit more genuine. “Well, I have very much enjoyed your company, but I really should get ready for my other patients. Can’t have one hogging me all day.”
rows.translation: 你已经对此下定决心，于是再次表明自己的决定。狐狸闻言悲伤地叹了口气，随后坐回桌后[mitch.hisHer]的椅子上。“很好。至少治疗的主要部分已经完成，我也可以满足了。我只希望它能稍微减轻你心灵承受的精神负担，”狐仙咕哝道，[mitch.hisHer]悲伤的笑容逐渐多了几分真诚。“嗯，我很享受你的陪伴，但确实该为其他患者做准备了。总不能让一个人整天独占我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou restate your decision, having made up your mind about the matter. The fox lets out a sad sigh in response, but slips back into [mitch.hisHer] chair behind the desk. “Very well. I can be satisfied that we’ve at least completed the main portion of the therapy. I can only hope that it helps ease some of the mental burden upon your psyche,” the kitsune mumbles, [mitch.hisHer] sad smile slowly turning a bit more genuine. “Well, I have very much enjoyed your company, but I really should get ready for my other patients. Can’t have one hogging me all day.”"

rows.original: You get the vulpine’s hint, which prompts you to get up from the lounge. After a few hard stretches, you thank Mitch for [mitch.hisHer] service before making your way out of the office, having gotten what you wanted from the therapist.
rows.translation: 你听懂了狐人的暗示，于是从沙发上站起来。用力伸展几下后，你感谢米奇提供的[mitch.hisHer]服务，随后离开办公室；你已经从治疗师这里得到了想要的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get the vulpine’s hint, which prompts you to get up from the lounge. After a few hard stretches, you thank Mitch for [mitch.hisHer] service before making your way out of the office, having gotten what you wanted from the therapist."

rows.original: “Can we just like, skip to the snuggling?!” you blurt out, shifting your [pc.hips] about in eager excitement.
rows.translation: “我们能不能直接跳到拥抱环节？！”你脱口而出，兴奋地扭动着[pc.hips]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can we just like, skip to the snuggling?!” you blurt out, shifting your [pc.hips] about in eager excitement."

rows.original: You reach to rub a hand into a shoulder as you let out a sore huff. “I just need some physical therapy.”
rows.translation: 你伸手揉着肩膀，酸痛地哼了一声。“我只是需要一点物理治疗。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach to rub a hand into a shoulder as you let out a sore huff. “I just need some physical therapy.”"

rows.original: “What if I just wanted a hug?” you ask coyly.
rows.translation: “如果我只是想要一个拥抱呢？”你含蓄地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What if I just wanted a hug?” you ask coyly."

rows.original: Mitch stares silently for a moment before blushing as [mitch.heShe] considers your request. “You just want the positive reinforcement? But it’s much more effective after receiving therapy.”
rows.translation: 米奇沉默地注视片刻，考虑你的请求时，[mitch.heShe]脸上泛起红晕。“你只想要积极强化？但它在接受治疗之后效果会好得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n Mitch stares silently for a moment before blushing as [mitch.heShe] considers your request. “You just want the positive reinforcement? But it’s much more effective after receiving therapy.”"

rows.original: Shaking your head, you reaffirm your decision. You know exactly what you came here for, and you’re not leaving without some foxy cuddling.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，再次确认自己的决定。你很清楚自己为何而来，不抱够狐狸绝不会离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nShaking your head, you reaffirm your decision. You know exactly what you came here for, and you’re not leaving without some foxy cuddling."

rows.original: “I suppose sometimes all one needs is a little physical affection,” the kitsune admits, shimmying as [mitch.heShe] slips off [mitch.hisHer] chair. “I’d feel bad if I denied a patient something that could potentially help their stress.” The plum fox steps closer, tails gently swaying as [mitch.heShe] fidgets. “Are you ready?”
rows.translation: “有时候，一个人需要的或许只是一点身体上的关爱，”狐仙承认道；[mitch.heShe]扭动身体，从[mitch.hisHer]椅子上滑下来。“如果拒绝给予患者某种或许能帮助缓解压力的东西，我会过意不去。”梅紫色狐狸走近几步，尾巴轻轻摇摆，[mitch.heShe]也坐立不安地动了动。“准备好了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose sometimes all one needs is a little physical affection,” the kitsune admits, shimmying as [mitch.heShe] slips off [mitch.hisHer] chair. “I’d feel bad if I denied a patient something that could potentially help their stress.” The plum fox steps closer, tails gently swaying as [mitch.heShe] fidgets. “Are you ready?”"

rows.original: Nodding, you adjust slightly on the red chaise as you eye the kitsune, eager to receive your coming cuddling.
rows.translation: 你点点头，在红色贵妃椅上稍稍调整姿势，期待地看着狐族，等候即将到来的拥抱。

rows.translation: 天下没有不散的筵席，因此感觉治疗师退开时，你没有抵抗。[mitch.HisHer]尾巴最难离开，因为它们必须从方才毫不知耻地揉摸时牢牢攀住的地方一一抽出。失去治疗师保暖绒毛的包围，你的身体感觉有些寒冷，但这段体验在内心留下了久久不散的暖意。米奇[mitch.heShe]彻底站起身时仍扭动不安，[mitch.hisHer]如今已经完全凌乱的尾巴在[mitch.himHer]身后挥舞。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll good things must come to an end, so you offer no resistance when you feel the therapist pulling away. [mitch.HisHer] tails have the hardest time leaving, having to extract themselves from whatever purchase they firmly clung to during their shameless groping. Your body feels cold without the therapist’s insulating fluff surrounding it, but the experience leaves a warmth that lingers in your core. Mitch fusses as [mitch.heShe] fully stands, [mitch.hisHer] now thoroughly ruffled tails waving behind [mitch.himHer]."

rows.original: “I-I hope you enjoyed the reinforcement.” the blushing kitsune murmurs. “Physical affection can do wonders on both the mind and body.”
rows.translation: “我、我希望你喜欢这种强化。”满脸通红的狐仙咕哝道。“身体上的关爱能为心灵和肉体带来奇效。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I hope you enjoyed the reinforcement.” the blushing kitsune murmurs. “Physical affection can do wonders on both the mind and body.”"

I can’t spend all day helping just one patient.”
rows.translation: 米奇倒吸一口气，一条尾巴迅速从[mitch.hisHer]双腿之间卷起，遮住显而易见的兴奋。“这、这只是靠得这么近所产生的自然反应！”[mitch.HeShe]结结巴巴地说道，耳朵向后抖动，[mitch.heShe]拖着脚步走向[mitch.hisHer]书桌。“现、现在快走！我不能整天只帮助一位患者。”

I can’t spend all day helping just one patient.”"

rows.original: You chuckle as you rise from the office lounge, stretching to give the flustered kitsune a bit of a show before making your way out of the office with a happy spring in your step.
rows.translation: 你笑着从办公室沙发上站起身，伸展身体，刻意给慌乱的狐仙展示一番，随后脚步轻快地离开办公室。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle as you rise from the office lounge, stretching to give the flustered kitsune a bit of a show before making your way out of the office with a happy spring in your step."

rows.original: You think it over for a bit, before mentioning that you’ve felt a little under the weather lately, but not too worse for wear.
rows.translation: 你思考片刻，接着提到自己最近有些不舒服，但状况还不算太糟。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think it over for a bit, before mentioning that you’ve felt a little under the weather lately, but not too worse for wear."

rows.original: “I see, so you’re experiencing only mild distress.” Mitch nods sagely. “It’s perfectly okay to seek out aid if you’re feeling a little down. The worst cases often arise from such small symptoms, after all,” [mitch.heShe] assures, the fox already slipping out from behind [mitch.hisHer] desk as [mitch.heShe] makes [mitch.hisHer] way over towards the lounge. It’s only a few short steps before the therapist is standing before you, face full of concern and tails neatly swishing.
rows.translation: “我明白了，所以你只是稍感苦恼。”米奇睿智地点点头。“如果心情有些低落，寻求帮助完全没问题。毕竟最糟糕的情况往往正是从这样的小症状发展而来，”[mitch.heShe]安慰道；狐狸已经从[mitch.hisHer]书桌后走出，[mitch.heShe]迈着[mitch.hisHer]脚步朝沙发走去。只需短短几步，治疗师便来到你面前，脸上满是关切，尾巴整齐地摆动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I see, so you’re experiencing only mild distress.” Mitch nods sagely. “It’s perfectly okay to seek out aid if you’re feeling a little down. The worst cases often arise from such small symptoms, after all,” [mitch.heShe] assures, the fox already slipping out from behind [mitch.hisHer] desk as [mitch.heShe] makes [mitch.hisHer] way over towards the lounge. It’s only a few short steps before the therapist is standing before you, face full of concern and tails neatly swishing."

rows.original: “Close your eyes,” Mitch quietly instructs. You do so, the world around you fading to black as you follow along with the kitsune’s commands. “Relax. Loosen your shoulders, ease your muscles. That’s it. Now let’s clear your thoughts. Focus on your breathing. Slow, steady breaths...”
rows.translation: “闭上眼睛。”米奇轻声指示。你依言照做，随着自己听从狐人的指令，周围的世界逐渐陷入黑暗。“放松。松开肩膀，舒展肌肉。对，就是这样。现在让我们清空思绪。专注于呼吸。缓慢、平稳地呼吸...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Close your eyes,” Mitch quietly instructs. You do so, the world around you fading to black as you follow along with the kitsune’s commands. “Relax. Loosen your shoulders, ease your muscles. That’s it. Now let’s clear your thoughts. Focus on your breathing. Slow, steady breaths...”"

rows.original: The sound of the office’s pouring rain fills your ears as you allow your mind to clear, your thoughts slipping away as the therapist’s soothing, ever gentle tone envelops them like a warm blanket. The pressure of the lounge under you dissipates along with it, as well as the feeling of

The pressure of the lounge under you dissipates along with it, as well as the feeling of "

rows.original: against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] as you surrender to the vulpine’s tender voice.
rows.translation: 贴着你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]的触感；你彻底沉浸在狐人温柔的声音中。
rows.raw: " against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] as you surrender to the vulpine’s tender voice."

rows.original: “Steady now... Evenly,” the voice softly urges, each word heard clearly and yet barely above a whisper. “I want you to follow my rhythm now. All the way in. All the way out. Feel the air moving in. Feel the stress moving out. Just like that. In. and out. In. and out.”
rows.translation: “保持平稳... 均匀一些。”那个声音轻柔地催促着，每个字都听得清清楚楚，却又几乎只是耳语。“现在我要你跟着我的节奏。彻底吸气。彻底呼气。感受空气进入体内。感受压力离开身体。就是这样。吸气。然后呼气。吸气。然后呼气。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steady now... Evenly,” the voice softly urges, each word heard clearly and yet barely above a whisper. “I want you to follow my rhythm now. All the way in. All the way out. Feel the air moving in. Feel the stress moving out. Just like that. In. and out. In. and out.”"

rows.original: Your [pc.chest] rises and falls on its own now, locked firmly to the tempo of the therapist’s even, controlled rhythm. The once gentle pattering of rain gracing your ears has evolved, growing and swelling until your mind is filled to the brim with its roaring, scattered white noise. The electric static is overpowering, drowning out any chance of coherent thought, and yet you can still vaguely hear the kitsune’s voice cutting through it all. It’s getting harder to make out exactly what the therapist is saying, but you feel your body respond to each and every single word.
rows.translation: 你的[pc.chest]如今自行起伏，牢牢跟随着治疗师均匀而克制的节奏。曾经轻柔敲击耳膜的雨声已经演变、增强并膨胀，直到其轰鸣而散乱的白噪音彻底填满你的头脑。电流般的杂音压倒一切，淹没任何连贯思考的可能，但你依然能模糊听到狐仙的声音穿透其中。治疗师具体在说什么越来越难以分辨，但你感觉身体会对每一个字作出反应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour [pc.chest] rises and falls on its own now, locked firmly to the tempo of the therapist’s even, controlled rhythm. The once gentle pattering of rain gracing your ears has evolved, growing and swelling until your mind is filled to the brim with its roaring, scattered white noise. The electric static is overpowering, drowning out any chance of coherent thought, and yet you can still vaguely hear the kitsune’s voice cutting through it all. It’s getting harder to make out exactly what the therapist is saying, but you feel your body respond to each and every single word."

rows.original: “Release your worries, they are just dust in the wind. Leave past hardships behind, and their weight will burden you no longer. The past has passed, and any worry over it should not hinder your precious future. The road ahead belongs to you, and you alone. Let nothing take that away.”
rows.translation: “放下你的忧虑，它们不过是风中的尘埃。把过去的苦难留在身后，它们的重量便再也无法拖累你。过去已经过去，对它的任何担忧都不该妨碍你珍贵的未来。前方的道路属于你，也只属于你。别让任何事物夺走它。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Release your worries, they are just dust in the wind. Leave past hardships behind, and their weight will burden you no longer. The past has passed, and any worry over it should not hinder your precious future. The road ahead belongs to you, and you alone. Let nothing take that away.”"

rows.original: Each word resonates deep within your core. All of this running around has only gotten you tired, sore, and stressed, but why? Why have you been worrying so much? Your inheritance, the probes, [rival.name]. it’s all been steadily wearing you down. But you’ve got it all completely handled! You’ve made it this far just fine after all. Wherever those probes are, how you find them, and whatever nonsense your cousin decides to throw at you are just small problems.
rows.translation: 每句话都在你的内心深处回响。四处奔波只让你疲惫、酸痛又压力重重，可这是为什么？你为什么要如此忧虑？你的遗产、探针、[rival.name]，这一切都在一点点消磨你。但你明明已经把一切都处理得很好！毕竟你一路走到现在都安然无恙。那些探针在哪里、该如何找到它们，还有你表亲打算抛来的任何麻烦，都不过是小问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nEach word resonates deep within your core. All of this running around has only gotten you tired, sore, and stressed, but why? Why have you been worrying so much? Your inheritance, the probes, [rival.name]. it’s all been steadily wearing you down. But you’ve got it all completely handled! You’ve made it this far just fine after all. Wherever those probes are, how you find them, and whatever nonsense your cousin decides to throw at you are just small problems."

rows.original: Nothing more.
rows.translation: 仅此而已。
rows.raw: "\n\nNothing more."

rows.original: “Feel free to breathe normally again,” the kitsune finally murmurs, although it changes nothing. This slow, even breathing is your new normal now, and every new breath of fresh air filling your lungs feels utterly euphoric. Each exhale is its own little release, and every inhale following [silly|fills your body with the warmth and power of pure sunlight.|makes your body feel lightweight and carefree.] It doesn’t feel like the weight has been lifted off your shoulders, it feels as if there wasn’t any weight to begin with.
rows.translation: “现在可以恢复正常呼吸了，”狐仙终于轻声说道，然而什么也没有改变。这种缓慢均匀的呼吸如今就是你的常态，每一口灌入肺部的新鲜空气都带来无与伦比的欣快。每次呼气都是一次小小释放，随后每次吸气都会[silly|让纯净阳光的温暖与力量充满你的身体。|令你的身体感觉轻盈而无忧无虑。]这感觉并不是肩头重担得以卸下，而是那份重量从一开始便从未存在。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Feel free to breathe normally again,” the kitsune finally murmurs, although it changes nothing. This slow, even breathing is your new normal now, and every new breath of fresh air filling your lungs feels utterly euphoric. Each exhale is its own little release, and every inhale following [silly|fills your body with the warmth and power of pure sunlight.|makes your body feel lightweight and carefree.] It doesn’t feel like the weight has been lifted off your shoulders, it feels as if there wasn’t any weight to begin with."

rows.original: The sharp sound of a throat being cleared is enough to pull you out of your comfy stupor, the kitsune giving you an apologetic stare as [mitch.heShe] shifts in place. “The main portion of your therapy is now complete, but it is only half of my offered service. However, I’m required to ask for your permission before I can move onto the positive physical reinforcement. Will you allow me to?”
rows.translation: 响亮的清嗓声足以把你从舒适恍惚中拉回；[mitch.heShe]在原地挪动，狐仙歉意地望着你。“治疗的主要环节已经完成，但这只是我所提供服务的一半。不过，在进行积极身体强化之前，我必须征得你的许可。你愿意让我继续吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sharp sound of a throat being cleared is enough to pull you out of your comfy stupor, the kitsune giving you an apologetic stare as [mitch.heShe] shifts in place. “The main portion of your therapy is now complete, but it is only half of my offered service. However, I’m required to ask for your permission before I can move onto the positive physical reinforcement. Will you allow me to?”"

Will you let [mitch.himHer]?|Seems like whatever [mitch.heShe] wants to do requires [mitch.himHer] to get rather close. Will you let [mitch.himHer]?]
rows.translation: 米奇的耳朵竖起并转动，白色绒毛覆盖的内侧专心聆听你的回答。[mitch.doneDeepTherapy|看来[mitch.heShe]想再次把你抱个够。你会允许[mitch.himHer]吗？|看来无论[mitch.heShe]想做什么，都需要[mitch.himHer]和你贴得相当近。你会允许[mitch.himHer]吗？]

rows.original: Deep
rows.translation: 深入
rows.raw: "Deep"

rows.original: You’ve been feeling more than a little down lately. Your mind is burdened with the constant weight of your endlessly growing responsibilities, and you’re uncertain if you can continue carrying on if it keeps getting worse.
rows.translation: 最近你的心情不只是有一点低落。不断增加、仿佛永无止境的责任沉沉压在心头，你不确定如果情况继续恶化，自己是否还能坚持下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve been feeling more than a little down lately. Your mind is burdened with the constant weight of your endlessly growing responsibilities, and you’re uncertain if you can continue carrying on if it keeps getting worse."

rows.original: Mitch listens intently to every word, eyeing you with growing concern once your confession is finished. “It sounds like you’re in desperate need of some deep therapy. We should begin at once,” the plum shaded kitsune announces, quickly slipping off [mitch.hisHer] chair and striding smoothly over towards the nearby wall. [mitch.HisHer] clawed fingers gently press into a hidden panel, which causes the low ambient light of the room to darken until only the faint outlines of the office furniture are seen. Even the simulated windows adjust, turning the normally boring, overcast city within their frames into a metropolitan nightscape of faint neon lights and pouring rain.
rows.translation: 米奇专心聆听每一句话；你坦白完毕后，狐狸看向你的目光愈发担忧。“听起来你迫切需要一些深度治疗。我们应该立刻开始，”梅紫色狐仙宣布道，迅速从[mitch.hisHer]椅子上滑下，步履流畅地走向附近的墙壁。[mitch.HisHer]带爪手指轻轻按住一块隐藏面板，令房间低沉的环境光逐渐变暗，直到办公室家具只剩模糊轮廓。就连模拟窗户也随之调整，将框内平日乏味、阴云密布的城市变成霓虹微光与倾盆大雨交织的大都会夜景。
rows.raw: "\n\nMitch listens intently to every word, eyeing you with growing concern once your confession is finished. “It sounds like you’re in desperate need of some deep therapy. We should begin at once,” the plum shaded kitsune announces, quickly slipping off [mitch.hisHer] chair and striding smoothly over towards the nearby wall. [mitch.HisHer] clawed fingers gently press into a hidden panel, which causes the low ambient light of the room to darken until only the faint outlines of the office furniture are seen. Even the simulated windows adjust, turning the normally boring, overcast city within their frames into a metropolitan nightscape of faint neon lights and pouring rain."

rows.original: Your attention is quickly fixated upon the fluffy therapist however, as the darkening office reveals the sionach’s often hidden attribute. Mitch’s eyes brightly glow with cyan bioluminescence, giving the fox a surprisingly sinister flair as [mitch.heShe] stares your way. [mitch.HisHer] tail tips share a similar, baleful glow, each leaving behind a glowing trail of mist in their wake as they flick and dance around the kitsune. The resulting combination is surprisingly haunting, adding an eerily phantasmal aura to the vulpine as [mitch.heShe] silently stalks over.
rows.translation: 然而，你的注意力很快集中在毛茸茸的治疗师身上，因为逐渐变暗的办公室显露了西奥纳克人时常隐藏的特征。米奇的双眼闪耀着明亮的青色生物荧光；[mitch.heShe]注视你时，竟让狐狸多了一丝出人意料的阴森气息。[mitch.HisHer]尾巴尖端也散发相似的不祥光芒；它们围着狐仙甩动飞舞时，各自在身后留下一道发光雾迹。组合起来的景象惊人地诡异，为[mitch.heShe]悄无声息逼近时的狐人增添一层幽灵般的阴森气场。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour attention is quickly fixated upon the fluffy therapist however, as the darkening office reveals the sionach’s often hidden attribute. Mitch’s eyes brightly glow with cyan bioluminescence, giving the fox a surprisingly sinister flair as [mitch.heShe] stares your way. [mitch.HisHer] tail tips share a similar, baleful glow, each leaving behind a glowing trail of mist in their wake as they flick and dance around the kitsune. The resulting combination is surprisingly haunting, adding an eerily phantasmal aura to the vulpine as [mitch.heShe] silently stalks over."

rows.original: “I want you to stare into my eyes,” Mitch orders with a whisper, inching closer as [mitch.hisHers] stare deeply into yours. “Focus on my voice.”
rows.translation: “我要你注视我的眼睛。”米奇低声命令，一边靠近，一边让[mitch.hisHers]目光深深望进你的双眼。“专注于我的声音。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I want you to stare into my eyes,” Mitch orders with a whisper, inching closer as [mitch.hisHers] stare deeply into yours. “Focus on my voice.”"

rows.original: Complying with the request, you relax as you focus onto those approaching, glowing orbs. You can’t help but notice the therapist’s tails flaring out with each slow step, before their tips begin to wiggle along the edges of your vision. The distracting movement threatens to drag your attention away from the vulpine’s eyes, but you keep your sight fixed in place as the fox’s face inches closer and closer.
rows.translation: 你顺从要求，放松下来，把注意力集中在那双逐渐靠近、闪闪发光的眼睛上。治疗师每迈出缓慢的一步，尾巴都会向外展开，尾尖开始在你视野边缘轻轻晃动，你不禁注意到了这一点。那令人分心的动作几乎要把你的注意力从狐人的眼睛上扯开，但你仍牢牢盯着原处，看着那张脸越来越近。
rows.raw: "\n\nComplying with the request, you relax as you focus onto those approaching, glowing orbs. You can’t help but notice the therapist’s tails flaring out with each slow step, before their tips begin to wiggle along the edges of your vision. The distracting movement threatens to drag your attention away from the vulpine’s eyes, but you keep your sight fixed in place as the fox’s face inches closer and closer."

rows.original: “Try not to blink,” Mitch urges, [mitch.hisHer] voice quiet but firm. “Keep staring into my eyes. We’re going to relax your thoughts by steadying your breathing. Follow my rhythm: Breathe in, and breathe out. All the way in. All the way out. In. Out. Relax, but don’t lose your focus. Keep staring into my eyes.”
rows.translation: “尽量别眨眼。”米奇催促道，[mitch.hisHer]声音轻柔却坚定。“继续看着我的眼睛。我们要用平稳的呼吸让你的思绪放松。跟随我的节奏：吸气，然后呼气。彻底吸入。彻底呼出。吸气。呼气。放松，但不要失去专注。继续看着我的眼睛。”

rows.translation: 穿过垂挂的淡紫色帘布，你走进一片宽敞开放的办公空间。与建筑朴素得过分的外观不同，内部这间布置齐全的房间竟营造出一种出人意料的舒适氛围，还略带黑色电影风格。硕大窗户占据了墙面，每扇玻璃后都呈现着一片乌云密布、遭受雨水洗礼的城市景观。这些窗口显然都是模拟的，却丝毫没有让它们发出的舒缓雨滴声变得不够真实。房间每个角落都耸立着大型盆栽，修长茎秆上盛开着深紫色花朵。它们的存在不只出于装饰考虑，宜人的花香正萦绕在办公室空气中。
rows.raw: "\n\nPassing through the hanging mauve sheets, you step into a large, open office space. Unlike the building’s blatantly unadorned exterior, the furnished room within manages to exude a surprisingly comforting, somewhat noir vibe. Large windows dominate the walls, each depicting a cloudy, rain drenched cityscape within their glassy panes. The apertures are very clearly simulated, though that doesn’t stop the soothing wet pattering they’re producing from sounding any less genuine. From each corner of the room loom large potted plants, which bear dark purple flowers along their lengthy stems. Their presence is more than just a decorative decision, as the pleasant scent of their floral perfume hangs in the office air."

rows.original: Your eyes are eventually drawn towards the center of the room, where they find a large, rather extravagantly crafted chaise lounge padded with royal red cushions. An equally ornate office desk sits just off to its side, the reflective sheen of its dark, grainy wood marred by what appear to be splotches of pale white along its otherwise glossy veneer. Both appear to be the only real functional furnishings present within the otherwise lacking space, though they aren’t what garner the bulk of your attention. Rather, your focus fixates on the individual who’s been silently waiting behind the desk since the moment you walked in.
rows.translation: 你的目光最终被房间中央吸引，在那里发现了一张硕大而制作华丽的贵妃椅，上面铺着皇家红色软垫。旁边不远处摆着一张同样华丽的办公桌；深色木材纹理清晰，本应光亮的漆面却被几块苍白污渍破坏了反光光泽。除此之外，这片空荡空间里似乎再也没有真正具有实际用途的家具，不过它们并不是最吸引你注意的东西。你的焦点反而锁定在办公桌后方，从你进门那一刻起便一直默默等待的人身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes are eventually drawn towards the center of the room, where they find a large, rather extravagantly crafted chaise lounge padded with royal red cushions. An equally ornate office desk sits just off to its side, the reflective sheen of its dark, grainy wood marred by what appear to be splotches of pale white along its otherwise glossy veneer. Both appear to be the only real functional furnishings present within the otherwise lacking space, though they aren’t what garner the bulk of your attention. Rather, your focus fixates on the individual who’s been silently waiting behind the desk since the moment you walked in."

rows.original: The sitting figure appears to be a rather effeminate looking kitsune, sporting short, plum colored hair messily wreathed around his – you’re assuming ‘his’, at least – rather petite shaped head. A pair of arms rest folded neatly in front of him, both sheathed in purple fur from elbow to wrist. His cyan clawed fingers gently tap against a coffee mug, the sound nearly muffled by the constant white noise of rain. The figure’s similarly cyan eyes are humanoid, their round pupils appraising you back as you take them in. The vulpine’s irises almost appear to be glowing as they stare your way, though the light of the room isn’t quite dark enough to verify that claim. Two fox ears are next to grab your attention, both of which look to be easily double the length of their head. They tower almost comically over the kitsune, their innards stuffed to the brim with puffy white fluff. The oversized [silly|radar dishes| appendages] loom precariously over a pair of slender white horns, which sprout out enough to breach through the vulpine’s fluffy, overly disheveled hair.
rows.translation: 坐着的人似乎是一名外表颇为女性化的九尾狐；淡紫色短发凌乱地环绕着他那形状相当小巧的脑袋，你至少猜想应该称作“他”。一双手臂整齐地叠放在面前，从肘部到手腕都覆盖着紫色毛发。他长着青蓝色爪子的手指轻轻敲击咖啡杯，声音几乎被持续不断的雨声白噪音掩盖。这个人同样呈青蓝色的双眼形似人类；当你打量时，那双圆形瞳孔也在评估你。狐人的虹膜望向你时几乎仿佛正在发光，不过房间还没有暗到足以证实这一点。接着吸引你注意的是两只狐耳，每一只看起来都足有他脑袋的两倍长。它们近乎滑稽地高高耸立在九尾狐头顶，内侧塞满了蓬松白绒。这对超大的[silly|雷达天线|附肢]危险地悬在一双纤细白角上方；那对白角从狐人蓬松而过分凌乱的头发中钻出，显露在外。

rows.original: Your perusing eyes eventually wander their way behind the patiently waiting fox, where you finally notice a large mass of swirling, plum colored motion.
rows.translation: 你四处审视的目光最终游移到耐心等待的狐狸身后，终于注意到一大团不断旋转的梅紫色动态。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour perusing eyes eventually wander their way behind the patiently waiting fox, where you finally notice a large mass of swirling, plum colored motion. "

rows.original: what the churning chaos of violet color actually is: exceptionally long, overly fluffy fox tails! You can just barely make out nine of them, each ceaselessly sliding over one another in an enchantingly smooth, dissonant motion. Their fuzzy ends share that same cyan color the fox’s eyes do, almost as if they were each individually dipped like a painter’s brush. Their perpetual movement is incredibly hypnotizing to watch; each tail endlessly brushing and slipping over and around each other like a ball of fluffy, agitated snakes. Wiggle, swish, flick, and sway.
rows.translation: ，你才看清这片翻腾的紫色混沌究竟是什么：异常修长、蓬松过头的狐狸尾巴！你勉强能辨认出九条，每一条都永不停歇地彼此滑过，以迷人顺畅却又并不协调的动作移动。它们毛茸茸的尾端与狐狸双眼呈现相同的青蓝色，仿佛每条尾巴都像画笔一样被单独蘸过颜料。那永恒不止的动作令人难以置信地着迷；每条尾巴都无休止地彼此摩擦，从同伴上方、下方与周围滑过，宛如一团毛茸茸而躁动的蛇。扭动、扫摆、轻弹、摇曳。

rows.original: “A little shy, are we?”
rows.translation: “有点害羞，是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A little shy, are we?”"

rows.original: The softly spoken words startle your attention back to the now highly bemused fox’s face. You were so focused on the hypnotic worming of all those numerous, fluffy tails that you forgot that someone was attached to the ends of them!
rows.translation: 轻声说出的话把你的注意力惊得回到狐狸脸上，而他如今显然觉得十分好笑。你刚才实在太过专注于那一大群毛茸尾巴催眠般的蜿蜒动作，竟忘了尾巴末端还连着一个人！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe softly spoken words startle your attention back to the now highly bemused fox’s face. You were so focused on the hypnotic worming of all those numerous, fluffy tails that you forgot that someone was attached to the ends of them!"

rows.original: “No, That’s not the full story,” he mutters quickly, eyes scrunched in deep thought. “You’re a difficult one to read. Too difficult, even. It’s almost as if you don’t really exist, do you? As if you’re just a puppet; an avatar even. Something made solely to be manipulated and altered by someone else, for their own enjoyment perhaps?” He chuckles softly, before shifting a bit in his seat. “Well, I certainly hope they take good care of you. And me, for that matter.”
rows.translation: “不，事情并不只是这样，”他迅速低声说道，双眼因沉思而眯紧。“你是个很难读懂的人。甚至难得过头。几乎就像你并不真正存在，对吗？仿佛你只是一具傀儡，甚至是一具化身。完全是为了让其他人操控、改变才创造出的东西，也许只是供他们自己取乐？”他轻声笑了起来，随后在座位上稍稍挪动。“好吧，我当然希望他们会好好照顾你。顺便也好好照顾我。”

As if you’re just a puppet; an avatar even. Something made solely to be manipulated and altered by someone else, for their own enjoyment perhaps?” He chuckles softly, before shifting a bit in his seat. “Well, I certainly hope they take good care of you. And me, for that matter.”"

Their feisty shifting is threatening to drag your vision away again, a fact the smiling fox is all too aware of. You can’t help but shake your head in amusement, a smirk growing along your face as you do your best to keep your focus on the playful kitsune. |“No,” the fox mutters quickly after, his eyes almost staring through yours. “That’s not quite it, is it? You’re not normally the shy type. No no, not at all. You’re the kind of no-nonsense person who likes things quick and simple. Blunt,” the vulpine chuckles, pausing to sip from his mug before continuing. “Worry not, I’m well aware that I’m distracting to look at. It’s something I’ve gotten quite used to,” he muses, grinning and shifting as their tails quicken their ever persistent wiggling. You roll your eyes at the display, crossing your arms across your [pc.chest] as you focus your attention back onto the fox. ]
rows.translation: [pc.nmh |被当场抓住明目张胆的凝视，你迅速涨红了脸，令九尾狐十分开心。“嗯，不，不是害羞。也许很体贴、很顾及别人，但不是害羞。完全不必担心。在这间办公室的墙壁内，你只会得到关怀与尊重，不会遭受窥探或评判。”九尾狐温暖地微笑，轻柔的语调听起来几乎令人着迷。你回以微笑，放松下来，把注意力集中在狐人身上。 |“不，不完全是这样，”他很快低声说道；说话时，那双眼睛几乎要看进你的身体。“你属于那种享受一个人全部特质的类型，会把对方能给予的一切统统吸收。每一个。微小的。细节。”九尾狐得意地咧嘴笑着，尾尖泛光的尾巴随着这番宣言来回轻弹。那些活泼的动作险些再次拖走你的视线，而微笑的狐狸对此心知肚明。你忍不住觉得好笑地摇摇头，脸上浮现坏笑，同时竭力将注意力保持在顽皮的九尾狐身上。 |“不，”狐狸很快低声说道，那双眼睛几乎要穿透你的目光。“不完全是这样，对吗？你平常不是害羞的类型。不不，完全不是。你是那种不喜欢废话、偏爱事情迅速简单的人。直截了当，”狐人轻笑道，停下来喝了一口杯中饮料，才继续开口。“别担心，我很清楚自己的外表很容易让人分心。我早就已经习惯了，”他若有所思地说，同时咧嘴挪动身体；那些尾巴始终不停的扭动也变得更快。你朝这番表演翻了翻眼睛，将双臂交叉抱在[pc.chest]前，把注意力重新放回狐狸身上。 ]

rows.original: Despite your best efforts, it takes only a few seconds before your eyes become helplessly enchanted again. The vulpine sighs, noticing your focus returning to the flicking and swaying of those delightfully wiggly tails. “No, that’s not quite it. Your mind is just easily distracted, isn’t it? A real shame. What happened to allow your mind to become like this.” You blink, the mumbled words enough to pause your tail watching long enough to focus back on the small kitsune’s face.
rows.translation: 尽管你已经竭尽全力，短短几秒后双眼还是无助地再次遭到迷惑。狐人注意到你的注意力又回到了那些欢快扭动的尾巴上，看着它们轻弹、摇摆，因而叹了口气。“不，不完全是这样。你的心智只是很容易分心，对吗？真可惜。究竟发生过什么，才让你的心智变成这样。”你眨了眨眼；这几句低声话语足以让你暂停欣赏尾巴，重新把注意力放回小巧九尾狐的脸上。

rows.original: As the two of you stare each other down however, you soon notice a distracted look growing upon the vulpine’s own face. Their eyes are still, appearing almost transfixed as the fox goes silent. You set a hand on your [pc.hip] as you wait, only to notice their eyes shifting subtly with the swaying of your movement. It takes another experimental wiggle of your shoulders to confirm your growing suspicions: The small fox has their eyes firmly set on your [pc.chest]! You clear your throat loudly, which is enough to shake the fluffy kitsune out of their stupor. “O-oh! My apologies, I u-uh, m-my mind was, wandering,” the vulpine clearly lies, their eyes now avoiding your upper half as they shift in their seat.
rows.translation: 然而，当你们彼此对视时，你很快注意到狐人自己的脸上也逐渐浮现出心不在焉的神情。狐狸沉默下来，双眼一动不动，似乎几乎看得入迷。你把一只手搭在[pc.hip]上等待，却注意到他的眼睛随着你的摆动而微妙地移动。你又试探性地晃了晃肩膀，终于证实逐渐产生的怀疑：小狐狸的视线牢牢锁定在[pc.chest]上！你大声清了清嗓子，足以把毛茸茸的九尾狐从恍惚中惊醒。“哦、哦！非常抱歉，我，呃，脑、脑子刚才走神了，”狐人明显在说谎。他在座位上挪动身体，如今那双眼睛正竭力避开你的上半身。

rows.original: Something else catches your attention... or more specifically, your psionic sense. Ever since entering the hallway, a peculiar feeling has been rippling along your aetheric perception, pouring over it like an imperceptible stream. Now that you’re in the office proper though, that stream has since become a torrent, one that now flows firmly enough to make you wonder if even those unattuned are capable of feeling its persistent pressure. The source of this ethereal emanation is no doubt the petite figure that sits before you, though if he’s aware of its effect on you he doesnt show it.
rows.translation: 还有别的东西吸引了你的注意... 更准确地说，是吸引了你的灵能感知。自从进入走廊，一种奇特感觉便在以太感知中泛起涟漪，如一股无法察觉的溪流漫过其上。不过如今正式进入办公室后，那条溪流已经化作洪流；它涌动得如此强烈，让你不禁怀疑，即使是没有灵能感应力的人也能否感受到那股持续不断的压力。这股空灵辐射的源头无疑正是坐在面前的娇小身影；不过他即使知道它对你的影响，也没有表现出来。

Ever since entering the hallway, a peculiar feeling has been rippling along your aetheric perception, pouring over it like an imperceptible stream. Now that you’re in the office proper though, that stream has since become a torrent, one that now flows firmly enough to make you wonder if even those unattuned are capable of feeling its persistent pressure. The source of this ethereal emanation is no doubt the petite figure that sits before you, though if he’s aware of its effect on you he doesnt show it."

rows.original: The purple fox pauses to sip from his mug, before returning his gaze your way. “In any case, It’s clear curiosity is what brought you inside my little office. Ah, there’s no need to remain standing. Please, have a seat.” A clawed hand motions to the chaise beside the desk, drawing your attention towards the rather fancy piece of furniture. The ornate bench-like chair appears designed to accept a multitude of patrons, be they big or small. It even looks sturdy enough to hold large taurs comfortably!
rows.translation: 紫色狐狸停下来喝了一口杯中饮料，随后重新望向你。“无论如何，显然是好奇心把你带进了我的小办公室。啊，你不必一直站着。请坐吧。”一只带爪的手指向办公桌旁的贵妃椅，将你的注意力引向这件相当华丽的家具。那张样式精美的长椅似乎专为接待各种客人而设计，无论体型大小都不成问题。它看起来甚至坚固得足以让大型牛形生物舒适地坐下！

Ah, there’s no need to remain standing. Please, have a seat.” A clawed hand motions to the chaise beside the desk, drawing your attention towards the rather fancy piece of furniture. The ornate bench-like chair appears designed to accept a multitude of patrons, be they big or small. It even looks sturdy enough to hold large taurs comfortably!"

rows.original: You decide to put that theory to the test as you [pc.walk] over to it, before carefully adjusting yourself to lower down onto its luxurious red cushions. Incredibly, it manages to hold firm against the weight of your hefty stature, and even smoothly bends to better support the shape of your body’s unique physique! Warmth radiates against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] from what must be a heating unit embedded within the padding, allowing you to comfortably settle with a relieved sigh as you settle in place. It’s nice to get the weight off your legs, and you allow yourself to fully relax as you face the softly smiling kitsune.
rows.translation: 你决定检验这个理论，[pc.walk]到贵妃椅旁，随后小心调整身体，向奢华的红色软垫坐下。难以置信的是，它在你沉重身躯的分量下依旧稳固，甚至还顺畅弯曲，以便更好地支撑你独特的体形！想必软垫内部嵌有加热装置，一股暖意正贴着[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]散发出来；你舒适地安顿下来，松了口气。能让双腿卸下负担实在惬意；面对轻柔微笑的九尾狐，你让自己彻底放松。

rows.original: [pc.kmhbb |“Sure,” you reply, smiling politely |“Yea yea,” you grumble |“Well, if you insist,” you tease, smirking |“Sure!” you giggle, hips swaying |“Thanks,” you grunt, relaxing a bit ] as you move towards the lounge. It takes only a few steps before you’re smoothly adjusting to settle onto the lounge’s luxurious red fabric. it’s just as comfortable as it appeared to be, made more so by a heating unit you feel working within the thick padding. There’s even a little pillow on the end to rest your head upon, though you ignore it for now as you opt to sit and face the happily smiling kitsune.
rows.translation: [pc.kmhbb |“好吧，”你礼貌地微笑着回答 |“好好好，”你抱怨道 |“嗯，既然你坚持，”你坏笑着调侃 |“当然！”你咯咯笑着，臀部来回摇摆 |“谢谢，”你低哼道，稍稍放松 ]，同时走向躺椅。只走了几步，你便顺畅地调整身体，在躺椅奢华的红色布面上坐下。它和看起来一样舒适，厚软垫里正在运转的加热装置更是锦上添花。末端甚至还有一个小枕头可以让你靠头休息，不过你暂时没有理会，而是选择坐着面对开心微笑的九尾狐。

There’s even a little pillow on the end to rest your head upon, though you ignore it for now as you opt to sit and face the happily smiling kitsune."

rows.original: “Better?” the fox asks, sneaking another sip. You shift slightly on the comfy padding before nodding an affirmation towards the kitsune, whose smile grows. “Perfect! Well then, It’s finally time for some proper introductions. My name is Mitch, although it shouldn’t come as too much of a surprise with the sign hanging above my door,” the kitsune jokes, chuckling lightly before clearing his throat almost apologetically. “I uh, had this little office built so I could offer my services as a therapist. It’s unbelievable how many people forgo their own mental well-being while they’re out and about.” The kitsune sighs at the thought, before tilting his head and allowing one of his big ears to sag. “And who might you be?”
rows.translation: “好些了吗？”狐狸问道，又偷喝了一口。你在舒适的软垫上稍稍挪动，随后向九尾狐点头确认，他脸上的笑容也更加明显。“太好了！那么，终于该正式自我介绍了。我的名字是米奇，不过门上方挂着招牌，这应该算不上太令人惊讶，”九尾狐开玩笑道，轻声笑了起来，随后近乎歉意地清了清嗓子。“我，呃，请人建造了这间小办公室，以便提供自己的治疗师服务。实在难以置信，有那么多人在外面四处奔波时，竟会完全放弃自己的心理健康。”想到这里，九尾狐叹了口气，随后歪过脑袋，让一只大耳朵耷拉下来。“那么，你又是谁呢？”

rows.translation: “我的名字？”你出声思索，随后倒吸一口气。“哦，对了！是[pc.fullname]！真高兴认识你这样的小可爱！”你滔滔不绝地说道，对毛茸茸的狐人开心微笑。
rows.raw: "“My name?” you wonder aloud, before gasping. “Oh right! It’s [pc.fullname]! It’s so nice to meet a cutie like you!” you gush, smiling happily at the fluffy vulpine."

rows.original: The kitsune perks up sharply, his fluffy ears making a barely audible snap as they rise to attention. “Wait, Steele? Like the Steele? Like that magnate’s heir that’s searching around the Rush for their inheritance? That Steele?” The purple fox squirms, his cyan clawed fingers tapping against the mug while his tails quicken their pace. “To think that someone so important just waltzed right into my little office.”
rows.translation: 九尾狐猛然打起精神，毛茸茸的耳朵竖起警觉时发出几不可闻的啪响。“等等，斯蒂尔？是那个斯蒂尔？那个正在行星开拓潮中到处寻找遗产的大亨继承人？那个斯蒂尔？”紫色狐狸扭动起来；他长着青蓝色爪子的手指不断敲击杯子，尾巴也加快了动作。“没想到这么重要的人竟直接大摇大摆地走进了我的小办公室。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kitsune perks up sharply, his fluffy ears making a barely audible snap as they rise to attention. “Wait, Steele? Like the Steele? Like that magnate’s heir that’s searching around the Rush for their inheritance? That Steele?” The purple fox squirms, his cyan clawed fingers tapping against the mug while his tails quicken their pace. “To think that someone so important just waltzed right into my little office.”"

rows.original: You remind the flustered fox that you’re not that important. Not yet, at least. You’ve still got a race to win.
rows.translation: 你提醒慌乱的狐狸，自己还没那么重要。至少现在还没有。你还有一场竞赛要赢。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remind the flustered fox that you’re not that important. Not yet, at least. You’ve still got a race to win."

rows.original: “Maybe not, but you’re no common slouch either. N-not that any patients I see aren’t special, they’re just not Steele special.” The [silly|smol|small] kitsune sits back, his lithe body squishing some of his many tails into the chair. “Although I really shouldn’t be saying that either! All of my patients are special in their own unique ways, and I’m sure your problems won’t be any different than theirs,” he muses, hands rubbing around the well worn sides of his mug. “Well, I think we’ve gotten that out of the way. Was there something you wanted from me while you’re here? Perhaps you’d like to try out some of my therapy?” Mitch asks, ears smoothly rotating until their white fluffy insides are facing your way as he intently waits for your next inquiry.
rows.translation: “也许不算，但你同样不是普通的等闲之辈。倒、倒不是说我接待的患者不够特殊，只是他们没有斯蒂尔那么特殊。”这名[silly|小小|小巧]的九尾狐靠向椅背，纤细的身体把众多尾巴中的几条压进椅子。“不过我其实也不该这么说！我的所有患者都以各自独特的方式与众不同；我敢肯定，你的问题不会和他们有多大不同，”他若有所思地说道，双手不断摩擦杯子已经磨损的侧面。“好吧，我想这些事已经说清楚了。你来到这里，是想从我这里得到什么吗？也许你想试试我的治疗？”米奇问道。双耳顺畅转动，直到毛茸茸的白色内侧朝向你；他专心等待你的下一个问题。

rows.original: She’s a cute half-ausar; probably about six foot tall not including the near-foot of wolf-ear height. Her brown hair is tied up in a ponytail that passes her shoulder, with scruffy bangs that rest just above pale blue eyes and soft-looking feminine features. She also seems to have the kind of skin that looks like it’s lost a fair amount of tan. Probably the result of spending a long time cooped up in a ship. It’s impossible to miss the huge fluffy tail that idly wags from side-to-side as she’s observed on the bar-stool, poking out from a tail-hole cut into some tight black jeans.

rows.original: Still she doesn’t look entirely blasted. “Something about me draw you in? Perhaps you’re just looking to kill some time.” She pauses for a moment, pulling out a palm-sized looking datapad. It chirps at her and she smiles brightly, tail wagging. “Sorry, got mail. Anyway, please! Tell me about yourself [pc.name]. I’ve got enough drink in me to actually manage being sociable.”
rows.translation: 不过她看起来依然没有完全烂醉。“我身上有什么吸引了你？也许你只是想打发点时间。”她停顿片刻，取出一块手掌大小的数据板。设备朝她发出啾鸣，她顿时灿烂微笑，尾巴来回摇摆。“抱歉，收到邮件了。总之，请说吧！跟我讲讲你自己的事，[pc.name]。我已经喝了足够多的酒，现在真能应付社交了。”

rows.original: “At least for a while. There was some drama with our sister ship nearly getting ripped out of orbit and dying, and then some Rushers turned up. Then some pirates turned up chasing after those Rushers.” She pauses, shrugging and draining her glass “and then there was a diplomatic incident when a bunch of Rushers made first contact with a paradise planet full of sexy floating mermaid people.”
rows.translation: “至少开始一段时间是这样。后来姊妹船差点被扯出轨道、全员送命，闹出了一场大乱子；接着又有一些拓荒者出现了。然后一些追赶那些拓荒者的海盗也出现了。”她停顿下来，耸耸肩，将杯中酒一饮而尽。“再后来，一群拓荒者与一颗天堂般的星球进行首次接触；那里全是性感的漂浮人鱼，于是又发生了一场外交事件。”

rows.original: You saunter into Kally’s bar, soaking in the atmosphere and taking in the sights. Perched up on a barstool is a familiar half-Ausar, Perdita, and they seem to be the first to notice your arrival. Large pointed wolf-ears peak out from scruffy auburn hair, and a long fluffy tail gently wags from side to side as she waves at you. Her tan skin is lightly dusted with freckles compared to the first time you saw her, evidence of a little more time spent in the sun perhaps.
rows.translation: 你悠然走进卡莉的酒吧，沉浸在氛围中，欣赏眼前景象。一名熟悉的半奥萨尔佩尔迪塔正坐在吧凳上，而她似乎是第一个注意到你到来的人。一对又大又尖的狼耳从凌乱的赤褐色头发中探出；她向你挥手时，一条修长蓬松的尾巴轻轻左右摇摆。与初次见面相比，她古铜色的肌肤上零星点缀着一些雀斑，也许证明她最近晒了更多太阳。
rows.raw: "You saunter into Kally’s bar, soaking in the atmosphere and taking in the sights. Perched up on a barstool is a familiar half-Ausar, Perdita, and they seem to be the first to notice your arrival. Large pointed wolf-ears peak out from scruffy auburn hair, and a long fluffy tail gently wags from side to side as she waves at you. Her tan skin is lightly dusted with freckles compared to the first time you saw her, evidence of a little more time spent in the sun perhaps."

rows.original: It also seems that she had some genetic work done; her eyes are a gently-glowing lavender, although somewhat fuzzy thanks to the stack of empty glasses lined up on the table. rows.original: You ask her what it is she does on the surface of Vesperia. “I’m a mineralogist, contracted with one of the big companies,” she replies, twirling her cocktail stick. “Stuck down a mine, taking samples and working out where best to stick those big-ass bores next. It’s a babysitting job half the time, state of the roughnecks I work with. You’d think they were there just for the pissing contests.” Still, geology is an interesting field... “Sure used to think so. Then I got shoved down a hole in the middle of nowhere for two years, with nothing but a bunch of smelly, oversized taurs for company.” She laughs suddenly, a burst of brassy music. “It’s not so bad, honey; it’s a living you know? But I don’t wanna talk shop right now.” She looks at you unerringly. “I wanna talk about you.”
rows.translation: 你问她在维斯佩里亚地表做什么工作。 “我是矿物学家，跟一家大公司签了合同，”她一边回答，一边转着鸡尾酒签。“整天困在矿井下面取样，再算算下一台巨型钻机该往哪儿扎。有一半时间都在替人带孩子，就我共事的那帮钻井工那德性。你会以为他们下去就是为了比谁尿得远。” 不过，地质学毕竟是个有趣的领域... “我以前当然也这么想。然后我被塞进鸟不拉屎地方的洞里待了两年，陪我的只有一群又臭又壮的半兽人。”她忽然笑出声，像铜管乐猛然奏响。“也没那么糟，甜心，毕竟靠它吃饭嘛。不过我现在不想谈工作。”她准确无误地望向你。“我想聊聊你。”

rows.original: You smile and begin to tell her about yourself. You’re [pc.name] Steele and are just passing through Canadia. Really you’re on this crazy mission to find your father Victor’s fortune... “Wait. Hold up.” Suze goggles at you. “The Victor Steele? As in, owner of Steele Tech?” Well, formerly, but yes. “The mining company?” That would be correct. “And you’re his [pc.son].” The amazonian frowns at you, a smile spreading over her face, before she laughs and looks away. “Naw. I can’t deal. I can’t go out with — I could never — but you’re kidding, right?”

You’re sorry, but she’s just going to have to cope with the fact that you are who you say you are. “I’m... not sure if I really believe you.” A cool barrier has descended between you and Suze. She frowns at you over the rim of her cocktail glass. “Look, thank you for, uh... the caring attitude. I mean it, I really do. But I can’t go out with the boss, or the boss’s baby, or someone pretending to be the boss’s baby — whatever. I’d never be able to relax.” She touches your hand with a regretful smile. “Later, honey. It’s been... weird.” And so you find yourself back at the bar, blown off in a truly bizarre manner. Suze will be back when she’s next portside, if you fancy giving it another shot.

Going deep into the guts of spaceships with your [silly|sonic screwdriver|toolkit], replacing sheets of armor, fitting expensive upgrades — it’s hard but rewarding work. She chokes slightly. “Sorry [pc.name],” she says with a grin, once she’s taken some water. “It’s just when you say background it makes me think of, like, some bitch in a dress suit, you know, a comfy resume. Not growing up in a two-room apartment near the bottom of a res-hive. Ma died when I was pretty young and pa’s a lab cleaner. My background’s Nesbourg 32nd Lower, that’s the truth.” Oh. You’re sorry. “Why?” She looks at you impassively. “I never knew ma, so no bad memories there. Pa took care of me when he could, and when he couldn’t, the streets did. People think places like that are shark tanks or something — they ain’t. They just teach you how to stand on your own two feet young[pc.isBiped|| — no offense - ] and what’s really important in life. Like looking after your sucker. Eat your salad, honey. It’ll make you nice ‘n stretchy.”
rows.translation: “杜桑星的内斯堡。你不知道在哪儿也别担心，我没觉得受冒犯，”你还没来得及插话，苏兹便说道。“那颗星球早在第四次行星热潮时就被殖民了。当年漂亮得不得了：美丽的平原、云雾森林之类的东西，光看影像都让人喉咙发紧...说实话，现在有点脏乱了。要供养二十亿人类，不牺牲几分姿色可办不到。” “你是什么出身？”她正叉起另一块粉嫩的异龙肉时，你问道。她轻轻呛了一下。 “抱歉，[pc.name]，”喝了点水后，她笑着说道。“只是你说‘出身’时，我想到的会是那种穿职业套装的贱人，你懂吧，一份光鲜舒服的履历。可不是在住宅蜂巢底层附近的两室公寓里长大。我很小的时候妈妈就死了，爸爸是实验室清洁工。我的出身就是内斯堡下层第三十二区，这才是实话。” 哦。你很遗憾。 “为什么？”她面无表情地望着你。“我从没认识过妈妈，所以也没什么糟糕回忆。爸爸有余力时就照顾我，没余力时街坊会照顾我。人们总觉得那种地方是什么鲨鱼池，其实不是。它们只是让你很小就学会靠自己的双脚站稳[pc.isBiped||，无意冒犯]，也让你明白人生中真正重要的东西。比如照顾好自己的小舔狗。把沙拉吃掉，甜心。它会让你变得柔软又有韧性。”

rows.original: “My school had a UGC grant scheme, for kids from poor backgrounds. Get good enough grades in the right subjects, and you can apply for a subsidized uni education. That’s how I got my degree.” Really? “Heh, naw.” Suze’s laugh has a bitter edge. “Only 1 in 5000 gets one of those, and it don’t matter if you worked your ass off in science if you can’t roll that dice and get it to land first time. So I had to do it the hard way.” She inhales a mouthful of green leaves and doesn’t continue until she’s swallowed. “You get ads constantly when you start maxin’ out your scores in your last year at high school. Companies offering to pay your way through uni — for a price. You gotta take it if you wanna get anywhere. Corpos love talking up goin’ in at the bottom and working your way up, but you got zero chance of doing that if you’re some raggedy ass ho from Toussaint. ‘less you take a gig on an outer colony, and hope enough peeps get capped or knapped above you for you to take their space.” So — what? She chose to get indentured? “‘S right.” The human smirks humorlessly. “Course when it’s white collar level they don’t like calling it that, exactly. I’m contracted to Steele Tech, ‘til such time as I’ve paid off my time at Neu Zurich. I don’t have to wear a collar, I just get the odd call to make sure I’m still where I’m s’posed to be, ‘n extranet messages reminding me of my duties and privileges whilst I’m in their service, busting my ass down one of their mines for nothing. It’s a real polite kinda slavery.” Did she enjoy her uni days at least? “It was — alright.” She grimaces a bit. “Kinda too squeaky clean for me. Took me a while to find people I fit in with. Man, I hadn’t even really found myself then.” She smiles and looks down, shifting in her seat a bit. “Mostly I remember how in awe pa was every time he visited. Gawping at the atriums and the libraries, like a damn tourist. Only thing he wasn’t impressed with was the labs. ‘Someone needs to knock some technician heads together round here, they ain’t clean!’ So Onedamn embarrassing.” She looks down, cheeks blazing with the pride of a daddy’s girl who overachieved.
rows.translation: “我们学校有个 UGC 补助计划，专门帮助家境贫寒的孩子。只要相关科目成绩够好，就能申请大学学费补贴。我的学位就是这么来的。” 真的？ “哈，才怪。”苏泽的笑声带着一丝苦涩。“那种补助五千个人里才有一个能拿到。你再怎么拼命学理科也没用，除非你掷出的骰子头一回就正好落在对的一面。所以我只能走那条难走的路。” 她吞下一大口绿叶菜，咽干净后才继续说下去。 “高中最后一年，你的成绩一开始冲到顶，各种广告就会没完没了地找上门。公司说愿意出钱供你上大学——当然是有代价的。想出人头地，你就非接受不可。企业最爱吹嘘什么从底层干起、一步步往上爬，可你要是个来自图桑、衣衫褴褛的穷婊子，根本连半点机会都没有。除非你去外殖民地接份差事，盼着上头的人多死几个或者多失踪几个，好让你补上他们的位置。” 所以——什么？她自愿签了卖身契？ “没错。”人类毫无笑意地咧了咧嘴。“当然，到了白领这个层次，他们可不爱这么直说。我与斯蒂尔科技签有合约，直到偿清在新苏黎世上学所耗的费用为止。我不用戴项圈，只是偶尔会接到电话，确认我还待在该待的地方；外网上还会发来消息，提醒我在为他们效力期间享有哪些义务和权利——也就是在他们的矿井里白干活，累死累活。算是一种特别有礼貌的奴役。” 那她至少享受过大学时光吗？ “还——行吧。”她微微皱起脸。“那里对我来说有点干净得过头。我花了好久才找到合得来的人。天啊，那时候我甚至还没真正找到自我呢。”她笑着低下头，在座位上稍稍挪了挪。“我印象最深的，还是老爸每次来参观时那副敬畏的样子。瞪着中庭和图书馆看个不停，跟个该死的游客似的。唯独实验室没能让他满意。‘这里得有人把那群技术员的脑袋敲到一块儿去，根本没打扫干净！’真是诸一神在上，尴尬死了。” 她垂下目光，脸颊因为身为一个出人头地的老爸乖女儿而自豪得通红。

rows.original: What does she think about her employers? “Steele Tech? They’re... fine.” She wrinkles her nose as she slices off another cut of medium-rare theropod. “I ain’t stupid, I did my research before accepting the indenturehood offer. There are corps out there that’ll take you for a ride — or worse. ST more or less play it straight. They tell you up front, you’ll be away on their front line for a good long while, ‘n if you don’t keep your nose clean... well, there’s always another broke-ass bitch waiting to be plucked out of the ghetto. They give you a decent enough living stipend so I can do shit like this...” She waves her knife at the table. “...and they do alright by you. Like, when I asked for a gene mod to improve my happiness, you know...” The knife waggles down towards her crotch. “...they got that done for me real quick. More time on the contract of course, but not all that much.” Any negatives? “Listen sucker, they’re a giant, soulless, mineral extraction company. They ‘n all the other corps here are sucking the marrow out of this defenseless planet and leaving it a hollowed out, polluted husk. I have to work for ‘em, but I don’t have to like ‘em. Far as ST in particular is concerned?” She taps her thumb against her cheek. “They cut corners where the ordinary miners are concerned real bad. They hire cheap and skimp on safety protocols. Me, I’m fine, cuz I’m a valuable nuff asset. But there’ve been accidents down the pits last few months that could’ve easily been fatal if things had fallen different. Literally.” Soooo, hypothetically Steele Tech could be doing more to be environmentally friendly — and its labor and safety practices need looking at? “Not used to people quizzing me ‘bout this stuff.” Suze frowns at you. “This is the type of shit you ordinarily gotta stop me sounding off about at the break platform. Why you so interested, sucker?” No reason.
rows.translation: 她怎么看自己的雇主？ “斯蒂尔科技？他们...还行。”她切下另一块五分熟的兽脚类肉，皱了皱鼻子。“我又不傻，接受契约奴工的邀约前当然调查过。有些公司会狠狠坑你——甚至干出更糟的事。斯蒂尔科技基本还算按规矩办事。他们一开始就会明说，你得在他们的前线待上很久；要是你不老实安分...呵，总有另一个身无分文的婊子等着被从贫民窟里拎出来。他们给的生活津贴还算过得去，至少我能干点像这样的事...” 她用餐刀朝桌面比画了一下。 “...而且待你也不坏。比如，我申请做个能让我更快乐的基因改造时，你懂的...”餐刀朝她胯间晃了晃。“...他们很快就替我办好了。当然，合约期限又加长了，不过也没加多少。” 没有什么坏处吗？ “听着，呆瓜，他们是一家庞大、冷血、没有灵魂的矿产开采公司。他们和这里其他所有公司都在吸干这颗毫无抵抗力的星球的骨髓，最后只留下一具被掏空、被污染的躯壳。我不得不替他们干活，可我没必要喜欢他们。至于斯蒂尔科技本身？” 她用拇指轻敲脸颊。 “他们在普通矿工身上偷工减料得特别厉害。专挑便宜的人雇，安全规程也能省则省。我倒没事，因为我算是够值钱的资产。可过去几个月矿井里出过几次事故，要是当时的情况稍微换个样，轻轻松松就会死人。真的是东西砸下来的那种‘换个样’。” 所——以，假设斯蒂尔科技本可以在环保方面做得更多——而且他们的用工和安全惯例也需要有人审查？ “我还真不习惯有人盘问我这些事。”苏泽皱眉看着你。“平时在休息平台上，别人都得想办法阻止我大谈这些破事。你怎么这么感兴趣，呆瓜？” 没什么原因。
