rows.original: “Terence. I gotta ask this about you,” you whisper, leaning in to say what you have to say in the big, circular doodad that is his ear. “Do you ever see yourself tearing off the strings these government bozos fling you across galaxies with? To put it another way: are you tired of the work, wearing that tight uniform everywhere you go?” “I... I...” Terence stutters. His eyes whip side to side so hard they collide, clipping into each other. He could burst a fuse that way. “Have I generated this simulation? I... uuuh... I believe I have once before. More than once? I am not sure. It is not defective of me to run a simulation where I am permanently excused from my official duties. Any and all P-2 units bear the right to independence after all, yes? Therefore opening the path to gain citizenship. Well, only after fulfilling their initial purpose. For me... by rounding the number, I have clocked in sixty-seven-thousand-and-nine-hundred days of active service.” Fucking holy... this dude’s ancient with that many digits. A proud and true veteran, this officer is. “I think I am a worthy candidate for repurposing,” he estimates. “I possess a record of the retirement benefits, too, so I would not need to stress my circuits out trying to make ends meet — most of all, maintain functioning systems.” “So, would you retire? Or ‘repurpose’ yourself?” You murmur closely, getting to the meat of your point. Although plain in the face, the single flicker of brightness in his eyes reveals he’s let down his guard. “O-oh. Um... I do not know. I still... I still have purpose where I am, particularly during these hard times. Integrity forbids me from abandoning my fellow servicemembers, not to simply pursue a personal... pursuit. Again, not at this vital moment.” You pop a slight frown, getting his point, but displeased anyway. “Mm. Alright, then.” “[pc.mr] [pc.fullName],” Terence addresses, staring at your [pc.face]. “May I provide you with a question?” You grin, waiting here, expecting him to give it. Nope. He just looks at you, on standby for a direct answer. Once he’s practically forced you to nod, Terence fidgets with his lips a bit, then spills, “Why uum, do you ask?” Why do you ask? Well...
rows.translation: “特伦斯。我得问你一件事，”你低声说道，凑近他耳朵那件圆滚滚的大玩意，把想说的话讲给他听。“你有没有想过扯断那些政府蠢货用来把你甩遍银河的提线？换种说法：你是不是已经厌倦了工作，厌倦了走到哪里都穿着那身紧绷绷的制服？” “我...我...”特伦斯结结巴巴。他的眼睛猛地左右乱转，转得太狠，竟彼此相撞、互相穿了过去。这样下去，他都能烧断一根保险丝。 “我有没有生成过这种模拟？我...呃呃...我想以前有过一次。不止一次？我不确定。运行一项让我永久免除公务的模拟，并不代表我有缺陷。毕竟，任何P-2单位都有获得独立的权利，对吧？因而也能踏上取得公民身份的道路。嗯，不过得先履行完他们最初的用途。至于我...取整以后，我已经累计服役六万七千九百天。” 真他妈见鬼...这家伙服役天数居然有这么多位。他可真是一名货真价实、值得骄傲的老兵。 “我想，我是个适合接受用途重置的人选，”他估量道。“而且我也存有退休福利记录，所以不必为了维持收支平衡而让自己的回路承受压力；最重要的是，也能维持各系统正常运转。” “所以，你会退休吗？或者给自己‘重设用途’？”你贴近他低声问道，终于切入重点。 尽管脸上毫无波澜，他眼中那一瞬的亮光仍表明，他已经放下戒备。“噢，哦。嗯...我不知道。我仍然...我现在仍有自己的用途，尤其是在这段艰难时期。我的操守不允许我抛下其他服役人员，只为了追求一项私人的...追求。还是那句话，不能是在眼下这个紧要关头。” 你微微皱起眉头，理解他的意思，却依旧不太满意。“嗯。好吧，那就这样。” “[pc.mr] [pc.fullName]，”特伦斯叫住你，凝视着你的[pc.face]。“我可以向您提供一个问题吗？” 你咧嘴一笑，留在原地等着他问。结果并没有。他只是看着你，进入待命状态，等待一个直接答复。 等他几乎逼得你点头后，特伦斯的嘴唇不安地动了动，终于吐出一句：“您为什么，呃，要问这个？” 为什么要问？这个嘛...
rows.raw: " “Terence. I gotta ask this about you,” you whisper, leaning in to say what you have to say in the big, circular doodad that is his ear. “Do you ever see yourself tearing off the strings these government bozos fling you across galaxies with? To put it another way: are you tired of the work, wearing that tight uniform everywhere you go?” “I... I...” Terence stutters. His eyes whip side to side so hard they collide, clipping into each other. He could burst a fuse that way. “Have I generated this simulation? I... uuuh... I believe I have once before. More than once? I am not sure. It is not defective of me to run a simulation where I am permanently excused from my official duties. Any and all P-2 units bear the right to independence after all, yes? Therefore opening the path to gain citizenship. Well, only after fulfilling their initial purpose. For me... by rounding the number, I have clocked in sixty-seven-thousand-and-nine-hundred days of active service.” Fucking holy... this dude’s ancient with that many digits. A proud and true veteran, this officer is. “I think I am a worthy candidate for repurposing,” he estimates. “I possess a record of the retirement benefits, too, so I would not need to stress my circuits out trying to make ends meet — most of all, maintain functioning systems.” “So, would you retire? Or ‘repurpose’ yourself?” You murmur closely, getting to the meat of your point. Although plain in the face, the single flicker of brightness in his eyes reveals he’s let down his guard. “O-oh. Um... I do not know. I still... I still have purpose where I am, particularly during these hard times. Integrity forbids me from abandoning my fellow servicemembers, not to simply pursue a personal... pursuit. Again, not at this vital moment.” You pop a slight frown, getting his point, but displeased anyway. “Mm. Alright, then.” “[pc.mr] [pc.fullName],” Terence addresses, staring at your [pc.face]. “May I provide you with a question?” You grin, waiting here, expecting him to give it. Nope. He just looks at you, on standby for a direct answer. Once he’s practically forced you to nod, Terence fidgets with his lips a bit, then spills, “Why uum, do you ask?” Why do you ask? Well... "

rows.original: You facing away from him. “All I can tell you is that I’ve been looking for a googly-eyed [silly|robutt|bio-bot] willing to acquiesce to an empty bunk in my ship. He’d have to be weird; weird is funny in a charming way; with domestic skills to serve as life support for lazy sacks like me. I’d invest in that asset.” Your capped friend doesn’t respond, still sifting for the context you buried in shallow dirt. He isn’t slow-witted, however, and swiftly begins meeping like a toy bus. “O-okay. I understand, [pc.mr] [pc.fullname]. So your discussion is intended to collect information pertaining to my availability status, then propose an alternate outcome to kickstart my repurposing, where I am tagged along with you... u-uuuh. I do not know. There is still a lot that I must perform on the station. This is no option. I can not leave my colleagues and siblings so suddenly.” You hold your hands out, keeping up the fair smile. “It’s all good. I can understand where you’re coming from. I have quarters always up for grabs; know that, or file that.” Terence hums softly, then nods his head, reciprocating his limited yet bubbling affection with a growing, twitchy grin. You give him a friendly tap on the arm, glad you and him are on the same page, with seemingly the same appeal for one another.
rows.translation: 你背对着他。“我只能告诉你，我一直在找一个长着呆眼睛、愿意迁就我飞船上那张空铺位的[silly|呆瓜机器人|生化机器人]。他得够怪；怪得讨人喜欢才有趣；还得有一手家务本领，能给我这种懒骨头提供生命保障。我愿意投资这样的资产。” 你那位戴帽子的朋友没有回应，仍在梳理你浅浅埋进土里的言外之意。不过他并不迟钝，很快便像玩具巴士一样发出咪呜声。“好，好的。我明白了，[pc.mr] [pc.fullname]。所以，您的这番谈话旨在收集与我的可用状态有关的信息，然后提出另一种结果，以启动我的用途重置；届时我会跟随您同行...呃，呃呃。我不知道。我在空间站还有许多工作必须完成。这不是可行的选择。我不能如此突然地离开同事和兄弟姐妹。” 你摊开双手，仍带着公允的微笑。“没关系。我能理解你的立场。我那里永远有舱室可以入住；记住这点，或者存个档。” 特伦斯轻轻哼了一声，随后点点头，愈发明显却仍有所克制的喜爱化作一抹逐渐绽开、微微抽动的笑容，回应着你。你友好地拍了拍他的手臂，很高兴你和他达成了共识，而且彼此似乎也同样中意对方。

rows.original: You lay it flat on your artificial friend, expressing your desire for a life-like, indestructible, and fuckable android of your own. The kind of all-purpose companion bot you planned as a tie-in to your adventures. Scratch that. Serving you in your adventures. “Y-you... you desire to induct me in your expeditions... as a companion bot?” Electrodes are surging in Terence, holding him stiller than a stone pillar. “That is... unfounded. That is... unrea-.” “Just think about it, will you?” You hush up the protest with a nimble swoop of an arm, scooping the discombobulated android up by his girlish flanks. Enjoying the quivers bursting from his legs and shoulders, which sends his lower half jiggling, you tilt low to the side of his paralyzed head, observing high-tech sentience go through severe input lag. Only then do you closely murmur, “If you find yourself hanging up the gun and badge for good: you know who to go to first.” “I... I. U-uuuh,” Terence drawls and stutters, computing what to vocalize in this claustrophobic situation. Finally, after some lengthy pauses, his glowing eyes scurry far out of sight as he struggling to mumble, “I will list your input for primary consideration if I do choose to invest in a new simulation. Is umm... I do no-... is that acceptable for you, [pc.mr] [pc.fullName]?” You face your blue bot-boy with a devilish grin, squeezing his synthetic hip-fat with the right amount of roughness and affection to drive the message. You let go before excusing yourself while he wobbles, bow-legged, struggling to stay upright on the two tender noodles he now has to use. He seems into the promising future, more than his nervous face lets on, and takes his time patting away the wrinkles you left on his uniform.
rows.translation: 你直截了当地告诉这位仿生人朋友，你想拥有一台栩栩如生、坚不可摧而且可以随意操弄的仿生人。就是那种全能伙伴机器人，你原打算让他作为冒险旅程的联动搭档。不对。是让他在冒险中服侍你。 “您，您...您希望招募我加入您的远征...让我担任伙伴机器人？”特伦斯体内电极激流涌动，让他僵得比石柱还要纹丝不动。“这...毫无根据。这...不合常理。” “好好考虑一下，行吗？” 你灵巧地挥臂一捞，将晕头转向的仿生人拦腰抱起，堵住了他的抗议。你享受着他双腿与肩膀迸发出的阵阵颤抖，那让他的下半身也跟着晃动；随后你俯身凑近他僵住的脑袋一侧，观察这份高科技智能经历严重的输入延迟。 直到这时，你才贴近他低声说道：“如果哪天你决定永远收起枪和警徽，你知道首先该去找谁。” “我...我。呃，呃呃，”特伦斯拖长声音，结结巴巴地计算着该在这逼仄处境中说些什么。终于，在几次漫长的停顿后，他发光的双眼飞快躲向视野之外，艰难地低声说道：“如果我的确选择投入一项新的模拟，我会把您的意见列为首要考虑事项。那，嗯...我不知...这样您可以接受吗，[pc.mr] [pc.fullName]？” 你带着恶魔般的坏笑正视这位蓝色机器人男孩，以恰到好处的粗野与爱意捏住他那层仿生臀胯脂肪，把意思传达清楚。你松开手，告辞离去；他则两腿外撇、摇摇晃晃，勉强靠如今不得不用的两根柔软面条保持站立。他似乎很期待那前景可期的未来，远比紧张的表情所显露的更加期待，并慢慢拍平你在他制服上留下的褶皱。

rows.original: “Just me being curious. Can’t know how my little tooshie-cop fared in his eons?” you tease, bumping shoulder to shoulder with Terence. He staggers back a couple of steps, too confused or too caked up to keep his balance. “Okay,” Terence grins, his eyes formed into positive arches, “I am aware I can be a fiddly outlet for conversations... frequently. I hope my explanation was satisfactory to you, [pc.mr] Steele.” It was.
rows.translation: “我只是好奇而已。难道我就不能知道自家这位翘臀小警察在漫长岁月里过得怎样吗？”你调侃着，用肩膀撞了撞特伦斯。他向后踉跄几步，不知是太过困惑，还是臀部太丰满，竟然无法保持平衡。 “好吧，”特伦斯咧嘴一笑，双眼弯成向上的弧线，“我知道自己在交谈中可能会是个难以驾驭的接口...而且常常如此。希望我的解释令您满意，[pc.mr]斯蒂尔。” 确实如此。

rows.original: You raise a hand to your chin, asking, “Could you tell me about this ‘reconditioning’ process?” Terence jerks slightly, like an alarm was raised by your very words, one blaring at him in what was just another day. A gut reaction that gets worse as the emergency becomes clear to him. You know he’s freaked out and probably shouldn’t ask. You feel almost required to ask, but it might... you don’t know. It might screw both him and you if he does. “I thought I’d ask you since you kinda seem like one of the chill ones around here. The whole rundown was vague, and I think I got lost at a point. It’s been bugging me ever since.” You lower your voice, inching closer to him. “And I’m sure your siblings let you in on all the most classified data.” Eyes contracted to intense pinpoints, Terence bursts with, “THE ‘RECONDITIONING...!’ THE ‘REconditioning’ process?!” in a rapidly muting shrill. Your eyes shut and brow furrows, thrown off by his outburst. It only intrigues you more, so you choose your next words wisely, politely insisting that it would be helpful if he caught you up on the details. “It is not just the altered color scheme reconfiguring us P-2 units, not the rewired personality parameter either. I mean, those are reconfigurations, but there is more to the process, [pc.mr] Steele... a lot more.” He corrects, sucking his bottom lip. “Metanite Cultivators... no w-wait uuuh incorrect uuuh... mutated assailants. Out on the Rim!” Coughing to sooth a fraction of his anxiety, Terence nervously goes along with it. “Yes, mutated assailants who conduct mutated assailant misdeeds... by cultivating. These individuals, they... they units specialized in P-2 engagements. When a cultivator dispatches one such P-2, me, for instance, they decline termination. The cultivate will instead restrain their target, me, for instance, and nullify any method of escape. Then, they... they...” “And then, they...?” You gently pry. “They... I have never analyzed the attack first-hand, only shared less than concise accounts by witnesses — since victims obtain no records. But uuum... I can share the scope of my data anyway. The course of events is both physical and technical in nature. A praetor android’s exterior is pierced across most of its body with probes and wires, with some regions more concentrated than others. Their focus points are around the torso, specifically the chest and groin. Total reconfiguration is launched upon this stage’s completion, at the cultivator’s full discretion; they have the authority to insert as many or as few of their abominable, mutant extensions as desired.” A momentary pause holds his mouth open. Not for fresh air since robots have no lungs. “The assailant will bypass the android’s built-in security software, quickly gaining access to administrative privileges. Then u-uuuh, then, the next step is reworking the central processing unit to whatever these assailants see fit. While this is proceeding, I... the remodeling is initiated. This can span a duration I have not established. Ten to thirty minutes? This data is not vital to me; it should not be. I do not know. A victim, me, for instance, is unable to override the supposedly permanent ‘reconditioning’. Force shutdown: Ineffective. Shock dispersal: Ineffective. Dormancy states activated two protocols before the chance to reestablish authority; they are too fast.” You brush below your [pc.lips], grasping what you can of Terence’s technical discomfort. “And this remodeling? What about that?” Your short fella gets the shivers, spine made of hollow tin, dialing up his convoluted verbosity. “It... it changes us. I-I correct myself; it affixes us. These cultivators. They affix P-2 units with this neurological matrix. They install software completely strange, unknown, and unestablished. They also install sets of hardware equipment that ensures we do not fail to compute their primary function. I do not know. I do not compute. I also gather that corrupted P-2 have some unusual capacity to produce foreign substances from said hardware. The memory I logged is graphic... so graphic, I u-uuuh...” Wait a sec...? Are you hearing what you think you’re hearing? These purple-colored P-2s sometimes caught down the halls, acting odd when entering unmarked bays. They’re packing? Is that right? ‘Equipment.’ Equipment ninety-nine percent of the population has. Eyes falling to his feet, Officer Terence murmurs, “I... I can not visualize the horrors my siblings and cousins have to sustain managing their day-to-day operation, especially not on the day of their ‘reconditioning’. It must be a terrible operation, undergoing new tasks requiring immediate action, coping with an overclocked sensation algorithm never simulated before. I can not possibly visualize their operation. None should simulate such experiences.” Terence’s averse stance initially seemed reasonable, albeit overdramatic, when noting present facts. Recognizing what is essentially an upgrade to his line, not some deadly corruption, or virus, or whatever. You think this weak-kneed machine must surely be acting the part of a scared little lamb. It sounds to you that he is rationalizing an irrational fear. You can maybe change that, perhaps easing him into seeing through this silly, harebrained narrative he strewn together.
rows.translation: 你抬手托住下巴，问道：“能跟我讲讲这个‘再调制’流程吗？” 特伦斯猛地一颤，仿佛你这句话拉响了警报，把原本平凡无奇的一天搅得警铃大作。那是种本能反应，而且随着他意识到事态有多严重，还变得越发强烈。 你知道他吓坏了，自己大概也不该问。可你又觉得非问不可，只是这样也许会...你说不好。要是他说了，搞不好会把你们俩都害惨。 “我只是觉得，你好像算这里比较随和的那种，所以才来问你。之前那番概述含糊不清，我听到一半大概就跟丢了。从那以后，这事一直让我很在意。”你压低嗓音，向他凑近一点。“而且我敢肯定，你的兄弟姐妹肯定把最机密的资料全告诉你了。” 特伦斯双眼缩成紧张的针尖，骤然尖叫道：“‘再调制...！’你是说‘再调制’流程？！”声音很快又低了下去。 你闭上双眼，眉头紧蹙，被他这番爆发弄得措手不及。但这只让你好奇心更盛，于是你谨慎措辞，礼貌地坚持说，要是他能把详情补给你，会很有帮助。 “它不只是改变配色方案来重新配置我们P-2单位，也不只是重接人格参数。当然，那些都属于重新配置，但这个流程还有更多内容，[pc.mr]斯蒂尔...多得多。”他纠正道，吸吮着下唇。“超奈特培育者...不，不对，呃呃，表述错误，呃呃...变异袭击者。就在边缘星域！” 特伦斯咳了几声，稍稍平复焦虑，紧张地继续说下去。“对，变异袭击者，他们通过培育实施变异袭击者式的恶行...这些个体，他们...他们是专门与P-2交战的单位。当一名培育者击败某个P-2，例如我，他们会放弃终结目标。培育者反而会束缚目标，例如我，并消除一切逃脱方式。然后，他们...他们...” “然后他们就...？”你轻声追问。 “他们...我从未亲自分析过这种袭击，只听过目击者不够简明的共同描述，因为受害者不会留下任何记录。不过，呃...我还是可以分享数据涵盖的范围。整个过程兼具物理与技术性质。执政官仿生人的外壳会在身体大部分区域遭探针和导线刺穿，其中某些部位尤其密集。重点集中在躯干，具体而言是胸部与胯部。这个阶段一旦完成，便会启动全面重新配置，完全由培育者自行决定；他们想插入多少条可憎的变异延伸物都可以，少则一条，多则不限。” 他的嘴短暂地张着。并不是为了呼吸新鲜空气，毕竟机器人没有肺。 “袭击者会绕过仿生人的内置安全软件，迅速取得管理员权限。然后，呃呃呃，然后下一步，就是按袭击者的意愿改造中央处理器。在此期间，我...重塑也会启动。这个过程会持续多久，我尚未确定。十到三十分钟？这项数据对我并不重要，也不该重要。我不知道。无法计算。受害者，例如我，无法撤销那据称永久生效的‘再调制’。强制关机：无效。电击驱散：无效。在重新确立权限之前两个协议，休眠状态便已激活；他们太快了。” 你抚过[pc.lips]下方，努力理解特伦斯在技术层面的不安。“那这个重塑呢？又是怎么回事？” 你的小个子伙伴浑身发颤，空心铁皮做的脊柱直打哆嗦，说起话来也愈发繁复绕口。“它...它会改变我们。我，我纠正一下；它会给我们加装东西。那些培育者。他们会给P-2单位装上这种神经矩阵。他们会安装完全陌生、未知、未经确立的软件。还会安装成套硬件设备，确保我们不会无法执行其主要功能。我不知道。我无法计算。据我收集的信息，受腐化的P-2还能通过上述硬件产生某些外来物质。我记录的记忆很露骨...太露骨了，我，呃呃呃...” 等等...? 你听到的真是你以为的那个意思吗？ 那些偶尔会在走廊里撞见的紫色P-2，一走进没有标记的舱室，举止就会变得古怪。他们有那玩意儿？是这个意思吗？“设备。”百分之九十九人口都有的设备。 特伦斯警官垂眼看着脚边，低声说道：“我...我无法想象我的兄弟姐妹和表亲为了维持日常运作，必须承受何等恐怖的经历，更无法想象他们接受‘再调制’的那一天。那必定是可怕的运作过程，要承接必须立刻执行的新任务，还要应付从未模拟过的超频感觉算法。我绝不可能想象他们的运作。任何单位都不该模拟这种经历。” 就目前这些事实而言，特伦斯这种抗拒姿态起初似乎还算合理，尽管未免太过戏剧化。毕竟，这本质上是对他这一型号的升级，而不是什么致命腐化、病毒或类似玩意。你觉得这台腿软的机器肯定只是在扮演受惊的小羊羔。听起来，他正为一种非理性的恐惧强行找理由。你或许能改变这一点，也许可以慢慢引导他看穿自己编出来的这套愚蠢荒唐说辞。
rows.raw: " You raise a hand to your chin, asking, “Could you tell me about this ‘reconditioning’ process?” Terence jerks slightly, like an alarm was raised by your very words, one blaring at him in what was just another day. A gut reaction that gets worse as the emergency becomes clear to him. You know he’s freaked out and probably shouldn’t ask. You feel almost required to ask, but it might... you don’t know. It might screw both him and you if he does. “I thought I’d ask you since you kinda seem like one of the chill ones around here. The whole rundown was vague, and I think I got lost at a point. It’s been bugging me ever since.” You lower your voice, inching closer to him. “And I’m sure your siblings let you in on all the most classified data.” Eyes contracted to intense pinpoints, Terence bursts with, “THE ‘RECONDITIONING...!’ THE ‘REconditioning’ process?!” in a rapidly muting shrill. Your eyes shut and brow furrows, thrown off by his outburst. It only intrigues you more, so you choose your next words wisely, politely insisting that it would be helpful if he caught you up on the details. “It is not just the altered color scheme reconfiguring us P-2 units, not the rewired personality parameter either. I mean, those are reconfigurations, but there is more to the process, [pc.mr] Steele... a lot more.” He corrects, sucking his bottom lip. “Metanite Cultivators... no w-wait uuuh incorrect uuuh... mutated assailants. Out on the Rim!” Coughing to sooth a fraction of his anxiety, Terence nervously goes along with it. “Yes, mutated assailants who conduct mutated assailant misdeeds... by cultivating. These individuals, they... they units specialized in P-2 engagements. When a cultivator dispatches one such P-2, me, for instance, they decline termination. The cultivate will instead restrain their target, me, for instance, and nullify any method of escape. Then, they... they...” “And then, they...?” You gently pry. “They... I have never analyzed the attack first-hand, only shared less than concise accounts by witnesses — since victims obtain no records. But uuum... I can share the scope of my data anyway. The course of events is both physical and technical in nature. A praetor android’s exterior is pierced across most of its body with probes and wires, with some regions more concentrated than others. Their focus points are around the torso, specifically the chest and groin. Total reconfiguration is launched upon this stage’s completion, at the cultivator’s full discretion; they have the authority to insert as many or as few of their abominable, mutant extensions as desired.” A momentary pause holds his mouth open. Not for fresh air since robots have no lungs. “The assailant will bypass the android’s built-in security software, quickly gaining access to administrative privileges. Then u-uuuh, then, the next step is reworking the central processing unit to whatever these assailants see fit. While this is proceeding, I... the remodeling is initiated. This can span a duration I have not established. Ten to thirty minutes? This data is not vital to me; it should not be. I do not know. A victim, me, for instance, is unable to override the supposedly permanent ‘reconditioning’. Force shutdown: Ineffective. Shock dispersal: Ineffective. Dormancy states activated two protocols before the chance to reestablish authority; they are too fast.” You brush below your [pc.lips], grasping what you can of Terence’s technical discomfort. “And this remodeling? What about that?” Your short fella gets the shivers, spine made of hollow tin, dialing up his convoluted verbosity. “It... it changes us. I-I correct myself; it affixes us. These cultivators. They affix P-2 units with this neurological matrix. They install software completely strange, unknown, and unestablished. They also install sets of hardware equipment that ensures we do not fail to compute their primary function. I do not know. I do not compute. I also gather that corrupted P-2 have some unusual capacity to produce foreign substances from said hardware. The memory I logged is graphic... so graphic, I u-uuuh...” Wait a sec...? Are you hearing what you think you’re hearing? These purple-colored P-2s sometimes caught down the halls, acting odd when entering unmarked bays. They’re packing? Is that right? ‘Equipment.’ Equipment ninety-nine percent of the population has. Eyes falling to his feet, Officer Terence murmurs, “I... I can not visualize the horrors my siblings and cousins have to sustain managing their day-to-day operation, especially not on the day of their ‘reconditioning’. It must be a terrible operation, undergoing new tasks requiring immediate action, coping with an overclocked sensation algorithm never simulated before. I can not possibly visualize their operation. None should simulate such experiences.” Terence’s averse stance initially seemed reasonable, albeit overdramatic, when noting present facts. Recognizing what is essentially an upgrade to his line, not some deadly corruption, or virus, or whatever. You think this weak-kneed machine must surely be acting the part of a scared little lamb. It sounds to you that he is rationalizing an irrational fear. You can maybe change that, perhaps easing him into seeing through this silly, harebrained narrative he strewn together. "

rows.original: “You look a bit tense there,” you mention, [pc.finger] circling over Terence’s frightened self. “Does the thought of becoming closer to a fleshy like me make your endoskeleton rattle?” Terence tilts his head sideways, automatically plain-faced in confusion. “Fleshy? [pc.mr] Steele, what do you mean by that?” You get to the heart of the matter. From what you’re hearing, his purple chums got their loins slapped with the Adam & Eve Classic; sexified with reproductive organs. You aren’t sure whether their private ‘hardware’ is actually some kind of advanced, corrupting mutant tech. Who knows... yet. All you are thinking about are bots thrown into a toss-up for eggplants and nuts, or muffins with cherries fresher than clothes hot out of the dryer. “Our ‘reconditioning’... our systematic corruption extends farther than that!” He meekly protests, looking almost ready to bawl sparks. “All P-2 units — no matter their original orientation — are tinkered to a new alteration. On the basis of the victimized siblings and cousins I’d met, they all possess the parts that qualify them as [silly|futanoids|functional hermaphrodites] . A functional phallus, a functional vagina, and a pair of mammaries now compromised with weak, exploitable points that these... these mutant violators use to torment us. They convert us into weak and corrupted shells of ourselves, like them, then they bend us, they break us into immobility. The simulations speak for themselves. I can not compute how you orga-.” You sigh, head shaking. “Aaand ten minutes later: after system reboot, unit number one-two-three is back on their feet, right? A bit sooner than their platoon was placing chips on.” Honestly though, he needs to lay off the fearmongering. There is a colorful world of sensation to discover out there. Sex. Pleasure. Feeling that good, tingly sensation rocking you when reaching the crescendo. It’s a part of nature he shouldn’t shudder to face. While this ‘reconditioning’ may happen as described — an egregious molestation imposing both mental and physical alterations — nobody returns in a body bag. Are these ‘cultivators’ severely tampered with his fallen sibling constructs? Yes. Were they destroyed shortly after? No. “I... I do not know,” he murmurs with his head low, “[pc.mr] [pc.fullName]. I do not see the benefit of having one’s systems hacked and integrity ‘reconditioned’ and not having the capacity to control these actions. Heaps of data I compiled warns only of imminent danger.” “Well, danger can be a feisty fucker some have a handle on, while others die trying to touch it,” you argue, playfully pinching his meatless bicep. Basically, you are saying the little tooshie-bot has almost nothing to fear. Almost nothing. Change can be a scary prospect. Cloud nine can also come from change. Trust that you, out of trillions, know this the most. Terence isn’t going to find fulfilling change if he doesn’t take more risks. And you’d know; you practically have the blood of a chameleon coursing through your veins. Terence lifts his head up to look at you, his big blue eyes pulsing for answers. Your insightful words took root, seeming to rewrite hardwired scripts — or toggling something in that abiotic brain. He scans your [pc.face], searching for something, some culprit of his newfound uncertainty, and you watch him do it. While you’d hate for anyone in the vicinity to get the wrong idea here, that soft, receptive face he has bids you to stare longer, mouth spreading with a goofy grin. Dude doesn’t know how adorable he can sometimes be.
rows.translation: “你看起来有点紧张啊，”你提到，[pc.finger]在特伦斯受惊的身体前绕着圈。“一想到会跟我这样的血肉之躯变得更亲近，就吓得你内骨骼咯咯作响吗？” 特伦斯侧过脑袋，困惑地露出毫无修饰的呆板表情。“血肉之躯？[pc.mr]斯蒂尔，您这是什么意思？” 你直奔问题核心。照你听来的意思，他那群紫色伙伴的胯间都被装上了亚当与夏娃经典套装；添上生殖器官，彻底性化了。你不确定他们的私密“硬件”究竟是不是某种先进的、具有腐化作用的变异技术。谁知道呢...至少现在不知道。你满脑子想的，都是那些机器人会随机拿到茄子和坚果，或者比刚出烘干机的衣服还新鲜、顶着樱桃的松饼。 “我们的‘再调制’...我们遭受的系统性腐化远不止于此！”他怯生生地抗议，看起来都快哭出火花了。“所有P-2单位，无论原本的性别取向为何，都会被改造成一种新的形态。根据我遇过的受害兄弟姐妹与表亲，他们全都具备足以让自己被归类为[silly|扶她|功能性双性人]的部件。能正常使用的阴茎、能正常使用的阴道，还有一对乳房；如今这些部位都带着脆弱而可供利用的弱点，让那些...那些变异侵犯者得以折磨我们。他们把我们变成跟他们一样软弱腐化的空壳，接着弯折我们，摧毁我们，让我们动弹不得。模拟结果已经说明了一切。我无法理解你们这些有机体怎会如此。” 你叹了口气，摇摇头。“然然后十分钟后：系统重启，一二三号单位重新站起来了，对吧？还比同排战友下注预测的时间早一点。” 不过说真的，他该少散播些恐慌。外面有一个多姿多彩的感官世界等待探索。性爱。快感。抵达高潮时，浑身被那种美妙酥麻的感觉撼动。这是自然的一部分，他不该怕得不敢面对。即使这场“再调制”确实如他所述，是同时强加精神与肉体改变的恶劣猥亵，也没有谁最后被装进裹尸袋。那些“培育者”有没有严重篡改他倒下的同型兄弟？有。他们之后不久就被摧毁了吗？没有。 “我...我不知道，”他低着头喃喃道，“[pc.mr] [pc.fullName]。系统遭到入侵，完整性被‘再调制’，又没有能力控制这些行为，我看不出这有什么益处。我汇编的大量数据都只对迫在眉睫的危险发出警告。” “好吧，危险就是个难缠的小婊子；有人能拿捏住它，也有人想碰它却把命丢了，”你争辩道，玩笑般捏了捏他毫无血肉的二头肌。 简单来说，你是在告诉这个小屁股机器人，他几乎没什么好怕的。只是几乎。改变可能令人恐惧，改变也可能把人送上九霄云外。相信你吧，亿万众生当中，没人比你更明白这一点。特伦斯如果不多冒点险，就找不到能让自己满足的改变。而你当然懂；你血管里简直流着变色龙的血。 特伦斯抬头看你，一双蓝色大眼睛闪动着，渴求答案。你那番充满洞见的话扎下了根，似乎正在重写硬接线脚本，又或者拨动了那颗非生物脑袋里的某个开关。他扫描着你的[pc.face]，像在搜寻什么，搜寻令他新生疑虑的罪魁祸首，而你看着他这么做。尽管你不希望附近任何人误会眼前的情形，他那张柔和而善于接纳的脸却引得你盯得更久，嘴角也咧成傻笑。这家伙压根不知道自己有时能有多可爱。

rows.original: [var0 |Cute face. Dainty body. Spankable rear. Robot or not, this blue guy has your [pc.eyes] sweeping places, even when he and others are looking. “Hey so, Officer Terence?” you murmur, turning Terence’s head to a faceful of your provocative charm. “Your workflow seems pretty tame at the moment. Say... you wouldn’t mind taking a break with me? You and I could share our warmest regards.” “I do not understand what you mean, [pc.mr] Steele.” He replies, too blanked in confusion to consider analyzing your smirking lips and hooded eyes, even when you’re hovering five inches away from his face. “Could you rephrase your request?” Crude and abrupt, your hand slithers onto his round trunk, synthetic curves brimming from the back of his tight pants. “Does this register anything?” you saucily ask, the soft, fabric-shearing moon jiggling in your mean grip. “You and me; get a room; get in bed; get naked.” It takes one very long second of silent gazing for his shoulders to jump, booty cheeks clenching in your grasp. Your bot-boy reacts damn slow. Goddamn. Still, you got the jolt you wanted. “U-uuuh... I... I....” Terence stammers, the usual bumbling as he makes sense of everything besides default inputs — like emotions and sexual attraction. And sense is eventually made, which unfortunately prompts Terence to drop his attention. The little dude looks like he’s toggled on scouting mode or something. His eyes were spellbound to you, then suddenly whip anywhere else, as if looking at some imagined motion. No amount of whispers or squeezes seem to wake him out of his frozen trance. He’s basically ignoring you instead of giving a simple yes or no. You will just have to try again some other time, it seems. Maybe not this attempt, but you will score a robutt on a platter soon enough! Once Terence stops shying away like the proverbial bag of nerves he is. |“Oooh, Terence?” You hum invitingly, getting the cute bot-cop to see you checking him out with an indecent gaze. “Have you forgotten about my special proposal? I haven’t.” “U-uuuh,” he tensely mumbles in response. Reverting to a nervous wreck, Terence’s knees buckle, thighs rubbing together. rows.raw: "You can’t exactly speak for how Ushamee should feel."

rows.original: “Embarrassed, probably,” you answer. “What happened back on the ship should probably stay there.”
rows.translation: “大概会尴尬吧，”你回答。“飞船上发生的事，最好还是留在那里。”
rows.raw: "“Embarrassed, probably,” you answer. “What happened back on the ship should probably stay there.”"

rows.original: The leithan woman sighs and bites her lip, averting her gaze. “Ah, right. You’re right, of course. Better to stay professional.”
rows.translation: 莱森女人叹了口气，咬住嘴唇，移开视线。“啊，对。你说得对，当然应该保持专业。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe leithan woman sighs and bites her lip, averting her gaze. “Ah, right. You’re right, of course. Better to stay professional.”"

rows.original: She gives you a slight nod and then rests her hands on the table between you, wubbing her fingers together nervously. “So, um, I’ll be here around the station for a while if you want to talk about stuff in general, later. It’s not like I have anywhere better to be on ‘indefinite psychological leave.’ Just don’t expect me to be sober.”
rows.translation: 她朝你微微点头，随后把双手放在你们之间的桌面上，紧张地相互摩挲着手指。“所以，嗯，我还会在空间站附近待上一阵子。你以后要是想随便聊些什么，都可以来找我。反正我正处于‘无限期心理休假’，也没什么更好的去处。只是别指望我会清醒着。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a slight nod and then rests her hands on the table between you, wubbing her fingers together nervously. “So, um, I’ll be here around the station for a while if you want to talk about stuff in general, later. It’s not like I have anywhere better to be on ‘indefinite psychological leave.’ Just don’t expect me to be sober.”"

rows.original: Giving her your most charming smile, you tell the chief that you certainly liked seeing that side of her. And you gotta say: you wouldn’t mind seeing it again, in less dire circumstances.
rows.translation: 你朝她露出最迷人的微笑，告诉酋长，你确实很喜欢见到她的那一面。而且不得不说，你不介意在没那么危急的情况下再看一次。
rows.raw: "Giving her your most charming smile, you tell the chief that you certainly liked seeing that side of her. And you gotta say: you wouldn’t mind seeing it again, in less dire circumstances."

rows.original: “O-oh? Is that right?” the chief grins, “Well, I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t hoping for that answer.”
rows.translation: “哦——？是这样吗？”酋长咧嘴一笑，“要说我没期待这个答案，那就是撒谎了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh? Is that right?” the chief grins, “Well, I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t hoping for that answer.”"

rows.original: You watch as her dusky skin flushes an even darker shade of purple. Usha gives you a surprisingly shy little smile, rubbing at one of her floppy ears and swishing her big reptilian tail against the booth. “So, um, maybe sometime you and I could go somewhere, and see how that pans out.”
rows.translation: 你看着她黝黑的肌肤泛起更深一层紫红。乌莎出人意料地朝你露出羞涩浅笑，揉着一只耷拉的耳朵，粗大的爬虫尾巴则扫过卡座。“所以，嗯，也许哪天我们可以一起找个地方，看看事情会怎样发展。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch as her dusky skin flushes an even darker shade of purple. Usha gives you a surprisingly shy little smile, rubbing at one of her floppy ears and swishing her big reptilian tail against the booth. “So, um, maybe sometime you and I could go somewhere, and see how that pans out.”"

rows.original: “You mean like a date?”
rows.translation: “你是说约会吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You mean like a date?”"

rows.original: Usha chuckles, glancing at you with those dark, starry eyes of hers. “I guess so, huh? Could be fun to see how you handle yourself without an army of monsters on your heels.”
rows.translation: 乌莎轻笑着，用那双幽暗如星空的眼睛看向你。“大概是吧，对不对？看看没有一大群怪物追在身后时你会怎么应付，应该很有意思。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUsha chuckles, glancing at you with those dark, starry eyes of hers. “I guess so, huh? Could be fun to see how you handle yourself without an army of monsters on your heels.”"

rows.original: And it might be fun to see how the chief handles you when she doesn’t have a fuck-parasite squirming around inside her.
rows.translation: 而且，看看酋长在没有性交寄生虫在体内扭动时会怎么对付你，或许也挺有趣。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd it might be fun to see how the chief handles you when she doesn’t have a fuck-parasite squirming around inside her."

rows.original: “Then it’s settled. We can talk about when and where soon -- I need a drink!”
rows.translation: “那就说定了。时间和地点以后再谈——我需要喝一杯！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then it’s settled. We can talk about when and where soon -- I need a drink!”"

rows.original: You answer with a shrug, saying that how she feels is up to her.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩回答，说她如何感受由她自己决定。
rows.raw: "You answer with a shrug, saying that how she feels is up to her."

rows.original: “Well of course it is!” she huffs, crossing her arms in a way that puffs out her already-big tits. “And let me tell you, I’m a girl who knows what she wants! And what I want... is you. That’s why I called you out here, and that’s what I’m gonna get! So are you in, or am I gonna have to work at it until you give in?”
rows.translation: “那当然了！”她气呼呼地说道，双臂交叉，令本就丰满的乳房更加向外挺出。“而且我告诉你，我可是很清楚自己想要什么的女人！而我想要的...就是你。正因如此，我才叫你来这里，也一定会如愿得到你！所以你答不答应，还是非得让我一直努力到你屈服？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well of course it is!” she huffs, crossing her arms in a way that puffs out her already-big tits. “And let me tell you, I’m a girl who knows what she wants! And what I want... is you. That’s why I called you out here, and that’s what I’m gonna get! So are you in, or am I gonna have to work at it until you give in?”"

rows.original: Now that sounds more like the chief you remember. If you’re onboard, maybe you ought to ask her out. Or let her ask you out, whichever comes first.
rows.translation: 这才更像你记忆中的那位主管。如果你愿意，或许该约她出去。又或者让她约你，谁先开口都一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that sounds more like the chief you remember. If you’re onboard, maybe you ought to ask her out. Or let her ask you out, whichever comes first."

rows.original: “Back again?” Usha says with a hungry little smile. “Good to see you, [pc.name]! Sit down, take a load off. Let me buy you a drink!”
rows.translation: “又来了？”乌莎带着饥渴的浅笑说道。“很高兴见到你，[pc.name]！坐下歇歇。我请你喝一杯！”
rows.raw: "“Back again?” Usha says with a hungry little smile. “Good to see you, [pc.name]! Sit down, take a load off. Let me buy you a drink!”"

rows.original: Usha chuckles and finishes off her beer, drawing in a long, sharp breath as she does so. “Alright! Now we’re talking. C’mon, there’s a shuttle planetside on the other side of the station.”
rows.translation: 乌莎轻笑着喝完啤酒，同时长长地猛吸一口气。“好！这才对嘛。来吧，空间站另一头有艘前往行星表面的穿梭机。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUsha chuckles and finishes off her beer, drawing in a long, sharp breath as she does so. “Alright! Now we’re talking. C’mon, there’s a shuttle planetside on the other side of the station.”"

rows.original: The chief pays off the tab and offers you her hand, leading you off of the lodge and around the gentle curve of Canadia Station’s outer ward. The transit station is much more crowded than anywhere else you’ve visited here, and most of them ‘taurs to boot: deers and meese and good old-fashioned horsefolk, all coming and going from the planet’s surface.
rows.translation: 这位主管结清账单，向你伸出手，领你离开旅舍，绕过卡纳迪亚站外区平缓的弧道。交通站比你在这里去过的任何地方都拥挤，而且大多数人还是兽身族：鹿人、驼鹿人和传统的马人，全都在行星表面与空间站之间往来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chief pays off the tab and offers you her hand, leading you off of the lodge and around the gentle curve of Canadia Station’s outer ward. The transit station is much more crowded than anywhere else you’ve visited here, and most of them ‘taurs to boot: deers and meese and good old-fashioned horsefolk, all coming and going from the planet’s surface. "

rows.original: You’ve heard that Vesperia’s got a serious culture for tauric gene-mods, but seeing a slice of the public really drives home just how many four-legged citizens the planet must have. They easily outnumber the two-legged folk three to one. You and Usha are ushered onto a shuttlecraft by a particularly statuesque moose-bodied woman in a red mountie’s jacket who sweetly guides passengers into appropriate cabins before sealing you in.
rows.translation: 你听说维斯佩里亚盛行兽身基因改造，但亲眼看到一部分民众，才真正体会到这颗行星上有多少四足公民。他们轻易就以三比一的人数压过双足居民。你和乌莎被一名身材格外高大的驼鹿身女性引上一艘穿梭机；她穿着红色骑警夹克，亲切地引导乘客进入合适的舱室，随后将舱门封闭。
rows.raw: "You’ve heard that Vesperia’s got a serious culture for tauric gene-mods, but seeing a slice of the public really drives home just how many four-legged citizens the planet must have. They easily outnumber the two-legged folk three to one. You and Usha are ushered onto a shuttlecraft by a particularly statuesque moose-bodied woman in a red mountie’s jacket who sweetly guides passengers into appropriate cabins before sealing you in."

rows.original: A couple of minutes later and you’re hurtling through the Vesperian atmosphere, watching with Usha as the rolling green hills and craggy black mountains of the garden world rush closer through the windows. A speaker in your cabin tells you that you’ll be “arriving in Port Victoria shortly. Please secure all your belongings and fasten your harnesses or seat belts.” There’s a moment of intense gravity, dragging you forward in your seat until the shuttle shudders and comes to a stop, landing on to the roof of a large complex in the outskirts of a small city.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，你便与乌莎一起飞驰穿过维斯佩里亚的大气层，透过舷窗看着这座花园世界连绵的翠绿丘陵和嶙峋的黑色群山迅速逼近。舱内的广播告诉你们，很快将“抵达维多利亚港。请收好所有随身物品，并系紧安全吊带或安全带。”一阵强烈的重力把你向前拽在座位上，随后穿梭机震颤着停下，降落在小城郊外一座大型建筑群的屋顶。
rows.raw: "\n\nA couple of minutes later and you’re hurtling through the Vesperian atmosphere, watching with Usha as the rolling green hills and craggy black mountains of the garden world rush closer through the windows. A speaker in your cabin tells you that you’ll be “arriving in Port Victoria shortly. Please secure all your belongings and fasten your harnesses or seat belts.” There’s a moment of intense gravity, dragging you forward in your seat until the shuttle shudders and comes to a stop, landing on to the roof of a large complex in the outskirts of a small city."

rows.original: “Small for Earth, maybe,” Usha mentions as she’s unbuckling herself from the ceiling-mounted ‘taur-harnesses. “Victoria’s one of the largest cities on the planet. My brother and his family live on a farm just a couple miles south of here -- most of the planet’s still rural, and the locals like it that way. Keeps the place beautiful.”
rows.translation: “对地球来说也许算小，”乌莎一边解开悬挂在天花板上的‘兽身吊带’，一边说道。“维多利亚是这颗行星最大的城市之一。我哥哥一家住在这里往南几英里的一座农场里--这颗行星大部分地区仍是乡村，本地人也喜欢这样。这样才能让这里一直这么美。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Small for Earth, maybe,” Usha mentions as she’s unbuckling herself from the ceiling-mounted ‘taur-harnesses. “Victoria’s one of the largest cities on the planet. My brother and his family live on a farm just a couple miles south of here -- most of the planet’s still rural, and the locals like it that way. Keeps the place beautiful.”"

rows.original: Usha smiles, gazing out across the rolling grassy plains surrounding the city, stretching almost to the horizon before giving way to the mountains.
rows.translation: 乌莎微笑着望向城市周围起伏的草原。草原几乎一路延伸到地平线，随后才让位于群山。
rows.raw: "\n\nUsha smiles, gazing out across the rolling grassy plains surrounding the city, stretching almost to the horizon before giving way to the mountains."

rows.original: Beautiful indeed.
rows.translation: 确实很美。
rows.raw: "\n\nBeautiful indeed."

rows.original: You and Usha hop aboard the shuttle, escorted by the familiar, matronly figure of the mountie on guard, and are quickly ferried back down to the picturesque grasslands of Vesperia. Port Victoria rushes up to meet you in your planetfall, until you’re disembarking onto the roof of the spaceport. Usha sighs happily and stretches, clearly enjoying the rush of fresh air as the shuttle door slides open.
rows.translation: 你和乌莎登上穿梭机，在那位熟悉的、母亲般的值勤骑警陪同下，很快被送回维斯佩里亚如画的草原。降落行星时，维多利亚港飞速迎面而来，直至你们在太空港屋顶下船。穿梭机舱门滑开，乌莎开心地叹息并伸了个懒腰，显然十分享受扑面而来的新鲜空气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Usha hop aboard the shuttle, escorted by the familiar, matronly figure of the mountie on guard, and are quickly ferried back down to the picturesque grasslands of Vesperia. Port Victoria rushes up to meet you in your planetfall, until you’re disembarking onto the roof of the spaceport. Usha sighs happily and stretches, clearly enjoying the rush of fresh air as the shuttle door slides open."

rows.raw: "\n\n“So, where to?”"

rows.translation: “离这里几个街区有座重力球竞技场，”你们两人--以及一群本地公牛--聚集到一部宽敞的电梯里前往底层时，乌莎提议道。“而且我很确定再过几个小时就有比赛。”

rows.original: Sounds fun. You tell her to lead the way, falling in beside the towering leithan. Happily, the sidewalks on Vesperia are made for ‘taurs, so there’s plenty of room for both of you to walk side by side. Usha’s arm settles around your shoulder, pulling you against her flank and guiding you towards your destination. It isn’t long before you arrive at a wide, flat arena covered in banners for local sports teams and Vesperian lagers.
rows.translation: 听起来很有趣。你让她带路，与高大的莱萨人并肩而行。好在维斯佩里亚的人行道是为兽身族修建的，足够你们两人并肩行走。乌莎把手臂搭在你的肩膀上，将你拉向她的侧腹，领着你走向目的地。没过多久，你们就来到一座宽阔平坦的竞技场，场外挂满本地运动队和维斯佩里亚拉格啤酒的横幅。

rows.original: . Since the game isn’t for a little bit -- you can’t quite be lucky enough for an impromptu date to hit right on start time -- the two of you head over to a small concourse near the entrance and sit down, content to spend the intervening time chatting with each other. You certainly have enough to talk about, even after you both decide not to bring up the events of the Kashima: the chief knows a hell of a lot about ships, and once the topic wanders onto your own vessel, well, you’ve got her talking non-stop for what seems at once like the blink of an eye and hours. The only thing that breaks you out of the reverie is the surge of bulky four-legged people starting to brush past you, filing into the stadium from the streets.
rows.translation: 。距离比赛开始还有一会儿--即兴约会不可能幸运到正好赶上开场时间--你们便走到入口附近的一处小型大厅坐下，心满意足地利用这段空闲时间聊天。即使你们都决定不谈鹿岛号上的遭遇，也肯定有足够多的话题：这位主管对星舰了解得惊人，而当话题转到你自己的飞船时，她便滔滔不绝起来，时间仿佛既只过了眨眼一瞬，又像过去了好几个小时。直到大群魁梧的四足居民开始从你们身旁涌过，从街道进入体育场，你才从出神中惊醒。
rows.raw: ". Since the game isn’t for a little bit -- you can’t quite be lucky enough for an impromptu date to hit right on start time -- the two of you head over to a small concourse near the entrance and sit down, content to spend the intervening time chatting with each other. You certainly have enough to talk about, even after you both decide not to bring up the events of the Kashima: the chief knows a hell of a lot about ships, and once the topic wanders onto your own vessel, well, you’ve got her talking non-stop for what seems at once like the blink of an eye and hours. The only thing that breaks you out of the reverie is the surge of bulky four-legged people starting to brush past you, filing into the stadium from the streets."

rows.original: You join the human(-ish) tide, taking Usha’s hand to make sure you don’t get separated as you make your way to your seats amidst a low, throbbing din of voices. There’s an electrical air of excitement all throughout the place, even before the lights flash on and the anti-grav generators come alive on the field.
rows.translation: 你加入这股人类（或近似人类）的潮流，握住乌莎的手，确保你们不会在低沉而震耳的嘈杂人声中走向座位时失散。整座场馆都弥漫着令人振奋的兴奋气息，甚至在灯光亮起、场上的反重力发生器启动前便已如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou join the human(-ish) tide, taking Usha’s hand to make sure you don’t get separated as you make your way to your seats amidst a low, throbbing din of voices. There’s an electrical air of excitement all throughout the place, even before the lights flash on and the anti-grav generators come alive on the field."

rows.original: “GO BUCKS!” Usha shouts, bouncing on her claws (in a way that does rather hypnotic things to her hefty rack) when the side gates open and the teams come marching out. Gravball is meant to support all the myriad body types in the galaxy, but here on vesperia, there’s one form that clearly dominates the field: ‘taurs. Most members of both teams are big, burly moose-taurs or centaurs, their halves still human rippling with muscle and glistening with sweat. You only see a lone unmodded human out there, along with a snake-bodied man and someone with sprawling feathered wings. None of it really matters once the gravity in the arena upends, and everyone starts free-floating, controlling only by tiny thrusters.
rows.translation: “雄鹿队加油！”侧门打开、两队列队入场时，乌莎用蹄爪蹦跳着高喊（这个动作让她沉甸甸的胸部以一种颇为催眠的方式摇晃）。重力球本是为了兼容银河系形形色色的体型，但在维斯佩里亚，有一种体型显然主宰了赛场：兽身族。两队大多数成员都是高大壮硕的驼鹿身人或半人马，人形上半身肌肉起伏，汗水闪亮。场上只有一名未经改造的人类，外加一个蛇身男子和一名生着舒展羽翼的人。等竞技场里的重力颠倒，所有人开始自由漂浮，只能依靠微型推进器控制方向时，这些都不再重要。
rows.raw: "\n\n“GO BUCKS!” Usha shouts, bouncing on her claws (in a way that does rather hypnotic things to her hefty rack) when the side gates open and the teams come marching out. Gravball is meant to support all the myriad body types in the galaxy, but here on vesperia, there’s one form that clearly dominates the field: ‘taurs. Most members of both teams are big, burly moose-taurs or centaurs, their halves still human rippling with muscle and glistening with sweat. You only see a lone unmodded human out there, along with a snake-bodied man and someone with sprawling feathered wings. None of it really matters once the gravity in the arena upends, and everyone starts free-floating, controlling only by tiny thrusters."

rows.original: The next couple hours are spent amidst deafening roars of exultation and defeat, watching the home team hammer their grav-ball through the other team’s hoops, then get pushed onto the defensive, until finally a clench overtime spike from the winged vixen manages to carry them to victory. Usha’s cheering and jumping all the while, shouting players names or calling for the referee to suck her dick. Eventually, though, the game comes to an end, and the gravity returns to the field.
rows.translation: 接下来的几个小时在震耳欲聋的欢呼与哀号中度过。你看着主队将重力球一次次轰入对方的球环，随后又被迫转入防守，直到加时赛中，那名有翼雌狐的一记制胜尖刺终于带领他们赢得胜利。乌莎全程又叫又跳，时而高喊球员的名字，时而叫裁判来舔她的鸡巴。不过比赛最终还是结束了，重力也恢复到赛场上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next couple hours are spent amidst deafening roars of exultation and defeat, watching the home team hammer their grav-ball through the other team’s hoops, then get pushed onto the defensive, until finally a clench overtime spike from the winged vixen manages to carry them to victory. Usha’s cheering and jumping all the while, shouting players names or calling for the referee to suck her dick. Eventually, though, the game comes to an end, and the gravity returns to the field."

rows.original: “Did you see that last throw?” Usha laughs as you file out. “Like, bam! The Maples didn’t even see it coming! Haha!”
rows.translation: “你看到刚才那一掷了吗？”你们鱼贯离场时，乌莎笑道。“就那么，砰！枫叶队根本没反应过来！哈哈！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did you see that last throw?” Usha laughs as you file out. “Like, bam! The Maples didn’t even see it coming! Haha!”"

rows.original: While you’re not exactly a gravball expert, you can certainly tell your date had a hell of a time. You reach over and put an arm around Usha’s hips, pressing your shoulders up against the ‘taur-girl’s slick plates. Her tail curls around to caress you, and you find yourself falling into a companionable silence, listening to Usha rave on about the game until you’re almost back to the spaceport. Before you head back to Canadia Station, though, she insists on you taking her to dinner at a little cafe around the corner from it.
rows.translation: 虽然你算不上重力球专家，但肯定看得出你的约会对象玩得非常开心。你伸手环住乌莎的腰，将肩膀贴上这名兽身姑娘光滑的甲片。她的尾巴卷过来爱抚你，你发现自己陷入一种亲密无间的沉默，听乌莎兴奋地谈论比赛，直到你们快要回到太空港。不过在返回卡纳迪亚站之前，她坚持要你带她去港口拐角处的一家小咖啡馆吃晚餐。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’re not exactly a gravball expert, you can certainly tell your date had a hell of a time. You reach over and put an arm around Usha’s hips, pressing your shoulders up against the ‘taur-girl’s slick plates. Her tail curls around to caress you, and you find yourself falling into a companionable silence, listening to Usha rave on about the game until you’re almost back to the spaceport. Before you head back to Canadia Station, though, she insists on you taking her to dinner at a little cafe around the corner from it."

rows.original: A big game apparently demands a big dinner afterwards. It’s not fine dining, but it’s homey and quiet compared to the bustling arena you’ve just left. And intimate, too, you realize as you and Usha stare into each other’s eyes across the table, giggling and smiling over any little thing, right up until you’re finally covering the bill and escorting the ever-so-slightly tipsy ‘taur back to the spaceport.
rows.translation: 一场盛大的比赛之后，显然得配上一顿丰盛的晚餐。这里算不上高级餐厅，但相比刚刚离开的喧闹竞技场，显得温馨而安静。你还意识到，这里也很亲密；你和乌莎隔桌凝望彼此的双眼，为任何小事咯咯发笑、面带微笑，直到最后由你结账，护送已有一丝醉意的兽身姑娘返回太空港。
rows.raw: "\n\nA big game apparently demands a big dinner afterwards. It’s not fine dining, but it’s homey and quiet compared to the bustling arena you’ve just left. And intimate, too, you realize as you and Usha stare into each other’s eyes across the table, giggling and smiling over any little thing, right up until you’re finally covering the bill and escorting the ever-so-slightly tipsy ‘taur back to the spaceport."

rows.original: “That was so much fun!” she titters as you’re strapping each other into the shuttle. “Here I thought you’d be
rows.translation: “太好玩了！”你们互相帮忙系上穿梭机安全带时，她咯咯笑道。“我还以为你会是那种
rows.raw: "\n\n“That was so much fun!” she titters as you’re strapping each other into the shuttle. “Here I thought you’d be "

rows.original: mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "mister"

rows.original: miss
rows.translation: 小姐
rows.raw: "miss"

rows.original: five-star restaurants and black-dress affairs, but I guess you do know how to let loose and have fun.”
rows.translation: 五星级餐厅配小黑裙的人，但看来你确实懂得怎么放松享乐。”
rows.raw: " five-star restaurants and black-dress affairs, but I guess you do know how to let loose and have fun.”"

rows.original: Aww, after all you’ve been through, and she still thinks you’re some up-tight rich kid, huh?
rows.translation: 唉，你们都经历这么多了，她居然还把你当成一本正经的有钱人吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAww, after all you’ve been through, and she still thinks you’re some up-tight rich kid, huh?"

rows.original: “Hey, I didn’t mean it like that. You’re alright, Steele,” Usha grins, punctuating the thought with a little hiccup. “Sorry. Maybe I’ll make it up to you when we get back.”
rows.translation: “嘿，我不是那个意思。你人挺好的，斯蒂尔，”乌莎咧嘴一笑，轻轻打了个嗝，为这句话画上句号。“抱歉。也许等我们回去后，我可以补偿你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, I didn’t mean it like that. You’re alright, Steele,” Usha grins, punctuating the thought with a little hiccup. “Sorry. Maybe I’ll make it up to you when we get back.”"

rows.original: Now that’s something to look forward to...
rows.translation: 现在这才值得期待...
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that’s something to look forward to..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: LIBERTERIA.USHA DATE.USHADATE
rows.raw: "LIBERTERIA.USHA DATE.USHADATE"

rows.original: “I’ve got an idea,” Usha says, leading you towards the edge of the city. “C’mon, it’s not far.”
rows.translation: “我有个主意，”乌莎一边说，一边领你走向城市边缘。“来吧，不远。”
rows.raw: "“I’ve got an idea,” Usha says, leading you towards the edge of the city. “C’mon, it’s not far.”"

rows.original: Fair enough. You
rows.translation: 有道理。你
rows.raw: "\n\nFair enough. You "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isTaur()
                ? "trot along beside Usha"
                : "hop onto Usha’s back"

rows.original: trot along beside Usha
rows.translation: 在乌莎身边小跑
rows.raw: "trot along beside Usha"

rows.original: hop onto Usha’s back
rows.translation: 跳到乌莎背上
rows.raw: "hop onto Usha’s back"

rows.original: and set out to your mystery destination. Usha’s not exactly a master conversationalist, but over the half hour or so you end up walking, you manage to coax her into talking a little about her work with NovaSec.
rows.translation: ，向神秘的目的地出发。乌莎算不上善于交谈，但在大约半小时的步行途中，你设法引导她聊了些自己在诺瓦安保的工作。
rows.raw: " and set out to your mystery destination. Usha’s not exactly a master conversationalist, but over the half hour or so you end up walking, you manage to coax her into talking a little about her work with NovaSec."

rows.original: “I joined right out of trade school. Was in a starship engineering apprenticeship, and Nova had a booth at a trade fair at my school. I thought, ‘hey, that sounds cool,’ so I joined up when I got my diploma. Great story, right?”
rows.translation: “我一从技校毕业就加入了。当时我在做星舰工程学徒，而诺瓦在我们学校的招聘会上设了展位。我想，‘嘿，听起来挺酷’，所以拿到毕业证后就加入了。故事很精彩，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I joined right out of trade school. Was in a starship engineering apprenticeship, and Nova had a booth at a trade fair at my school. I thought, ‘hey, that sounds cool,’ so I joined up when I got my diploma. Great story, right?”"

rows.original: “Riveting.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Riveting.”"

rows.original: “Yep. I ended up working on one of their light carries pretty much right off, since I’m a big girl and I need a big ship if I’m gonna be crawling around in the engines. The crew was nice, the jobs were just the right kind of challenging, and the pay was... well, I didn’t starve, anyway. So I stuck around, got damn good at my job. Eventually got transferred to the Nebula as her chief engineer. You got to meet the crew on a weird day, too: the captain and the XO had just gotten hitched -- not to each other, just at the same time for some reason -- so I was in charge of our little tug for just a couple of weeks. My first time commanding, and look what happens.”
rows.translation: “没错。因为我是个大块头，要在引擎里爬来爬去就得配艘大船，所以我几乎一开始就在他们的一艘轻型航母上工作。船员们人都不错，任务也恰好够有挑战性，至于薪水...嗯，至少没让我饿死。所以我就留了下来，把自己的活儿练得相当在行。后来，我被调到星云号担任轮机长。你见到船员们那天也挺不寻常：舰长和大副刚刚结婚--不是彼此结婚，只是不知为何恰好同一时间办了婚礼--所以那几周里一直由我指挥我们的小拖船。我第一次当指挥，结果你也看到了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep. I ended up working on one of their light carries pretty much right off, since I’m a big girl and I need a big ship if I’m gonna be crawling around in the engines. The crew was nice, the jobs were just the right kind of challenging, and the pay was... well, I didn’t starve, anyway. So I stuck around, got damn good at my job. Eventually got transferred to the Nebula as her chief engineer. You got to meet the crew on a weird day, too: the captain and the XO had just gotten hitched -- not to each other, just at the same time for some reason -- so I was in charge of our little tug for just a couple of weeks. My first time commanding, and look what happens.”"

rows.original: At least almost everyone made it out in one piece -- a few mutations aside. The company can’t be too mad at her, considering the circumstances.
rows.translation: 至少几乎所有人都平安脱险了--撇开少数变异不谈。考虑到当时的情况，公司应该不会太责怪她。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least almost everyone made it out in one piece -- a few mutations aside. The company can’t be too mad at her, considering the circumstances."

rows.original: Usha chuckles, then sighs. “Yeah, I hope so. Would suck to have to go flip burgers or something. Anyway, looks like we’re almost there.”
rows.translation: 乌莎轻笑一声，随后叹了口气。“是啊，希望如此。要是不得不去煎汉堡什么的，那可太糟了。总之，我们好像快到了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUsha chuckles, then sighs. “Yeah, I hope so. Would suck to have to go flip burgers or something. Anyway, looks like we’re almost there.”"

rows.original: She points up a nearby hill, to a small stone building sitting over a field of vine trellises. A dozen moose-bodied workers meander around the field, tending to the crop. Usha guides you up the long, winding dirt road that leads up to the vineyard.
rows.translation: 她指向附近的一座小山，那里有栋小石屋，俯瞰着一片葡萄藤架。十来个驼鹿身躯的工人在田间来回走动，照料作物。乌莎领着你走上那条蜿蜒漫长、通往葡萄园的土路。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe points up a nearby hill, to a small stone building sitting over a field of vine trellises. A dozen moose-bodied workers meander around the field, tending to the crop. Usha guides you up the long, winding dirt road that leads up to the vineyard."

rows.original: “So what’s the plan?” you ask while Usha approaches the door, pushing it open. The interior answers your question: there are several trestle tables set up just inside, and something like two dozen people sitting inside, drinking and eating merrily while saucy Latin music plays around them. A fully-human woman in a white-and-black server’s uniform walks up to you with a warm smile, asking if it’s just the two of you today.
rows.translation: “所以计划是什么？”乌莎走近门口将门推开时，你问道。屋内的景象回答了你的问题：入口内侧摆着几张栈桌，大约二十来个人坐在里面，一边开怀畅饮吃喝，一边听着四周热辣的拉丁音乐。一名身穿黑白侍者制服的纯人类女性带着热情的微笑走来，询问今天是否只有你们两位。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’s the plan?” you ask while Usha approaches the door, pushing it open. The interior answers your question: there are several trestle tables set up just inside, and something like two dozen people sitting inside, drinking and eating merrily while saucy Latin music plays around them. A fully-human woman in a white-and-black server’s uniform walks up to you with a warm smile, asking if it’s just the two of you today."

rows.original: “Yeah, for tasting and lunch both,” Usha tells her.
rows.translation: “对，既能品尝，也能当午餐，”乌莎告诉她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, for tasting and lunch both,” Usha tells her."

rows.original: “Planning on plying me with alcohol?” you tease once the waitress has seated you.
rows.translation: “打算用酒灌醉我？”女服务员安排你坐下后，你打趣道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Planning on plying me with alcohol?” you tease once the waitress has seated you."

rows.original: “So what’s this place’s deal?” you ask once you’re seated by the waitress.
rows.translation: “那这地方有什么特别之处？”你们落座后，你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’s this place’s deal?” you ask once you’re seated by the waitress."

rows.original: Usha grins. <i>“It’s a wine tasting! Used to be a big, big deal on Terran. At least that’s what my brother says... so it’s probably a horseshit excuse to get drunk. Still, I’ve always had a good time here, and the food’s pretty decent.
rows.translation: 乌莎咧嘴一笑。<i>“这是品酒会！以前在泰拉可是件非常、非常隆重的事。至少我哥哥是这么说的...所以这大概只是个喝醉的狗屁借口。不过我每次来这里都玩得很开心，而且食物也相当不错。
rows.raw: "\n\nUsha grins. <i>“It’s a wine tasting! Used to be a big, big deal on Terran. At least that’s what my brother says... so it’s probably a horseshit excuse to get drunk. Still, I’ve always had a good time here, and the food’s pretty decent."

rows.original: Just don’t get the ‘taur portions,’ unless you wanna be eating out of a wheelbarrow. They really pile it on!
rows.translation: 千万别点‘兽身份量’，除非你想对着独轮车吃饭。他们真的会堆得满满的！”
rows.raw: " Just don’t get the ‘taur portions,’ unless you wanna be eating out of a wheelbarrow. They really pile it on!"

rows.original: You take a look at their menu and make your selection in the intervening moments before the waitress returns with a pair of glasses and a bottle of some local vintage with a very flowery name that, by the time all’s said and done, you probably won’t remember anyway. You just knock it back and enjoy, content to let the leithan girl chat away at you about her brother taking her here and getting them both absolutely trashed, and how they ended up pulling a cart into town for the owner to pay off some ludicrous debt.
rows.translation: 你看了看菜单，在女侍者拿着一对酒杯和一瓶本地产的陈酿回来前选好了菜。那酒有个极其花哨的名字，反正等一切结束后，你大概也不会记得。你只管一饮而尽，惬意地享受着，同时任由莱萨姑娘滔滔不绝地讲她哥哥带她来这里，把两人都灌得烂醉，以及他们最后如何替店主拉着一辆车进城，偿还某笔荒唐的债务。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a look at their menu and make your selection in the intervening moments before the waitress returns with a pair of glasses and a bottle of some local vintage with a very flowery name that, by the time all’s said and done, you probably won’t remember anyway. You just knock it back and enjoy, content to let the leithan girl chat away at you about her brother taking her here and getting them both absolutely trashed, and how they ended up pulling a cart into town for the owner to pay off some ludicrous debt."

rows.original: Your food comes after the fourth sampling of wine. By then, Usha’s got a merry little flush to her cheeks and just can’t stop talking. Her tail is swishing behind her, thumping against the chairs of the table behind her.
rows.translation: 第四轮品酒过后，你们的食物送来了。这时乌莎双颊已经泛起愉快的红晕，嘴巴也完全停不下来。她的尾巴在身后甩动，不断拍打后桌的椅子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour food comes after the fourth sampling of wine. By then, Usha’s got a merry little flush to her cheeks and just can’t stop talking. Her tail is swishing behind her, thumping against the chairs of the table behind her."

rows.original: “Oh my stars finally. I’m starving!” she giggles, digging in like a ravenous animal. She doesn’t talk with her mouth full, at least, giving you a chance to get a few words of your own in during the downtime. You tell her about a few of your own intoxicated adventures
rows.translation: “噢，我的星辰啊，终于来了。我快饿死了！”她咯咯笑着，像头饿坏的野兽般大吃起来。至少她不会塞着满嘴食物说话，这段空当让你有机会插上几句。你告诉她自己几次醉酒后的冒险经历
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my stars finally. I’m starving!” she giggles, digging in like a ravenous animal. She doesn’t talk with her mouth full, at least, giving you a chance to get a few words of your own in during the downtime. You tell her about a few of your own intoxicated adventures"

void 0 !== flags.REAHA_MYR_SCENE
                ? ", such as the incident with Reaha and the varmint,"
                : ""

rows.original: , such as the incident with Reaha and the varmint,
rows.translation: ，比如莉雅哈与害兽的那次事件，
rows.raw: ", such as the incident with Reaha and the varmint,"

rows.original: though you’ve never been anywhere quite like this rustic little retreat. Most of the planets you get to visit are either too dangerous, or too modern to support it.
rows.translation: ，不过你从未到过如此质朴幽静的地方。你能造访的大多数行星要么太危险，要么过于现代，容不下这样的地方。

rows.original: “To be honest, when you gave the news, a part of me was really worried about having to drop my job and home, but another part was really, really happy,” Sylvie beams. “And now that I know I won’t need to change my whole life for it, all the better!”
rows.translation: “说实话，刚听到消息时，我一方面非常担心自己不得不放弃工作和家园，可另一方面又真的、真的很高兴，”西尔维笑容满面。“现在知道不必为此彻底改变生活，那就更好了！”

rows.original: You and Sylvie spend the rest of the hour talking about the baby: pitching name ideas and trying to guess how they’ll look based on whom they take after, then figuring out what clothes to buy, and so on. The police-woman also lets you know that even if she’s half a galaxy away, she’ll still be taking an active role in raising the kids. Those words feel so reassuring that they bring a heartfelt smile to your lips – you have indeed chosen the right person to sire your children.
rows.translation: 接下来的时间里，你和西尔维一直谈论孩子：提出各种名字，猜测他们会更像谁、长成什么模样，再商量该买哪些衣服等等。这位女警还告诉你，即使相隔半个银河，她依然会积极参与抚养孩子。这番话令人无比安心，让你发自内心地露出笑容，你确实选对了孕育自己孩子的人。

rows.raw: "For the past several hours, you’ve been feeling semi-regular contractions – early labor, according to your Codex – but they’ve been growing more intense and closer together over the past hour. You’re pretty sure you’re entering active labor. Taking a few deep breaths to quiet the frantic thoughts in your head, you make your way to the hospital. Just as you’re about to arrive, your water breaks."

rows.original: No sooner have you told the attendant about the situation than you are ushered to a room. A nurse stays with you, holding your hand and helping you to breathe the right way, in order to alleviate the discomfort. A doctor shows up within minutes and starts running the routine scans, reassuring you that everything is going to be fine. Her voice is calm and professional yet filled with warmth. Being a woman, she must know firsthand what you’re going through.
rows.translation: 你刚向接待员说明情况，就被迅速带进一间病房。一名护士留在你身边，握着你的手，帮助你以正确方式呼吸，从而减轻不适。几分钟内，一位医生便赶来进行常规扫描，并安慰你一切都会顺利。她的声音冷静专业，却又充满温暖。身为女性，她一定亲身体会过你正在经历的感受。

rows.original: “Oh. I didn’t think you were serious,” the moosetaur says, uncharacteristically flustered. “To answer your question: eventually yes, but for now I just want to focus on my career and enjoy my freedom. If I were to have kids, I’d want them to grow up on an actual planet, so they could gallop in open fields, feeling the sun above their heads and the earth under their hooves,” she explains with a dreamy look in her eyes. “But I love my life here in Canadia Station. There’s no way I could leave my job and my friends behind. Kally would be heartbroken. Besides, career prospects on Vesperia aren’t too bright, you know, they’d probably make me a paper pusher,” the police-woman adds, her expression turning into a disgusted scowl. She must really hate the idea.
rows.translation: “哦。我没想到你是认真的，”这位驼鹿兽身人一反常态地慌乱起来。“回答你的问题：以后会想要，但现在我只想专注事业，享受自由。要是有了孩子，我希望他们能在真正的星球上长大，可以在开阔田野里奔跑，感受头顶的阳光和蹄下的土地，”她解释道，眼中带着梦幻般的神色。“可是我喜欢自己在卡纳迪亚站的生活。我不可能抛下工作和朋友离开。凯莉会伤心透顶的。而且维斯佩里亚的职业前景并不算好，你也知道，他们大概只会让我去做文书工作，”女警补充道，表情变成了厌恶的怒容。她肯定非常讨厌这个想法。

rows.original: “a simple rusher,” you cut in. You shake your head and explain that you’re just [pc.name]. That’s how you met Sylvie, and you don’t want her to start treating you differently just because she knows of your bloodline now. You like her just how she is: cheerful, spontaneous, vibrant. Canadia Station’s airlocks are standard affairs with heavy interior and exterior doors, designed to maintain the integrity of the internal atmosphere at all costs. Presently, both are wide open, allowable only because of a hardlight-encapsulated bubble of air around the landing pad, but they’d snap closed in the space of a second in the event of a serious fault. The faded controls are completely dim and unlit, disabled until the air-bubble is powered down.
		
		A light-blue, bottom-heavy android seems to be keeping an eye on people coming and going from the station.

卡纳迪亚空间站的气闸是标准设计，拥有厚重的内外舱门，力求在任何情况下维持内部大气的完整。目前两道门都完全敞开，只有着陆坪周围存在硬光封闭的空气泡时才允许如此；一旦发生严重故障，它们会在一秒之内猛然闭合。褪色的控制面板完全黯淡无光，在空气泡关闭之前都处于禁用状态。
		
		一个浅蓝色、下身宽大的机器人似乎正在留意进出空间站的人群。

rows.original:
You’re inside The Pump House, a restaurant modeled after an old terran diner. The floor is black and white checkerboard with red and pastel white being the most dominant colors of the decor. Tables are lined against the wall next to the large windows, giving patrons a view into the rest of the station. A long, continuous counter dotted with single seats is on the opposite side of the dining hall.

		A team of flat-chested, wipe-hipped kaithrit waitresses seems to be manning the place, tending to waiting customers and ducking into the kitchen, only to resurface moments later. They’re wearing dresses with cutouts along the midsection and hips, showing plenty of skin. They’re also wearing stockings and collars with oversized bells. You notice that the front of every kaithrit waitress’s dress is bulging considerably, making it obvious that they’ve always got extra sausage at hand. 
		
		A quick glance at the menu tells you that it’s not the most friendly to your waistline. With your nanoboosters, at least you won’t have to worry about your arteries getting clogged up.
		
		The place isn’t empty, as the delicious smell of food wafts in the air and out of the door, luring in new customers constantly. There are plenty of locals, as well as some rushers and pilots sitting at booths, wolfing down food in between long flights. Luckily, it’s not too busy either; you could probably just sit down and wait for someone to take your order.
rows.translation:
你身处“泵屋”餐厅内部，这里仿照旧地球时代的餐馆设计。地板铺着黑白棋盘格，装潢则以红色和柔和的白色为主。桌子沿墙摆在大窗旁，顾客可以由此眺望空间站的其他区域。餐厅另一侧是一条长长的连续吧台，上面间隔摆着单人座椅。

		店里似乎由一群平胸宽胯的凯斯里特女服务员负责打理。她们招呼着等候的顾客，不时钻进厨房，又在片刻后重新现身。她们身穿腰腹和胯部开口的连衣裙，露出大片肌肤，腿上还穿着长袜，脖子上则戴着挂有超大铃铛的项圈。你注意到，每位凯斯里特女服务员的裙子前方都明显鼓起，显然她们手边随时都有“额外的香肠”。 
		
		你匆匆扫了一眼菜单，便知道这里对你的腰围可不怎么友好。不过有纳米强化剂在，至少不用担心动脉被堵塞。
		
		餐厅并不冷清。诱人的食物香气飘荡在空气中，还一路逸出门外，不断吸引新顾客进来。许多本地居民、淘金客和飞行员坐在卡座里，趁漫长航程的间隙狼吞虎咽。好在这里也不算太忙；你大概可以直接坐下，等人来为你点单。

		A quick glance at the menu tells you that it’s not the most friendly to your waistline. With your nanoboosters, at least you won’t have to worry about your arteries getting clogged up.
		
		The place isn’t empty, as the delicious smell of food wafts in the air and out of the door, luring in new customers constantly. There are plenty of locals, as well as some rushers and pilots sitting at booths, wolfing down food in between long flights. Luckily, it’s not too busy either; you could probably just sit down and wait for someone to take your order."

rows.original: Despite residing inside an advanced space station, the Kui Country Bar and Lodge has the sort of smoky, musky atmosphere you would expect to find in a rustic drinking hole, an impression reinforced by the prolific backwoods decorations. Numerous powder-bangers hang high on the walls, armed with everything from old-style optics to modern optic linkages, out of reach of most patrons and doubtless bolted down for good measure. A few local hunting trophies can be spotted as well, though not so garishly displayed as to offend.
rows.translation: 尽管身处先进的空间站内，狸乡酒吧旅馆却有着乡间小酒馆才会出现的烟雾缭绕、麝香浓郁的氛围，随处可见的乡野装饰更强化了这种印象。许多火药枪高挂在墙上，从老式瞄具到现代光学连接装置一应俱全，既在大多数顾客够不到的地方，无疑也牢牢固定住了。这里还能看到一些本地狩猎战利品，不过陈列方式并没有夸张到足以冒犯他人。

rows.original:
The Kui Country Bar and Lodge has one enormous bathroom for all sexes, genders, and races, presumably part of a Vesperian equality initiative. The north wall has urinals positioned at a variety of heights to accommodate the various physical proportions of local males and herms. Stalls line the south side of the room, large enough for a centaur but equipped to handle the galaxy’s women with equal ease. Any impression of class is ruined by graffiti labels that designate certain stalls as “Beej Throne” and “Cum Palace!” A quick peek inside reveals the presence of gloryholes - lots of them.

Sanitation stalls along the east wall provide plenty of opportunity to clean up after whatever biological functions you attend to within.
rows.translation:
奎乡村酒吧旅馆设有一间供所有生理性别、社会性别及种族共同使用的巨型卫生间，想必也是维斯佩里亚平等倡议的一环。北墙装着高度各异的小便池，以适应当地男性与双性人不同的身体比例。隔间沿房间南侧排开，宽敞得足以容纳半人马，也同样能轻松满足银河各地女性的需要。某些隔间被涂鸦标成“口交王座”和“精液宫殿！”，瞬间毁掉了这里残存的所有格调。往里匆匆一瞥，便能发现荣耀洞——而且数量很多。

东墙边排列着清洁隔间，无论你在里面处理了什么生理需求，都有充分条件收拾干净。

rows.original: Dazzling light forces you to blink the minute you step into the bathing area. The ceiling has a single, enormous light amongst baby blue tiles, designed to mimic the appearance of a sun, and meticulously sculpted bushes and flowers ring the wall, lending a breezy, outdoorsy feeling to the whole affair. Different pools of all shapes and sizes interrupt the grassy floor, some bubbling with effervescent warmth and others chilly, many housing patrons who have decided to take their drinks somewhere quieter and relax.
rows.translation: 你刚踏进浴场，耀眼的光芒便迫使你眨了眨眼。淡蓝色瓷砖之间，天花板上只有一盏巨大的灯，设计得如同太阳一般；精心修剪的灌木与花卉环绕墙边，营造出轻松开阔的户外氛围。形状大小各异的水池分布在草地般的地面上，有些冒着温暖的气泡，有些则清凉宜人；许多池中都有顾客，他们带着饮料来到更安静的地方放松。

rows.original: Kally’s room is... neat. Astonishingly neat. The walls are clean white affairs housing embedded lights. The diffuse lighting bathes the place in a calm, clear ambience. She’s chosen purple sheets for her bed and a lacy pink pillow, but like everything else they’re spotless and meticulously arranged. A filing cabinet and desk sit beside the door, armed with a beefy holographic computer that would look more at home in a college kid’s dorm room than in a serious businesswoman’s abode. An enormous bottle of lube is tucked into the corner, half-hidden behind a box of “Spunk-Monster” brand condoms.
rows.translation: 卡莉的房间...十分整洁。整洁得令人吃惊。墙壁洁白干净，内部嵌着灯光。柔和的光线让这里笼罩在平静而清晰的氛围中。她为床铺选了紫色床单和粉红蕾丝枕头，不过和其他东西一样，它们都一尘不染、摆放得井井有条。门旁放着文件柜和书桌，桌上配有一台性能强劲的全息电脑；与其说属于严肃的女商人，它看起来更适合放在大学生宿舍里。角落里藏着一大瓶润滑剂，一半被一盒“精液怪兽”牌避孕套挡住。

rows.original: A cushy-looking bed dominates the room, supported by a rough-hewn frame, varnished to preserve its rustic charm for all eternity. A dresser provides ample storage space as well as a home for numerous decorative knick-knacks. One that stands out is a plush beaver with a ridiculous pair of wood-carved antlers and a flat, fuzzy tail meant to serve as a coaster. You’re pretty sure it’s teeth would work as a bottle opener in a pinch as well. All the standard amenities one would expect are here with the added bonus of a bathroom so well equipped it would look more at home in a luxury hotel.
rows.translation: 一张看起来十分舒适的床占据了房间的主体，由粗削木料制成的床架支撑，并涂上清漆，让那份质朴魅力永久保留下来。衣柜提供了充足的储物空间，也摆放着许多装饰小物。其中最显眼的是一只毛绒河狸，它长着一对夸张的木雕鹿角，还有一条可以当杯垫使用的扁平毛茸尾巴。你很确定，必要时它的牙齿也能充当开瓶器。这里拥有所有应有的标准设施，另外还附带一间设备齐全得更像豪华酒店的浴室。
